https://www.inquirer.net/495243/comelec-.body: The observation comes as the poll body reopened the registration for the May 2028 national and local elections. Comelec Chair George Erwin Garcia described the turnout at the Special Registration Anywhere/Anytime Program (SRAP) site at Mabini Hall in Luneta Park in Manila as “overwhelming.”The commission did not expect such a large number of applicants on the first day. At the Luneta Park SRAP site, long lines had already formed before registration began at 8 a.m. on Tuesday. Majority of those waiting were senior high school students, most of whom were applying for voter registration as a requirement for their college applications. John Rex Laudiangco said the turnout was considerably better than the registration turnout over the last couple of years. He cited similarly large crowds at other special registration sites nationwide. “SRAP NU Lipa received applications not only from Batangas, Quezon, Cavite, Mindoro and many more,” Laudiangco noted. He believes the hight turnout as proof that Filipinos recognize the importance of registering to vote in the 2028 elections. To bring voter registration closer to the public, Comelec will continue to set up SRAP sites in various establishments, including schools and malls. Following its activity at Luneta Park, the poll body will open additional SRAP sites at WalterMart Chino Roces on Nov. 19, and the Far Eastern University-Manila campus on Nov. 24. The poll body is accepting applications for first-time registration, transfer of registration records, reactivation of deactivated records, and correction or updating of personal information. Applicants must bring at least one valid identification document, along with its original copy and a photocopy. The ID must bear the applicant’s photograph, full name and address. Comelec accepts the following documents: An electronic Philippine Identification (ePhilID) may also be presented, provided it can be accessed through the eGovPH app. READ: Comelec says barangay residency certificate, cedula not valid IDs Comelec reminds applicants that barangay residency certificates, community tax certificates or cedulas, police clearances and company IDs are not accepted as proof of identity or residency. Each registered voter or qualified relative may serve as a guarantor for up to three applicants only. Applicants may register at the Office of the Election Officer (OEO) with jurisdiction over the area where they intend to register or update their registration records. Other designated registration venues include satellite offices, mall registration sites, the Special Registration Anywhere/Anytime Program (SRAP) and the Registration Anywhere Program. Registration sites are open from Tuesday to Friday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. The sites are also open Saturdays and holidays, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Before visiting a registration site, applicants may download and complete the application form from the Comelec website. The form must be printed back-to-back on legal-size paper. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）副总统候选人Rotimi Amaechi敦促党内成员保持冷静。尽管联邦高等法院作出裁决，推翻该党领导层和总统初选结果，Amaechi先生仍呼吁大家继续竞选。这位前Rivers州州长透露，该党已对判决提出上诉，并相信上诉法院会作出公正裁决。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The African Democratic Congress (ADC) vice presidential candidate, Rotimi Amaechi, has urged party members to remain calm and continue campaigning despite the Federal High Court judgement that invalidated the party’s leadership and presidential primary. He made the remarks on Channels Television’s Sunrise Daily programme on Tuesday morning. Mr Amaechi, a former Rivers State governor, disclosed that the party had appealed the judgment and expressed confidence that the Court of Appeal would do the right thing. He urged supporters not to allow the ruling to distract them from their political activities. “What we have done is continue to let our supporters know that everybody should be calm and continue with your campaign,” Mr Ameachi, the transport minister during President Muhammadu Buhari administration, said. The dispute over the ADC leadership began after Nafiu Bala Gombe, a former deputy national chairman of the party, challenged the emergence of the David Mark-led leadership. Mr Gombe sued the party and the David Mark-led executives before the Federal High Court in Abuja, arguing that he was entitled to lead the party following the resignation of its former national chairman, Ralph Nwosu. He also challenged the party’s July 2025 National Executive Committee meeting, which produced the Mark-led leadership. He asked the court to invalidate the meeting and its decisions and stop the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) from recognising the new leadership. In April, the Supreme Court sent the dispute back to the Federal High Court to determine the substantive issues. The Supreme Court did not decide who was entitled to lead the party. Justice Peter Lifu delivered judgement on 5 November, ruling in favour of Mr Gombe. He nullified the party’s 99th National Executive Committee meeting and the decisions taken at the meeting. The judge also invalidated the party’s primary elections, including the process that produced former Vice President Atiku Abubakar as its presidential candidate. He directed INEC not to recognise the decisions of the disputed meeting. Although Mr Amaechi disclosed on Tuesday that the party had gone on appeal, he complained that it had yet to receive the Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgement, despite applying for it. “We can’t even see the judgment. He needs to hand over the judgment to us so we can go to the Court of Appeal,” he said. He questioned why Judge Lifu heard arguments on other issues before determining whether the court had jurisdiction to entertain the case. Describing jurisdiction as the “live wire of every case”, Mr Amaechi, who was called to the Bar in 2024, argued that the judge should have determined that issue first. He recalled that the Supreme Court had sent the matter back to the Federal High Court to determine whether it had jurisdiction. The ADC candidate expressed surprise that the judge allowed parties to address him on other issues before resolving the jurisdiction question. Mr Amaechi, however, declined to discuss the judgment in detail because the matter was before the Court of Appeal. He maintained that the party would rely on its lawyers, whom he described as experienced Senior Advocates of Nigeria, to handle the appeal. The ADC candidate also dismissed suggestions of an internal disagreement within the party. He cited a video he claimed showed Nafiu Bala Gombe congratulating David Mark during the party’s leadership handover. Mr Amaechi accused the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) of trying to weaken the opposition because of its growing political activities. He alleged that the ruling party was more interested in distracting the opposition than addressing the country’s problems. “When we are campaigning, we are addressing issues. We are addressing the issue of the economy, social housing and security. They are not interested,” he said. Mr Amaechi also defended the ADC presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar’s, proposal to introduce a production-based fuel subsidy. He explained that the proposal differed from the previous arrangement, which subsidised imported petroleum products. According to him, the proposed policy would support domestic refineries by making crude oil available to them at a lower price. To illustrate the proposal, he said if crude is sold internationally for about N15,000, the government could supply it to domestic refineries for about N10,000. The N5,000 difference would constitute the subsidy. He argued that the arrangement would encourage local refining and support the Dangote refinery and several modular refineries. Mr Amaechi maintained that government support should go to businesses producing petroleum products locally rather than importers. He stressed that the ADC was not proposing a return to the previous subsidy arrangement. Instead, it wanted a system that supported domestic production. The former governor recalled that he initially supported fuel subsidy removal but disagreed with how the Tinubu administration implemented the policy. The former Rivers State governor also criticised the Tinubu administration over its borrowing and infrastructure spending. He claimed that the government had borrowed more than N143 trillion in about three years, arguing that previous administrations combined had not borrowed as much. “Why are you not bringing out the fact that, as we are talking today, you have borrowed over N143 trillion?” he asked. He questioned the cost of the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway, which he estimated at about N33 trillion, or $16 billion. Mr Amaechi also challenged the process for awarding the project. He alleged that the government selected a contractor to design and construct the road as work progressed. He claimed that “No drawing. No process of selecting a contractor. You choose the contractor who is there to design. So what they are doing is, as you move, you design.” He argued that the government should have prioritised the East-West Road, which previous administrations had begun constructing. According to him, completing the remaining section towards Calabar would benefit Cross River, Akwa Ibom, Rivers, Bayelsa, Edo and Delta states. Mr Amaechi estimated that completing the road would cost about N500 billion, compared with the much higher cost of the coastal highway. He further accused the president of choosing the coastal highway because of the benefits he would gain from the project. The former governor faulted the government’s economic priorities, arguing that it should focus on infrastructure that directly supports economic activities. He compared economic conditions under former President Muhammadu Buhari and President Bola Tinubu, urging Nigerians to assess their living conditions under both administrations. He also faulted the Tinubu administration’s record on the exchange rate and public spending, arguing that it had not justified its borrowing and infrastructure costs. Mr Amaechi expressed confidence in his own record in office and challenged Nigerians to assess the records of the presidential candidates and their running mates before making their choices. “President Tinubu, Vice President Atiku, myself, Shettima, we have all sat in government,” he said. He also asked Nigerians, “Can you do a referendum on us and choose who you want to vote for? That’s what you should be asking?”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）副总统候选人罗蒂米·阿马奇敦促党员保持冷静，尽管联邦高等法院的判决使该党领导层和总统初选选举失效，但仍应继续开展竞选活动。周二上午，他在Channels电视台《Sunrise Daily》节目中发表上述言论。阿马奇曾任 Rivers State 州长，他透露该党已对判决提出上诉，并相信上诉法院会作出公正裁决。他敦促支持者不要让这项裁决分散政治活动的精力。阿马奇说：“我们所做的是继续告诉支持者，每个人都应保持冷静并继续你们的竞选活动。”阿马奇曾在穆罕马杜·布哈里总统执政期间担任交通部长。ADC领导层争端始于该党前全国副主席纳菲乌·巴拉·贡贝对大卫·马领导层上台提出质疑。贡贝在阿布贾起诉该党及由大卫·马领导的执行机构，称该党前全国主席拉尔夫·恩沃苏辞职后，他有权领导该党。他还对该党2025年7月全国执行委员会会议提出质疑，该会议选出了由马领导的领导层。他请求法院宣布该会议及其决议无效，并禁止独立国家选举委员会（INEC）承认新领导层。今年4月，最高法院将争端发回联邦高等法院审理实体问题。最高法院没有裁定谁有权领导该党。彼得·利富法官于11月5日作出判决，裁定支持贡贝。他宣布该党第99次全国执行委员会会议及会上作出的决议无效。法官还否定了该党的初选，包括最终推选前副总统阿提库·阿布巴卡尔为总统候选人的流程。他指示INEC不得承认有争议会议的决议。尽管阿马奇周二透露该党已提出上诉，但他抱怨该党虽已申请，却仍未收到判决核证真实副本（CTC）。他说：“我们甚至连判决都看不到。他必须把判决交给我们，这样我们才能前往上诉法院。”他质疑利富法官为何在先审理其他问题的arguments后，才确定法院是否有权受理此案。阿马奇于2024年获得出庭律师资格，他把管辖权称为“每个案件的带电主线”，并认为法官应首先裁定这一问题。他提到，最高法院曾将此事发回联邦高等法院，以确定该法院是否拥有管辖权。ADC候选人对法官允许各方先就其他问题陈述意见、再解决管辖权问题表示惊讶。不过，由于案件正在上诉法院审理，阿马奇拒绝详细评论判决。他坚持该党将依靠其律师处理上诉，并称这些律师是经验丰富的高级出庭律师。ADC候选人还驳斥了党内存在分歧的说法。他援引了一段视频，称视频显示纳菲乌·巴拉·贡贝在党内领导权交接期间向大卫·马表示祝贺。阿马奇指责执政的进步大会党（APC）因反对派政治活动日益活跃而试图削弱反对派。他声称，执政党更 interested于分散反对派的注意力，而不是解决国家问题。他说：“我们开展竞选时，是在处理实际问题。我们正在处理经济、社会住房和安全问题。他们对此不感兴趣。”阿马奇还为ADC总统候选人阿提库·阿布巴卡尔提出的基于生产量的燃油补贴方案辩护。他解释说，该方案不同于以往对进口石油产品给予补贴的安排。据他介绍，拟议政策将通过以较低价格向国内炼油厂供应原油来支持国内炼油企业。为说明该方案，他表示，如果原油在国际市场上的售价约为N15,000，政府可以按约N10,000的价格供应给国内炼油厂。N5,000的差额将构成补贴。他认为，这一安排将促进本地炼油，并为Dangote炼油厂及多家模块化炼油厂提供支持。阿马奇坚持认为，政府支持应流向在本地生产石油产品的企业，而不是进口商。他强调，ADC并未提议恢复此前的补贴安排，而是希望建立一套支持国内生产的制度。这位前州长提到，他最初支持取消燃油补贴，但不认同蒂努布政府对这项政策的实施方式。这位前Rivers State州长还批评蒂努布政府的借款和基础设施支出。他声称，政府在大约三年内借款超过N143万亿，并认为此前各届政府合起来的借款额也没有这么多。他问：“为什么你们不把这一事实摆出来？今天我们谈论的时候，你们已经借了超过N143万亿？”他质疑拉各斯—卡拉巴尔沿海公路的成本，估计约为N33万亿，即160亿美元。阿马奇还对该项目的授标程序提出质疑。他声称，政府在工程推进过程中挑选承包商负责道路的设计和施工。他称：“没有图纸。没有选择承包商的程序。你挑选已经在那里负责设计的承包商。所以他们所做的就是，工程推进到哪里，你就设计到哪里。”他认为，政府本应优先建设东西道路，此前几届政府已开始修建该公路。据他估计，完成通往卡拉巴尔的剩余路段将惠及Cross River、Akwa Ibom、Rivers、Bayelsa、Edo和Delta各州。阿马奇估计，完成该道路将耗费约N5000亿，与成本高得多的沿海公路相比差距明显。他还进一步指控总统选择沿海公路，是因为总统将从中获益。这位前州长批评政府的经济优先事项，认为政府应专注于直接支持经济活动的基础设施。他比较了前总统穆罕马杜·布哈里与总统博拉·蒂努布执政时期的经济状况，敦促尼日利亚人评估两届政府下的生活状况。他还批评蒂努布政府在汇率和公共支出方面的表现，认为政府没有为其借款和基础设施成本作出合理说明。阿马奇对自己任内的执政记录表示有信心，并要求尼日利亚人在作出选择前评估总统候选人及其竞选搭档的执政记录。他说：“蒂努布总统、阿提库副总统、我本人、谢蒂马，我们都曾在政府任职。”他还问尼日利亚人：“你们能不能就我们举行一次公投，选出你们想投票支持的人？这才是你们应该问的问题，不是吗？”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: OPCON transfer unlikely during Trump's term, ex-US diplomat says
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Ambassador Steel calls for 'level playing field' for American firms in Korea The transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the United States to South Korea is unlikely to happen during the remaining two years of the Trump administration, former acting U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Joseph Yun said Tuesday. Yun said the two countries approach the issue differently, and that the Trump administration’s weakening authority in its final two years would make the transfer harder to complete.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 大使Steel呼吁为美国企业在韩国营造“公平竞争环境”。前美国驻韩国代大使Joseph Yun周二表示，在特朗普政府剩余的两年内，将战时作战指挥权（OPCON）从美国移交给韩国的可能性不大。Yun称，两国对这一问题的处理方式不同，而特朗普政府在最后两年里权威的削弱将使移交更难完成。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Ambassador Steel calls for 'level playing field' for American firms in Korea The transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from the United States to South Korea is unlikely to happen during the remaining two years of the Trump administration, former acting U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Joseph Yun said Tuesday. He said there is no consensus in Washington that conditions are met, adding that the same applies to Seoul’s nuclear submarine ambitions and its U.S. investment pledge. “There is no consensus in Washington, for example, that conditions are ready for wartime OPCON to be transferred,” Yun, who also served as the State Department’s special representative for North Korea policy, said during the second Korea-U.S. Diplomatic Forum, which he joined remotely from the U.S. “Conditions are factors. It is never going to be ready but that still remains an issue and I cannot imagine it moving very rapidly,” he added. His remarks came about a week after the U.S. midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of Congress, both House and Senate, and amid differences between the two allies over the timing and conditions of the transfer. South Korea wants to reclaim wartime OPCON by 2028, while the U.S. favors the first quarter of 2029. Yun said the two countries approach the issue differently, and that the Trump administration’s weakening authority in its final two years would make the transfer harder to complete. “The reality is that OPCON transfer is not a political issue in Washington. It is a technical issue,” he said. He also cautioned that regaining OPCON would inevitably reshape the alliance. “South Korean people want to have the OPCON back with no weakening of the alliance. That is impossible. There is no way Koreans can have OPCON back without weakening the alliance structure,” Yun said. “If the Korean capability is so great, a little bit of weakening of the alliance is OK ... But that's a political decision South Korea has to make.” He added, however, that there will be no withdrawal of U.S. troops from South Korea, as their presence enjoys bipartisan support, while stressing that the alliance would remain foundationally sound. Yun expected similarly slow progress on other bilateral negotiations that have been delayed amid friction between the allies, including nuclear and investment issues. “There is no consensus in Washington that Korea ought to have enrichment or nuclear submarines, so those things I find will be very difficult,” he said. Regarding South Korea's investment pledges, he said many Americans are “having trouble fundamentally grasping why there is a commitment for this huge amount of money in certain sectors in the United States,” and that he did not expect it to materialize within the next two years. Yun also ruled out a summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, saying Kim sees nothing to gain. “(Kim) has no interest in meeting with Trump. So I just don't think such a meeting would happen,” Yun said, noting that Pyongyang is no longer isolated, given its backing from Russia and China. The central question, according to Yun, is whether the Trump administration would acknowledge North Korea as a nuclear weapons state — a step he said would draw criticism from Democrats. “Supposing it did happen and Trump has nothing to say on denuclearization, I think the reception from the Democratic Party in the United States will be very poor. He would be heavily criticized, and because really denuclearization of North Korea will remain the central pillar of the U.S. policy, even though a lot of people will acknowledge that this is not something that could happen sooner,” he said. At the same forum, U.S. Ambassador to South Korea Michelle Steel emphasized the alliance’s dual role in security and economics. “Security and prosperity go together. Seventy-six years ago, we fought together to protect the young Republic of Korea. Since then, our economies and culture have become tightly intertwined. We are not only security allies but indispensable economic partners,” she said, adding the Korea-U.S. alliance should grow together. In an apparent reference to the dispute over U.S.-headquartered e-commerce company Coupang, Steel also called for fair treatment of American firms. “Of course, there is always room to do more as our two presidents committed," she said. "American companies in Korea deserve to compete on a level playing field that starts with understanding each other better.”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 前美国外交官称，特朗普任内不太可能完成军事维和行动移交
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh:
Steel大使呼吁为美国企业在韩国营造“公平竞争环境”

美国前驻韩国代理大使约瑟夫·云周二表示，在特朗普政府剩余的两年任期内，美国不太可能将战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交给韩国。他说，华盛顿尚未就是否具备移交条件达成共识，并指出首尔追求核潜艇及美国投资承诺的问题同样如此。

“例如，华盛顿对于是否已准备好移交战时作战指挥权并没有共识。”云在第二届韩美外交论坛期间说。他曾担任美国国务院对朝政策特别代表，并从美国远程参加论坛。“条件取决于各种因素。准备工作永远不可能完全就绪，但这仍是一个悬而未决的问题，我无法想象推进速度会有多快。”他补充说。

他的这番言论发表在美国中期选举约一周之后。民主党在此次选举中赢得国会参众两院的控制权，而美韩两个盟友对于移交的时间和条件也存有分歧。韩国希望在2028年前收回战时作战指挥权，美国则主张推迟至2029年第一季度。云说，两国看待这一问题的方式不同，而特朗普政府最后两年权威的削弱将使移交更难完成。

“现实情况是，移交作战指挥权在华盛顿并非政治问题，而是技术问题。”他说。他还警告，收回作战指挥权必然重塑美韩同盟关系。

“韩国人民希望在不削弱同盟关系的情况下收回作战指挥权，这是不可能的。韩国人不可能在不让同盟架构 weakened 的情况下收回作战指挥权。”云说，“如果韩方的能力足够强大，同盟关系略微削弱也可以接受……但这是韩国必须作出的政治决定。”不过，他也强调，美国不会从韩国撤军，因为美军驻韩得到两党支持，同时强调同盟关系的根基依然稳固。

云预计，由于美韩之间摩擦不断，包括核问题和投资问题在内的其他双边谈判也不会取得太大进展。“华盛顿对于韩国是否应当拥有核浓缩能力或核潜艇没有共识，因此我认为，这些事情会非常难推进。”他说。

谈及韩国作出的投资承诺，云表示，许多美国人“从根本上难以理解，为何美国某些行业会承诺投入如此巨额资金”，并称他不期待这些承诺能在未来两年内兑现。

云还排除了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普与朝鲜领导人金正恩举行峰会的可能性，称金正恩认为会面没有任何好处。

“（金正恩）没有兴趣与特朗普会面。因此，我认为这种会面不会发生。”云说，并指出，在俄罗斯和中国支持朝鲜的情况下，平壤已不再受到孤立。

据云所述，核心问题是特朗普政府是否愿意承认朝鲜为核武国家。他表示，此举将招致民主党人的批评。

“假设特朗普真的这样做，却对无核化只字不提，我认为美国民主党的反应会非常糟糕。他将受到严厉批评，因为朝鲜无核化仍将是美国政策的核心支柱，尽管许多人会承认这不可能在较短时间内实现。”他说。

在同一场论坛上，美国驻韩国大使米歇尔·steel强调，同盟关系在安全和经济两方面发挥着双重作用。

“安全与繁荣密不可分。76年前，我们并肩作战，保护年轻的大韩民国。此后，我们的经济和文化已紧密交织。我们不仅是安全盟友，也是不可或缺的经济伙伴。”她说，并强调韩美同盟应当共同发展。

显然是在影射围绕美国总部电商企业Coupang的争议，Steel还呼吁为美国企业提供公平待遇。

“当然，正如两国总统所承诺的那样，我们始终还有更多工作要做。”她说，“在韩国的美国企业应当获得公平竞争的环境，而这一切应从更好地相互理解开始。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: 'Honey trap': Nvidia spy scandal puts Korea on alert
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a Chinese woman accused of spying for Beijing has emerged as a significant national security concern for the United States. The scandal erupted amid an intensifying race between the U.S. and China for global leadership in artificial intelligence (AI).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被控为北京从事间谍活动的中国女子有染一事，已成为美国重大的国家安全关切。这场丑闻爆发之际，美国与中国争夺人工智能全球领导权的竞赛正日益激烈。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a Chinese woman accused of spying for Beijing has emerged as a significant national security concern for the United States. According to U.S. intelligence officials, Alice Huang, who worked as a business executive at Singapore-based data center firm Megaspeed in 2023, allegedly collected intelligence and passed it on to China. The scandal erupted amid an intensifying race between the U.S. and China for global leadership in artificial intelligence (AI). Yoo Seong-ok, a retired intelligence official who previously served as president of the Institute for National Security Strategy during his career at the National Intelligence Service (NIS), warned that South Korea is equally vulnerable to espionage operations by foreign intelligence agencies seeking to steal critical technologies. “Chinese [or] North Korean spies — or both — could have used, or may still be using, a similar honey trap to the one allegedly used against Nvidia CEO Huang to gather confidential information and pass it on to their intelligence agencies,” he told The Korea Times. More significantly, Yoo suggested that sensitive information about Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and their technologies may already have been passed to Chinese rivals, given Nvidia’s close business ties with the two Korean chipmakers. Jensen Huang has held several meetings under what has been dubbed the “AI buddy alliance” with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong and SK hynix Chairman Chey Tae-won, both in South Korea and the United States. “According to media reports, the Nvidia CEO and Alice Huang are said to have been intimate. He could have unconsciously shared details of his meetings with Korean business leaders when talking to the woman. Who knows?” Yoo said. South Korea has ample reason to be a target of foreign espionage. Its manufacturers play a pivotal role in the global AI industry, supplying the critical components that power AI computing. Samsung Electronics and SK hynix dominate the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) market, together accounting for more than 80 percent of global market share. Their strategic importance to the global AI supply chain makes both companies, as well as their top executives, potential targets of foreign intelligence operations. In recent years, a clear trend has emerged across the global intelligence community: Countries are strengthening their intelligence capabilities to address evolving security challenges. The European Commission is considering establishing an intelligence body under President Ursula von der Leyen to respond to technological and geopolitical challenges in the AI era. Japan has taken similar steps, undertaking a national security and intelligence overhaul since Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi took office. The country has also established a National Intelligence Council to oversee its intelligence strategy. In August, the Defense Counterintelligence Command was disbanded, more than a year after its involvement in former President Yoon Suk Yeol’s Dec. 3, 2024, martial law declaration. The NIS’ counterintelligence capabilities have also been significantly weakened since January 2024, when its authority to detect and investigate espionage cases was transferred to the police. “Since then, not a single North Korean spy has been apprehended. This suggests that the country is doing virtually nothing about counterintelligence,” Yoo said. Jang shared similar concerns. He noted that countries around the world have intensified intelligence gathering and analysis activities to cope with the changing security environment. “Countries such as China, Russia and North Korea have stepped up espionage operations to obtain critical technologies and intelligence. Given this situation, what South Korea has done makes little sense,” he said. Beyond semiconductors, Jang warned that other strategic sectors, particularly the defense industry, are increasingly becoming targets of foreign espionage. He stressed that South Korea must urgently strengthen its counterintelligence capabilities to protect its strategic technologies, industrial assets and national security
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: “蜜 trap”风波：Nvidia间谍丑闻令韩国提高警惕
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋与一名被指控为北京从事间谍活动的中国女子的暧昧关系，已成为美国的一项重大国家安全关切。据美国情报官员透露，Alice Huang曾于2023年在总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业Megaspeed担任业务主管，据称她收集情报并将其传递给中国。这场丑闻正值美国与中国竞逐全球人工智能领导地位之际爆发。曾任国家情报院院长的退休情报官员 Yoo Seong-ok 在其国家情报院（NIS）任职期间警告称，韩国同样容易受到外国情报机构的间谍活动渗透，这些机构意图窃取关键技术。他告诉《韩国时报》：“中国或朝鲜间谍，或两者都有，可能曾使用、或至今仍在使用与据称针对Nvidia首席执行官黄仁勋所设的类似的蜜罐，以收集机密信息并传递给各自的情报机构。”更值得注意的是，Yoo指出，鉴于Nvidia与韩国两家芯片制造商关系密切，有关Samsung Electronics、SK hynix及其技术的敏感信息可能已经传递给中国的竞争对手。黄仁勋曾以被称为“AI伙伴联盟”的机制，多次与Samsung Electronics董事长李在镕和SK hynix董事长崔泰源会面，会面地点包括韩国和美国。Yoo说：“据媒体报道，Nvidia首席执行官与Alice Huang关系亲密。他在与该女子交谈时，可能无意中分享了与韩国商界领袖会面的细节。谁知道呢？”韩国有充分理由成为外国间谍活动的目标。其制造企业在全球人工智能产业中发挥关键作用，为人工智能计算提供核心组件。Samsung Electronics和SK hynix主导高带宽存储器（HBM）市场，合计占全球市场份额的80%以上。两家公司对全球人工智能供应链具有战略重要性，因此它们及其最高管理层都可能成为外国情报行动的目标。近年来，全球情报界已呈现出明显趋势：各国正加强情报能力，以应对不断演变的安全挑战。欧盟委员会正考虑在Ursula von der Leyen总统领导下设立一个情报机构，以应对人工智能时代的技术和地缘政治挑战。日本也采取了类似措施，自首相Sanae Takaichi上任以来推进国家安全和情报体系改革。该国还成立了国家情报委员会，负责监督其情报战略。今年8月，国防反情报司令部被解散；此前一年多前，该机构曾介入前总统Yoon Suk Yeol于2024年12月3日宣布戒严一事。自2024年1月将侦查和调查间谍案件的权限移交给警方后，NIS的反情报能力也明显削弱。Yoo说：“从那以后，没有一名朝鲜间谍被抓捕。这表明，该国在反情报方面几乎没有采取任何行动。”Jang表达了类似担忧。他指出，为应对不断变化的安全环境，世界各国都在加强情报收集和分析活动。他说：“中国、俄罗斯和朝鲜等国家加大了间谍行动力度，以获取关键技术和情报。在这种情况下，韩国采取的做法很难说得通。”Jang还警告称，半导体以外的其他战略部门，尤其是国防工业，正日益成为外国间谍活动的目标。他强调，韩国必须紧急加强反情报能力，以保护其战略技术、产业资产和国家安全

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Participants from Mexico to Uzbekistan immerse themselves in language workshops, traditional cuisine, classic poetry Ninety-two students and teachers from 30 countries wrapped up a five-day immersive camp hosted by the Ministry of Education. A group of 92 secondary school students and teachers from 30 countries completed a five-day immersive journey into Korean language and culture, concluding a nationwide youth camp organized by the Ministry of Education. To mark the end of the 2026 International Korean Education Youth Camp, the ministry and the International Korean Education Foundation held a celebratory ceremony Tuesday evening at Sarangjae, a traditional guest house on the National Assembly grounds in Seoul. Running from Friday to Tuesday across Seoul and Incheon, the camp brought together students enrolled in Korean language classes at their home schools. This year’s cohort welcomed its first-ever participant from Mexico, alongside students from Malaysia and Uzbekistan who were recently featured in a KBS documentary aired on Hangeul Day, the Oct. 9 national holiday celebrating the Korean alphabet. During the program, participants engaged in level-tailored Korean lessons leveraging artificial intelligence. Beyond the classroom, they explored historic landmarks, including Gyeongbok Palace, the main royal palace of the 1392-1910 Joseon Dynasty, and sampled iconic street foods like "tteokbokki," Korea’s signature spicy simmered rice cakes. The students also studied "Sejong 1446" — a musical depicting King Sejong’s 15th-century creation of Hangeul — and prepared a live performance for the closing ceremony. The camp featured a literature contest where students recited and interpreted works from Korean school textbooks, with Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin on hand to present awards to the top three finalists. Phung Khanh Linh of Vietnam presented Yi Chong-jun’s classic 1977 short story “The Snowy Road," a textbook staple exploring themes of maternal sacrifice and unpayable filial debt through the memory of a mother walking her son to the bus along a snow-covered mountain path. Siriwardena Chanthuki Thathyana of Sri Lanka recited Hwang Ji-u’s famous 1997 poem “While Waiting for You," a staple of Korean literature that frames waiting not as passive resignation, but as an active, urgent journey of love toward an inevitable arrival. Prasista Zharafah Mulia of Indonesia performed Oh Sae-young’s lyric poem “Like a Star, Like a Flower," which uses vivid natural imagery to reflect on living a pure, illuminating life despite transient worldly hardship. Reflecting on her selection, the Sri Lankan student shared that she viewed the "you" in Hwang's poem as representing Korea itself — explaining that rather than passively waiting for a dream to materialize, she felt inspired to actively pursue and create her own opportunities. Launched in 2019 as a regional exchange with Southeast Asian nations, the program expanded globally in 2022 to welcome Korean language learners worldwide. “Meeting peers from around the world here in Korea will serve as powerful motivation for these students to continue their language journey,” Choi said. “I hope they grow into global leaders who maintain strong ties with Korea.” This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 来自30个国家的学生齐聚首尔学习韩语和韩国文化
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 来自墨西哥至乌兹别克斯坦等国的参与者沉浸式学习韩语课程、传统美食和经典诗歌。由教育部主办的为期五天的沉浸式夏令营落下帷幕，来自30个国家的92名中学生和教师完成了为期五天的韩国语言与文化沉浸体验，结束了教育部组织的全国青少年夏令营。为纪念2026年国际韩国教育青少年夏令营闭幕，教育部与国际韩国教育基金会于周二晚上在首尔国会议事堂 grounds 内的传统客栈 Sarangjae 举行庆祝仪式。夏令营从周五持续至周二，贯穿首尔和仁川，吸引了各国本土学校韩语课程的学生参加。今年的参与者中首次欢迎了来自墨西哥的学员，此外还有来自马来西亚和乌兹别克斯坦的学生；这些学生近期出现在 KBS 于10月9日韩文日这一庆祝韩文字母的韩国国庆日播出的纪录片中。活动期间，参与者参加了根据不同水平设计的韩语课程，并利用人工智能开展学习。课堂之外，他们参观了历史遗迹，包括1392年至1910年朝鲜王朝的主要王宫景福宫，还品尝了韩式辣炒年糕等韩国代表性街头小吃，以“떡볶이”（“韩式辣炒年糕”）为代表。学生们还学习了音乐剧《世宗1446》，该剧描绘了世宗大王于15世纪创制训民正音（韩文）的历史，并为闭幕式准备了一场现场演出。夏令营还举办了文学比赛，学生们诵读并解读韩国学校教科书中的作品，教育部长崔教振现场为决赛前三名颁奖。越南的 Phung Khanh Linh 讲解了李忠俊1977年的经典短篇小说《雪路》，这篇课文常见作品通过儿子在积雪覆盖的山路上走向公交车站的母亲这一回忆，探讨母爱牺牲与无法偿还的孝亲之恩等主题。斯里兰卡的 Siriwardena Chanthuki Thathyana 诵读了黄智宇1997年的著名诗作《在等待你的日子里》，这首作品是韩国文学的经典，将等待塑造成不是被动 resignation，而是通向必然重逢的积极而急迫的爱之旅。印度尼西亚的 Prasista Zharafah Mulia 表演了吴世永的抒情诗《如星，如花》，以生动的自然意象反思如何在短暂的世界苦难中过上纯净、照亮他人的生活。回顾自己入选的原因，斯里兰卡学生表示，她把黄智宇诗中的“你”理解为韩国本身，并解释说，梦想不会被动地等待实现，这促使她受到启发，主动追求并创造属于自己的机会。该项目于2019年作为与东南亚国家之间的区域交流项目启动，2022年扩大至全球范围，迎来世界各地的韩语学习者。崔教振表示：“这些学生在这里与世界各地的同龄人相会，将成为他们继续学习语言的强大动力。”“我希望他们成长为与韩国保持密切联系的全球领袖。”本文在生成式人工智能的协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Korean Army has temporarily grounded its Apache military helicopters as U.S. authorities began inspections on the fleet over a possible malfunction of their transmission system, an Army official said Tuesday. The grounding of the AH-64E Apache Guardian attack helicopters has been in place since early October, after the Army received a safety advisory from the U.S. military regarding the transmission component, Army spokesperson Capt. Bae Seok-jin said in a press briefing. "As a safety precaution, the Army temporarily grounded the fleet in early October (for the U.S. side) to conduct technical inspections in phases," Bae said. "Operations will resume sequentially based on the inspection results." While routine training flights are paused during the grounding, the helicopters usually stand ready for an immediate operational launch in the event of a contingency. "There are currently no issues with our readiness or operational posture," the Army spokesperson added. Manufactured by Boeing, the Apache helicopters serve as a key asset for air-to-ground defense for the Korean military, which currently operates a fleet of 36 units. The U.S. Army issued a statement early last month on the temporary pause of flight operations for Apache helicopters, citing technical assessments of their transmission systems. The inspections follow an August crash of an Apache helicopter in Texas that killed two U.S. soldiers. The same model also went down during a patrol operation near the Strait of Hormuz in June for reasons that have not been identified. Other countries operating the Apache chopper appear to be taking the same step. Taiwan also grounded the helicopters last month, local media have reported
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 美国检查疑似缺陷期间，军方暂时停飞阿帕奇直升机
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国陆军已临时停飞其阿帕奇军用直升机；美国当局开始检查该机队，原因是其 transmission system 可能存在故障。陆军官员周二表示。陆军发言人 Bae Seok-jin 上尉在新闻发布会上说，自10月初起，AH-64E“阿帕奇守卫者”攻击直升机便处于停飞状态，此前陆军收到了美国军方就 transmission 部件发布的安全警示。Bae说：“作为安全预防措施，陆军于10月初临时停飞该机队，以便美方分阶段进行技术检查。各项行动将根据检查结果依次恢复。”停飞期间，例行训练飞行暂停，但这些直升机通常仍随时待命，一旦发生突发情况即可立即投入行动。陆军发言人补充说：“我们目前的战备状态和作战部署没有问题。”这些阿帕奇直升机由波音制造，是韩国军队实施对地防御的重要装备；韩国目前运营一支由36架该型直升机组成的机队。美国陆军上月早些时候曾就阿帕奇直升机暂停飞行行动发表声明，称其依据是对 transmission systems 的技术评估。此次检查是在8月得克萨斯州发生一架阿帕奇直升机坠毁事故后进行的，事故造成两名美军士兵死亡。同款直升机6月也在霍尔木兹海峡附近执行巡逻任务时坠毁，原因尚未查明。据当地媒体报道，其他运营阿帕奇直升机的国家似乎也在采取同样措施。台湾上月也让这些直升机停飞。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: The share of Korea's top 10 exporters in the country's total outbound shipments rose sharply in the third quarter from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, driven by strong demand for semiconductors and other technology products. Exports by the top 10 companies accounted for 60.9 percent of total exports in the July-September period, up from 40.5 percent a year earlier, according to data compiled by the Ministry of Data and Statistics. The country's top 100 exporters accounted for 79.4 percent of total exports in the third quarter, up from 67.9 percent a year earlier. Korea's total exports came to $318.6 billion in the third quarter, an increase of 72.3 percent on-year. By company size, exports by conglomerates more than doubled to $248.6 billion, while those by medium-sized companies rose 12.8 percent to $36.9 billion. Exports by small enterprises also gained a solid 10.7 percent to $32.7 billion. By industry, exports by the mining and manufacturing sector surged 82.8 percent to $291.5 billion. Within the sector, the electronics industry, including chips, saw its exports soar 143.6 percent to $206 billion. Exports by the wholesale and retail sector rose 5.1 percent to $20 billion

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国民俗村的一项热门景点近日受到关注。演员装扮成鬼怪训斥调皮捣蛋的孩子，但有人投诉后，当地政府开始考虑调查是否存在虐待儿童的问题。京畿道龙仁市周一表示，计划于本月晚些时候携同儿童福利专家和警方前往韩国民俗村，调查这项所谓的“鬼怪管教”活动是如何运作的。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A popular attraction at the Korean Folk Village, where actors dressed as ghosts discipline misbehaving children, has come under scrutiny after complaints prompted the local government to consider investigating possible child abuse. The move has instead sparked controversy, with many online commenters arguing that parents who bring their children to the attraction, rather than the folk village itself, should be held responsible if the experience is deemed abusive. Yongin City, Gyeonggi Province, said Monday that it plans to visit the Korean Folk Village later this month with child welfare experts and police to examine how the so-called "ghost discipline" event is operated. Every autumn, the folk village hosts an event featuring actors dressed as traditional Korean ghosts, including the nine-tailed fox and the virgin ghost. More recently, a segment dubbed "ghost discipline," in which the performers scold and discipline children on behalf of their parents, has gained popularity through word of mouth. However, the event has drawn criticism from some visitors, who argue that it exposes children to excessive fear and could leave them traumatized. Complaints have also been filed with authorities. According to the city, nine complaints concerning the event have been submitted through the government's online civil petition system. Police have also reportedly received a request to look into a possible case of child abuse. The city said it would coordinate with the folk village to arrange a visit and assess the event's operations. The planned investigation has itself drawn criticism online, with many saying both the complaints against the attraction and the city's response are excessive. They argued that interpreting the event as a potential violation of child protection laws was an overreach. "If ghost discipline is really a problem, shouldn't the parents who bring their children there be investigated for child abuse, rather than the ghosts (or the folk village)?" one online commenter wrote sarcastically. The Korean Folk Village will continue the ghost discipline event through Sunday, the final day of its extended nighttime opening hours this month. The attraction said it would consider revising the event next year after reviewing the findings of the inspection and gathering feedback. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国民俗村一项颇受欢迎的游览项目近日受到审视。演员装扮成鬼怪惩戒调皮不听话的孩子，但投诉事件促使地方政府考虑调查该项目是否可能存在虐待儿童行为。此举反而引发争议，许多网络评论者认为，如果这种体验被认定为虐待儿童，那么应追究把孩子带到该项目的家长，而不是民俗村本身。京畿龙仁市周一表示，计划于本月晚些时候与儿童福利专家和警方一同前往韩国民俗村，调查这项所谓的“鬼怪惩戒”活动是如何运作的。每年秋季，民俗村都会举办一项活动，由演员装扮成传统韩国鬼怪，包括九尾狐和女鬼。近来，一段被称为“鬼怪惩戒”的表演因口碑传播而走红，表演者代替家长斥责并惩戒孩子。然而，这项活动也遭到部分游客批评，他们认为这会让儿童陷入过度恐惧，并可能给他们留下心理创伤。当局也收到了相关投诉。据该市称，政府在线公民请愿系统已收到9起有关该活动的投诉。警方据称也收到了一项调查可能存在虐待儿童案件的请求。该市表示，将与民俗村协调安排实地调查，并评估活动的运营情况。拟进行的调查本身也在网上遭到批评，许多人认为，针对该游览项目的投诉和市政府的回应都过于夸张。他们认为，将该活动解读为可能违反儿童保护法律属于过度干预。一名网络评论者讽刺地写道：“如果‘鬼怪惩戒’真是个问题，难道不该调查那些带孩子去那里的家长，指控他们虐待儿童，而不是鬼怪（或民俗村）吗？”韩国民俗村将在本周日继续举办鬼怪惩戒活动；周日本月延长夜间开放时间的最后一天。该游览项目表示，在审查调查结果并收集反馈后，将考虑明年修改这项活动。本文来自《韩国时报》的姊妹报《韩民族日报》，由生成式人工智能系统翻译并经《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 议会记录显示，执政党和小党议员共同提出一项法案，允许居住在海外的韩国人通过电子方式投票，旨在提高投票便利性。这项法案由执政的韩国民主党的金永浩议员牵头，于周五提出，并由该党另外11名议员以及重建韩国党的金俊亨议员共同联署。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A bill allowing Koreans living overseas to vote electronically has been proposed by ruling and minor party lawmakers, parliamentary records showed Tuesday, in a move aimed at improving voting accessibility. The proposed revision to the Public Official Election Act would allow voters to cast their ballots in presidential and parliamentary elections without having to visit designated polling stations, according to the National Assembly's online bill information system. The bill, led by Rep. Kim Young-ho of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), was proposed Friday, co-sponsored by 11 other DPK lawmakers and Rep. Kim Joon-hyung of the minor Rebuilding Korea Party. By introducing an electronic voting system operated by the National Election Commission (NEC), the bill seeks to address challenges faced by Koreans living far from overseas polling stations. The bill also includes measures to protect voter privacy and prevent unauthorized access to voting records amid concerns over hacking and proxy voting. Rep. Jang Dong-hyeok, leader of the main opposition People Power Party, has raised questions over the reliability of electronic voting, pointing out the unprecedented shortage of ballots reported during the June 3 local elections. "How can they propose electronic voting when we cannot even trust votes cast at polling stations? Is it in the DPK's genes to go against the public opinion?" Jang wrote in a Facebook post. A special counsel team, launched in early September, has been investigating various suspected irregularities involving the NEC to look mainly into what led to the ballot shortages
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 民主党籍议员提议立法，允许海外韩国人电子投票
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 议会记录显示，执政党及小党议员于星期二提议一项法案，允许居住在海外的韩国人通过电子方式投票，旨在提高投票便利性。据国民议会在线法案信息系统介绍，拟议修订《公职人员选举法》，允许选民在总统选举和议会选举中投票，而无须前往指定投票站。该法案由执政的朝鲜民主党（DPK）议员Kim Young-ho领衔，于星期五提出，并由另外11名DPK议员及小党重建韩国党议员Kim Joon-hyung共同联署。法案引入由国家选举委员会（NEC）运营的电子投票系统，旨在解决居住在远离海外投票站地区的韩国人面临的困难。鉴于人们担心黑客攻击和委托投票，法案还纳入保护选民隐私、防止未经授权访问投票记录的措施。主要反对党人民权力党党首Jang Dong-hyeok对电子投票的可靠性提出质疑，并指出今年6月3日地方选举期间曾出现前所未有的选票短缺现象。Jang在Facebook帖子中写道：“当我们连投票站投出的选票都无法信任时，他们怎么能提议电子投票？违逆公众意愿难道是DPK的一贯作风吗？”一个于9月初成立的特别律师团队正在调查涉及NEC的多项疑似违规行为，重点查清选票短缺的起因

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title: Korea's export boom masks widening gap between large, small firms
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary: While shipments soared, the number of exporting firms remained virtually unchanged, suggesting that the benefits of the export boom have yet to spread across the business sector. The export growth rate for large corporations was nearly 10 times that of smaller firms. Despite soaring export value, the number of exporting firms edged up just 0.3 percent year-on-year to 69,988.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.summary_zh: 尽管出货量激增，出口企业数量却几乎没有变化，这表明出口繁荣带来的好处尚未惠及整个商业领域。大型企业的出口增长率接近小型企业的10倍。尽管出口额大幅攀升，出口企业数量同比仅微增0.3%，达到69,988家。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body: While shipments soared, the number of exporting firms remained virtually unchanged, suggesting that the benefits of the export boom have yet to spread across the business sector. According to preliminary trade statistics released by the Ministry of Data and Statistics and the Korea Customs Service, exports jumped 72.3 percent year-on-year to $318.6 billion in the third quarter. Imports rose 25 percent to $203.1 billion. Export growth accelerated from 38.4 percent in the first quarter of this year and 57.2 percent in the second. “Driven by the semiconductor sector, export value and export growth reached record highs,” a ministry official said. However, the figures revealed a stark disparity in export performance by company size. Exports by large corporations more than doubled to $248.6 billion, up 103.5 percent from a year earlier. In contrast, exports by medium-sized companies rose 12.8 percent to $36.9 billion, while those by smaller enterprises increased 10.7 percent to $32.7 billion. The export growth rate for large corporations was nearly 10 times that of smaller firms. The concentration of exports among a handful of companies also intensified. The top 10 exporters accounted for 60.9 percent of total shipments, up 20.3 percentage points from 40.5 percent a year earlier. Their share climbed from 50.1 percent in the first quarter to 55.3 percent in the second. The top 100 exporters accounted for 79.4 percent of shipments, up 11.5 percentage points year-on-year, meaning nearly 80 percent of Korea’s exports came from just 100 companies. Despite soaring export value, the number of exporting firms edged up just 0.3 percent year-on-year to 69,988. Growth in the number of exporters slowed from 2.5 percent in the first quarter and 2 percent in the second. Exports of electrical and electronic products, including semiconductors, soared 143.6 percent to $206 billion, while shipments of transportation equipment declined 1.2 percent. Concerns over Korea’s reliance on semiconductors were also reflected in the country’s economic outlook for next year. The Korea Institute of Finance projected Tuesday that the economy would grow 3.1 percent in 2027, supported by strong semiconductor exports. Although down from an estimated 3.8 percent this year, growth is expected to remain robust, driven by expanding facility investment and recovering private consumption. However, the institute cautioned that heavy dependence on semiconductors could leave the economy vulnerable to shifts in artificial intelligence (AI) investment, with any slowdown potentially affecting exports, investment and consumption
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.title_zh: 韩国出口繁荣掩盖了大中小企业之间日益扩大的差距
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/oth.body_zh: 尽管出口额飙升，出口企业数量却几乎未变，这表明出口繁荣带来的好处尚未惠及整个商业部门。根据数据与统计部以及韩国海关发布的初步贸易统计数据显示，第三季度出口额同比增长72.3%，达到3186亿美元；进口额增长25%，达到2031亿美元。出口增速较今年第一季度的38.4%和第二季度的57.2%进一步加快。一位部级官员表示：“在半导体行业的带动下，出口额和出口增速均创下历史新高。”然而，相关数据也反映出不同规模企业出口表现的显著差距。大型企业的出口额增长一倍以上，达到2486亿美元，较上年同期增长103.5%；相比之下，中型企业的出口额增长12.8%，达到369亿美元，小型企业的出口额则增长10.7%，达到327亿美元。大型企业的出口增速接近小型企业的10倍。出口集中在少数企业的情况也有所加剧。前十大出口企业占出口总额的60.9%，较上年同期的40.5%提高了20.3个百分点；其占比从第一季度的50.1%升至第二季度的55.3%。前一百大出口企业占出口总额的79.4%，同比提高11.5个百分点，这意味着韩国近80%的出口来自仅100家公司。尽管出口额飙升，出口企业数量同比仅小幅增长0.3%，达到69,988家。出口企业数量增速从第一季度的2.5%和第二季度的2%放缓。包括半导体在内的电气电子产品出口额飙升143.6%，达到2060亿美元，而运输设备出口额下降1.2%。韩国对半导体的依赖所引发的担忧，也反映在该国明年的经济前景中。韩国金融研究所周二预计，在强劲的半导体出口带动下，韩国经济将在2027年增长3.1%。尽管这一增速低于今年预计的3.8%，但随着设施投资扩大和私人消费复苏，预计经济仍将保持强劲增长。不过，该研究所警告称，过度依赖半导体可能使经济在人工智能（AI）投资发生变化时变得脆弱，任何放缓都可能影响出口、投资和消费

Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the rejection in a statement carried by the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA).
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜星期二驳回了联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯近期提出的恢复韩朝对话、缓和9月边境附近地雷爆炸后紧张局势的呼吁，并指责他“持偏见且不负责任”。朝鲜领导人金正恩权势强大的妹妹金与正通过朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）播发的声明中作出了这一回应。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea on Tuesday rejected U.N. Secretary-General Antonio Guterres' recent call to resume inter-Korean dialogue to ease tensions following September's mine blast near the border, accusing him of being "prejudiced and irresponsible." Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the rejection in a statement carried by the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). Last week, the U.N. chief called for restoring communication channels between South and North Korea amid concerns over a potential escalation of tensions following the Sept. 21 explosion inside the Demilitarized Zone. That incident, blamed on mines planted by the North, wounded three South Korean soldiers, two of them seriously. "I express my regret over the fact that the top official of the U.N., which regards impartiality and objectivity as its lifeline, took such prejudiced and irresponsible attitude as echoing the ROK's unilateral and provocative sophism," Kim said. ROK is short for the Republic of Korea, South Korea's official name. She also accused the U.N. chief of "doubling-dealing," saying he had denounced North Korea's exercise of its sovereign rights as a "provocation" and "threat," while "persistently keeping mum about the heinous military hysteria of the U.S. and its allies." "Such ignorant and irresolute attitude of the U.N. secretary-general serves as a main factor of gradually pushing the U.N. into a state of its malfunction," she said. In early October, a joint investigation by South Korea's military and the U.N. Command concluded that the explosion was caused by antipersonnel mines deliberately planted by North Korea south of the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). North Korea has denied responsibility for the incident, dismissing Seoul's findings as "fabricated" and an attempt to impede the North's border fortification work. In a letter dated Oct. 22, South Korea raised the incident with the U.N. Security Council, calling on Pyongyang to apologize, remove the mines and take steps to prevent a recurrence. In response, the North also sent its own letter, accusing Seoul of fabricating the mine blast. In Tuesday's statement, she reiterated the North's border fortification work "never violates the U.N. Charter and the international laws as it is the most righteous, reasonable and regular exercise of its right to self-defense." "If the reckless military provocations of the ROK gangsters lead to an undesirable incident in the southern border area, U.N. Secretary-General Guterres will never be free from the blame for it," she said, concluding her statement
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 地雷爆炸后，朝鲜拒绝联合国秘书长关于朝韩对话的呼吁
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 朝鲜周二拒绝了联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯近期提出的恢复朝韩对话、缓和9月边境附近地雷爆炸后紧张局势的呼吁，并指责他“带有偏见且不负责任”。朝鲜领导人金正恩权势显赫的妹妹金与正通过朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）发表的声明中作出上述表态。上周，这位联合国 chief 因担忧9月21日非军事区（DMZ）内爆炸事件可能加剧紧张局势，呼吁恢复韩国与朝鲜之间的沟通渠道。该事件被归咎于朝鲜埋设的地雷，造成3名韩国士兵受伤，其中2人伤势严重。金说：“我对联合国最高官员采取如此带有偏见且不负责任的态度表示遗憾；联合国将公正性和客观性视为生命线，却附和韩国方面的单方面和挑衅性诡辩。”ROK是Republic of Korea的缩写，即韩国的正式名称。她还指责联合国 chief“两面三刀”，称他谴责朝鲜行使主权权利是“挑衅”和“威胁”，却“始终对美军及其盟友骇人的军事歇斯底里三缄其口”。她说：“联合国秘书长这种无知且优柔寡断的态度，是逐渐把联合国推入失灵状态的主要因素之一。”10月初，韩国军方与联合国军司令部联合调查后认定，爆炸是由朝鲜蓄意在军事分界线（MDL）以南埋设的人杀伤雷所致。朝鲜否认对事件负责，称首尔的调查结果“捏造”，并称这是企图阻碍朝鲜的边境加固工作。在一封日期为10月22日的信函中，韩国向联合国安理会提出该事件，要求平壤道歉、清除地雷并采取措施防止事件再次发生。作为回应，朝鲜也致函指责首尔捏造了地雷爆炸事件。她在周二发表的声明中重申，朝鲜的边境加固工作“从未违反《联合国宪章》和国际法，因为这是其行使自卫权最正当、合理和常规的举措”。她说：“如果韩国暴徒的鲁莽军事挑衅导致南部边境地区发生不良事件，联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯将永远无法推卸责任。”她以此结束声明……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.title: Korea Times Translation Awards bring Korean literature closer to world readers
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.summary: The Korea Times honored five winning translators during the 57th Modern Korean Literature Translation Awards ceremony held in Seoul Tuesday, celebrating their roles in connecting Korean writers with global readers as artificial intelligence raises new questions about the future of literary translation. The Korea Times President-Publisher Oh Young-jin said the growing international reach of Korean culture coincides with a technological upheaval that demands reflection on what makes literature meaningful.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.summary_zh: 《韩国时报》星期二在首尔举行的第57届现代韩国文学翻译奖颁奖仪式上表彰了五位获奖译者。在人工智能引发有关文学翻译未来的新疑问之际，此次颁奖礼旨在彰显这些译者连接韩国作家与全球读者的作用。《韩国时报》总裁兼出版人Oh Young-jin表示，韩国文化国际影响力的日益提升恰逢一场技术巨变，这要求人们重新审视文学何以具有意义。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.body: The Korea Times honored five winning translators during the 57th Modern Korean Literature Translation Awards ceremony held in Seoul Tuesday, celebrating their roles in connecting Korean writers with global readers as artificial intelligence raises new questions about the future of literary translation. Held at the Korea Press Center in Seoul, the ceremony brought together translators, cultural officials and publishing representatives, with speakers emphasizing the human sensitivity needed to carry a work’s emotional depth across languages. The awards are organized by The Korea Times and supported by the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and KB Financial Group. The Korea Times President-Publisher Oh Young-jin said the growing international reach of Korean culture coincides with a technological upheaval that demands reflection on what makes literature meaningful. “In this age when machines write, how can we preserve the emotional resonance, imagination and cultural depth that only humans can convey?” Oh said. “How we carry forward the essential beauty of literature while embracing technological progress is an urgent challenge humanity must address,” he said, pledging that the newspaper would work alongside the winners to seek answers, drawing on the competition’s 57 years of experience. “I had so much fun translating this story and it really means a lot to me that the time and effort I put into this translation is being recognized this way,” Hundley, who was not able to attend the ceremony in person, said via a video message. Jude Vandervort won the fiction Commendation Award for translating “Bead by Bead” by Jung Ji-a. Park Se-yeon and Noh Hye-yeon received poetry Commendation Awards for their translations of works by An Hee-yeon and Lee Su-myeong , respectively. No poetry Grand Prize was awarded. The special prize commemorates the Irish priest and translator who arrived in Korea in 1964 as a missionary and translated more than 2,000 Korean poems and served as a judge for the competition from 1975 to 1980 and from 1988 to 1989. Culture minister Chae Hwi-young stressed the need to turn heightened international interest in Korean literature into a lasting reading culture. “At the center of that effort are translators, who convey not only a work’s language but also its emotions and the spirit of its time,” Lee Yong-shin, the director general for arts policy, read on Chae's behalf. The minister expressed hope that the awards would mark a new beginning for the winners and that their efforts would open broader horizons for Korean literature. Lee Young-ju, head of KB Kookmin Bank’s custody business division, likewise emphasized translation’s importance in sustaining Korean culture’s global reach. “However outstanding a work may be, it can truly communicate with readers around the world only when translation conveys the emotional resonance and depth of the original,” Lee said. Judge Krys Lee praised the entrants’ willingness to explore diverse literary territory in remarks read by the ceremony’s host. “The translators for this year’s award made adventurous choices in the selection of texts,” she said, highlighting a range extending from historical and mythic fiction to experimental poetry. Irish Ambassador to Korea Sean Hoy spoke of literature’s enduring place in national culture. “It’s our literature that lasts. It’s like a stone building — it’s there forever,” Hoy said, describing translation as a way to bring Korean literature to readers across the world. Accepting her poetry award in person, Park thanked her teachers at Ewha Womans University’s Graduate School of Translation and Interpretation, poet An and her family. “I first encountered the poet’s work as a reader, and I believe its beauty and power are what brought me here today,” she said. “I will continue working to share the beauty and depth of Korean literature, and the pleasure it brings, with readers around the world.” Ku thanked writer Danyao for trusting him, while Noh said receiving recognition for a work she loved was especially meaningful. “I will do my best to become a translator worthy of this honor,” Ku said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.title_zh: 《韩国时报》翻译奖让韩国文学走近世界读者
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/b.body_zh: 《韩国时报》于周二在首尔举行的第57届现代韩国文学翻译奖颁奖仪式上，表彰了5名获奖译者。在人工智能引发文学翻译未来新疑问之际，此次颁奖礼旨在庆祝他们在连接韩国作家与全球读者方面发挥的作用。典礼在首尔韩国新闻中心举行，译者、文化官员和出版界代表齐聚一堂，发言者强调，要让作品蕴含的情感深度跨越语言，需要具备人类的敏感细腻。奖项由《韩国时报》主办，并得到文化、体育和旅游部以及KB金融集团的支持。《韩国时报》社长吴永镇表示，韩国文化国际影响力的日益扩大，恰逢一场技术巨变，这要求人们反思文学何以具有意义。吴说：“在机器也能写作的时代，我们如何才能保存唯有人类才能传达的情感共鸣、想象力和文化深度？如何在接受技术进步的同时传承文学的本质之美，是人类必须解决的紧迫课题。”他承诺，该报将与获奖者携手寻找答案，并借鉴竞赛57年来积累的经验。无法亲临现场的Hundley通过视频致辞说：“翻译这个故事让我非常开心，我为这次翻译投入的时间与努力能够以这种方式得到认可，对我意义重大。”Jude Vandervort凭翻译Jung Ji-a的《Bead by Bead》获得小说 commendation奖。Park Se-yeon和Noh Hye-yeon分别凭翻译An Hee-yeon和Lee Su-myeong的作品获得诗歌commendation奖。本届没有颁发诗歌大奖。特别奖旨在纪念这位爱尔兰神父兼翻译家；他于1964年以传教士身份来到韩国，翻译了2,000多首韩国诗歌，并于1975年至1980年、1988年至1989年担任赛事评委。文化部长Chae Hwi-young强调，需要把国际社会对韩国文学日益浓厚的兴趣转化为持久的阅读文化。艺术政策总司长Lee Yong-shin代Chae宣读致辞说：“ translators处于这项努力的核心，他们不仅传达作品的语言，也传达作品的感情和时代精神。”部长希望，这些奖项能为获奖者 marking一个新起点，他们的努力也将为韩国文学打开更广阔的前景。KB国民银行托管业务部门负责人Lee Young-ju同样强调，翻译对于维系韩国文化的全球影响力至关重要。Lee说：“无论一部作品多么出色，只有当翻译传达出原作的情感共鸣与深度时，它才能真正与世界各处的读者沟通。”评委Krys Lee在由主持人代读的致辞中，赞赏参赛者探索多元文学领域的意愿。她说：“今年获奖译者在文本选择方面作出了大胆的决定”，并指出其涵盖范围从历史与神话小说延伸至实验诗歌。韩国爱尔兰大使Sean Hoy谈到文学在民族文化中经久不衰的地位。Hoy说：“我们的文学经久不衰。它就像一座石头建筑——永远矗立在那里。”他将翻译形容为把韩国文学带到世界各地读者面前的一种方式。Park亲自领奖时，向梨花女子大学翻译与口译研究生院的教师、诗人An及其家人致谢。她说：“我最初是作为读者接触到这位诗人的作品，我相信，正是作品的美与力量带我走到今天。”她还说：“我会继续努力，把韩国文学的美与深度，以及它带给读者的愉悦，与世界各地的读者分享。”Ku感谢作家Danyao对自己的信任；Noh则表示，自己喜爱的作品获得认可尤其意义重大。Ku说：“我会竭尽全力，成为一名配得上这份荣誉的译者。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Vice Unification Minister Kim Nam-jung said Tuesday construction will soon resume on the South Korean section of a railway line meant to link the two Koreas. He made the remarks during a seminar in Seoul, as the government seeks to restore the South Korean section of the Gyeongwon Line, which once connected Seoul and North Korea's eastern port city of Wonsan. The last stop now accessible on the southern section is Cheorwon's Baekmagoji in Gangwon Province, and the ministry plans to resume work on the stretch between Baekmagoji and Woljeong-ri Station, the northernmost station on the South Korean side, close to the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) separating the two Koreas. The planned restoration work is aimed at "preparing a path connecting the two Koreas," Kim said at the forum on peace tourism cooperation on the Korean Peninsula. Earlier this year, the ministry briefed the National Assembly on its plan to carry out preparatory work within this year, and to resume construction on the cross-border line next year. Restoration of the line began in 2015 but stopped in May 2016, following North Korea's fourth nuclear test earlier that year. "Peace will not come by declaration, but it grows bit by bit when people meet people face to face," Kim said. The ministry, he added, will work to create such encounters by building transportation infrastructure and enhancing tourism in the border area. Kim also called for greater interest from the private sector and the international community, saying the tourism in the border area cannot be driven by the government alone
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔：朝韩铁路南段施工将很快恢复
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国统一部副部长金南贞周二表示，旨在连接朝鲜半岛南北双方的铁路，其韩国境内路段很快将恢复施工。他是在首尔举行的一场研讨会上说这番话的。目前，政府正推动恢复京元线韩国境内路段；该铁路曾连接首尔与朝鲜东港城市元山。南部路段目前可抵达的最后一站是江原道铁原郡的白马高志站，该部计划恢复白马高志站与韩国境内最北端、临近非军事区分隔南北的停战村附近月精里站之间区段的施工。计划中的修复工程旨在“为连接南北双方的通道做好准备”。金南贞在有关朝鲜半岛和平旅游合作的论坛上表示，修复工程的目标是“为连接南北双方的通道做好准备”。今年早些时候，该部向国会介绍了年内开展准备工作、明年恢复跨境线路施工的计划。该线路的修复工程始于2015年，但在2016年5月因朝鲜当年早些时候进行第四次核试验而中止。金南贞说：“和平不会因一声宣告而到来，但当人们面对面相遇时，它会一点点增长。”他还表示，该部将通过建设交通基础设施和发展边境地区旅游，推动创造此类相遇机会。金南贞还呼吁私营部门和国际社会加大关注，并表示边境地区的旅游业不能仅靠政府推动。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Rolex watches, Hermès handbags and gold bars are among 99 lots of luxury goods seized from Korea’s major tax delinquents that will go under the hammer this weekend in a special auction organized by the National Tax Service, Seoul Auction said Tuesday. The sale, scheduled for Saturday, carries combined opening bids of 344.7 million won ($258,000) and will be split between online and in-person bidding, with offerings ranging from fine jewelry and premium whisky to high-end bicycles. Eighteen lots featuring sought-after brands will be available exclusively in person at Seoul Auction’s Gangnam Center . They include a Rolex Day-Date automatic watch with an opening bid of 35 million won and an Hermès Kelly 25 bag with palladium hardware starting at 12 million won. Two Chanel Coco Crush rings, in white and beige gold, each set with diamonds and made of 18-karat gold, are priced to start at 8 million won. The online sale has a similarly eclectic lineup: Japanese whiskies, a titanium-frame folding bicycle, a Christian Dior handbag and jewelry by Van Cleef & Arpels and Boucheron. Six 24-karat gold bars will be offered together, with a combined opening bid of 20 million won. Prospective buyers can inspect the items at the auction house from Wednesday through Saturday ahead of the sale. The auction is part of a partnership between Seoul Auction and the National Tax Service that began in the second half of last year. As the tax agency’s commissioned auction operator, the company handles the sale of seized assets to help recover unpaid taxes. The two sides work together to determine the composition and format of each sale around market demand. At their first special auction on March 11, all 76 lots were sold, bringing in 1.2 billion won — more than six times their combined opening bids of 197 million won. The Saturday sale marks the second time the seized assets have been assembled for a dedicated event featuring both online and in-person bidding. Meanwhile, six high-value works of modern and contemporary art seized by the authorities will go under the hammer separately at Seoul Auction’s regular sales on Nov. 23 and 24. Among them are Josef Albers’ 1969 painting “Homage to the Square,” with a low estimate of 350 million won, and Yoshitomo Nara’s sculpture “The Puff Marshies Mini” (2006), estimated at 100 million won at the low end. Similar auctions of tax-seized assets take place in other countries, though the systems differ. In the U.S., tax sales commonly involve real estate sold over unpaid property taxes. Spain’s State Tax Administration Agency regularly auctions assets seized from tax debtors, including homes, vehicles and jewelry. Japan has its own system, known as “kobai,” through which tax authorities sell everything from real estate and vehicles to luxury goods and artworks
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 从劳力士到金条，税务查扣的奢侈品将公开拍卖
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国国税厅周二表示，Rolex手表、 Hermès手袋和金条等奢侈品将从该国重大税务欠缴者处查扣的99件拍品中选出，本周末在首尔拍卖行举办的一场特别拍卖会上公开拍卖。此次拍卖定于周六进行，总起拍价为3.447亿韩元（$258,000），竞拍方式分为线上和现场两种，拍卖品涵盖精美珠宝、高级威士忌到高端自行车等。共有18批包含热门品牌的拍品仅限在首尔拍卖行江南中心现场竞拍，其中包括起拍价为3,500万韩元的Rolex Day-Date自动机械表，以及起拍价为1,200万韩元、配有钯金饰件的Hermès Kelly 25手袋。两枚分别为白金和米金色、镶有钻石并采用18K金打造的Chanel Coco Crush戒指，起拍价均为800万韩元。线上拍卖的拍品同样种类丰富，包括日本威士忌、钛合金车架折叠自行车、Christian Dior手袋，以及Van Cleef & Arpels和Boucheron的珠宝。六块24K金金条将作为组合拍品出售，总起拍价为2,000万韩元。有意竞拍者可在周三至周六拍卖前前往拍卖行现场查看拍品。此次拍卖是首尔拍卖行与韩国国税厅自去年下半年开始合作的一部分。作为税务机关委托的拍卖执行机构，该公司负责出售查扣资产，以帮助追缴欠税。双方会根据市场需求，共同确定每次拍卖的拍品构成和形式。在3月11日举行的首次特别拍卖会上，全部76批拍品均告售罄，成交额达到12亿韩元，是1.97亿韩元总起拍价的六倍多。周六的拍卖是查扣资产第二次汇集举办专门活动，并同时采用线上和现场竞拍。与此同时，当局查扣的6件现代及当代艺术高价值作品，将于11月23日和24日在首尔拍卖行的常规拍卖中分别举槌。其中包括Josef Albers于1969年创作的画作《向方形致敬》，最低估价为3.5亿韩元；以及Yoshitomo Nara的雕塑《The Puff Marshies Mini》（2006年），最低估价为1亿韩元。其他国家也会举行类似的查扣税务资产拍卖，但各自的制度有所不同。在美国，税务拍卖通常涉及因未缴财产税而被出售的房地产。西班牙国家税务管理局经常拍卖从欠税人处查扣的资产，包括住宅、车辆和珠宝。日本也有自己的制度，称为“公卖”，税务机关通过这一机制出售从房地产、车辆到奢侈品和艺术品等各种资产……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: Industry minister calls for deregulation The streets of Seoul are already bright with colorful lights and decorations for Christmas. Splashes of red and green and the glitter of small lights create a sense of abundance and festivity. The celebratory ambiance sits uncomfortably, however, here in the capital of one of Asia's export powerhouses. Korea has enjoyed a stellar export rally this year, yet the benefits have yet to materialize as improvements in the cost of living for everyday citizens. A social media post by Industry Minister Kim Jung-kwan on Saturday is raising the alarm over the jarring economic landscape. Returning from a three-day trip to China, Kim posted to Facebook: "Are we desperate enough? Are we doing what is required?" He went on to say that he was struck with a sense of urgency during his trip, as he viewed how much China had developed. According to the minister, a Korean businessman he met during the trip had asked why the Chinese government was doing so much more to support its industries compared to Korea. Kim's post required particular attention, as he was one of the key ministers involved in the $350 billion investment agreement with the United States reached last year. The industry minister is imploring the nation to regain its economic focus. Chinese companies — even in sectors where Korea has long been the leader — are quickly catching up. Chinese-made electric vehicles have arrived in Korea at competitive prices. An Oct. 28 report by Bloomberg Intelligence forecast that by 2030, China will be a global leader in eight out of 17 key sectors, including in large language models, humanoid robots and shipbuilding. The same report said that China will be catching up in areas like chip design, metal casting and memory by 2030, which is in line with Korean chips sector projections. Korea has about three years remaining before Chinese semiconductors are major competitors for domestic ones. State-led industrial policy is a thing of the past. However, the pace of technological innovation in the era of artificial intelligence has made speed paramount — and that type of speed can best be achieved when the state and private enterprise work together. Having the state heavily involved in a country's economy may not always be the most efficient model, but the situational context must be considered. Kim's remark also comes at a time when he and other officials including Labor Minister Kim Young-hoon are discussing the specifics of a proposed special bill. The ruling Democratic Party of Korea recently suggested creating an Act on Super-Regional Special Zones. Several rounds of consultations have been held to implement the legislation speedily. The bill is largely about balanced regional development and the "three megaprojects" announced by President Lee Jae Myung. One of the more contentious issues in the bill is the deregulation of the current 52-hour workweek for the research and development sector for the megaprojects, as well as expanding hiring of temporary workers. While speed is vital for projects to improve Korea's global competitiveness, the bill has been slow in moving thanks to disagreements between the trade and labor sectors, the latter of which has taken a strong stand for worker protection. While state-led industrial policies may also result in side effects , both the trade and the labor side must find a way to cooperate on the issue. The economic landscape, just like the geopolitical one, has been in flux for the past few years. The fallout from the U.S. midterm elections is not yet clear. When Seoul policymakers attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting next week in Shenzhen, China, they should have their finger on the pulse of the Chinese economy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: “韩国是否已经绝望到如此境地？”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh:
产业部长呼吁放松管制

首尔的街道已经亮起五颜六色的灯饰，圣诞节装饰遍布各处。红色与绿色的点缀以及小灯闪烁的光芒，营造出富足而喜庆的气氛。然而，在这座亚洲出口 powerhouse之都——首尔——这种欢庆氛围却显得格格不入。今年，韩国的出口表现亮眼，但这些收益尚未体现为普通民众生活成本的改善。产业部长金正官周六发布的一篇社交媒体帖子，就令人不安的经济现状发出警报。结束为期三天的中国之行后，金正官在Facebook上写道：“我们已经迫切到这种程度了吗？我们正在做必要的事吗？”他说，旅途中看到中国的发展程度，令他深感紧迫。据这位部长介绍，他在行程中遇到的一名韩国商人问，中国政府为何比韩国采取多得多的措施来支持本国产业。

金正官的帖子格外引人关注，因为他是参与去年韩国与美国达成的3500亿美元投资协议的关键部长之一。这位产业部长恳请全国重新聚焦经济。中国企业——即使在韩国长期领先的行业——也在迅速赶上。中国制造的电动汽车已经以具有竞争力的价格进入韩国。Bloomberg Intelligence在10月28日发布的报告预测，到2030年，中国将在包括大型语言模型、人形机器人和造船在内的17个关键行业中的8个成为全球领导者。同一份报告还称，到2030年，中国将在芯片设计、金属铸造和存储芯片等领域追赶，这与韩国芯片行业的预测一致。中国半导体成为韩国本土芯片有力竞争者之前，韩国大约还有三年时间。

国家主导的产业政策已经成为过去。然而，在人工智能时代，技术创新的速度已使速度成为 paramount——而这种速度只有在国家与私营企业携手合作时才能充分实现。国家深度参与一国经济，未必总是最高效的模式，但必须结合具体情势加以考量。

金正官发表这番言论之际，他正与劳工部长金永勋等其他官员讨论一项拟议特别法案的具体内容。韩国执政党民主党最近建议制定《超级区域特别区法》。目前已经举行数轮磋商，以迅速推动该法案落地。该法案主要涉及区域均衡发展，以及总统李在明宣布的“三大超级项目”。

法案中争议较大的问题之一，是针对这些超级项目所涉研发部门，放宽现行每周52小时工作制，并扩大临时工招聘规模。尽管速度对于提升韩国全球竞争力至关重要，但由于贸易和劳工部门之间存在分歧，这项法案推进缓慢；劳工部门在保护劳动者方面立场强硬。虽然国家主导的产业政策也可能带来副作用，但贸易与劳工双方都必须设法就这一问题展开合作。

过去几年，经济格局与地缘政治格局一样一直处于变化之中。美国中期选举带来的影响尚不明朗。下周，当首尔决策者赴中国深圳参加亚太经济合作组织会议时，他们应当准确把握中国经济的脉搏……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Kolmar Korea's artificial intelligence (AI)-powered lipstick system, ChromaFlow, won the Best of Innovation award in the beauty technology category for CES 2027, marking the first case of consecutive wins in the category, the company said Tuesday. ChromaFlow also received an Innovation Award in the AI category, while its LumiJet Pro skin care device won another award in that category, bringing Kolmar Korea’s total honors at CES 2027 to three across two products. The company said the recognition follows its award for the Scar Beauty Device, an AI-based wound care and makeup coverage device, at CES 2026. It plans to exhibit both award-winning products at the Venetian Expo in Las Vegas during CES 2027, scheduled for Jan. 6 to 9. ChromaFlow is designed to reproduce a lip color while accounting for differences in users’ lip tones, which can affect how the same lipstick shade appears on different people. When held against the lips, an optical sensor analyzes their condition. The system then calculates a customized formula and combines material from seven color cartridges to produce a lip product in under a minute. A translucent section in its lipstick-shaped body lets users watch the colors mix. LumiJet Pro analyzes skin condition and thickness before using high-speed jets to deliver ultrafine particles containing active ingredients to targeted locations and depths. The device then emits light at a specific wavelength to break down the particles and disperse their contents into the surrounding area. Kolmar Korea said it has developed a nanoparticle formulation used in the device. The company plans to build a beauty technology data platform using skin and color data accumulated through products including its CAIOME scalp analysis solution, Scar Beauty Device and ChromaFlow. It aims to connect developed AI models into an integrated system spanning skin analysis, cosmetic formulation and manufacturing. “The consecutive Best of Innovation wins recognize our database-based manufacturing technology, which connects the cosmetics process, from measurement to manufacturing, through AI,” a company official said. The official said Kolmar Korea would develop the platform using its accumulated data to lead the beauty technology market
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: Kolmar 的人工智能口红系统赢得 CES 美妆科技奖
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Kolmar Korea的人工智能（AI）驱动口红系统ChromaFlow在CES 2027美容科技类别中荣获“最佳创新奖”，这是该类别首个连续获奖的案例，该公司周二表示。ChromaFlow还获得了人工智能类别的“创新奖”，其LumiJet Pro护肤设备也斩获该类别另一项奖项，使Kolmar Korea在CES 2027凭借两款产品共获得三项荣誉。公司表示，此次认可紧随其AI伤口护理及遮瑕设备Scar Beauty Device在CES 2026获奖之后。公司计划在1月6日至9日举行的CES 2027期间，于拉斯维加斯Venetian Expo展出两款获奖产品。ChromaFlow旨在还原唇色，同时考虑用户唇色的差异，因为这些差异会影响同一色号口红在不同人身上的呈现效果。将口红贴近嘴唇时，光学传感器会分析嘴唇状态。随后，系统计算定制配方，并混合七个颜色盒中的材料，在不到一分钟内制成唇部产品。其口红形机身上的半透明区域让用户能够看到颜色混合过程。LumiJet Pro会分析皮肤状态和厚度，然后利用高速气流将含有活性成分的超细颗粒输送至指定位置和深度。设备随后发出特定波长的光，分解颗粒并将其内容物扩散至周围区域。Kolmar Korea表示，公司已开发出用于该设备的纳米颗粒配方。公司计划利用CAIOME头皮分析解决方案、Scar Beauty Device和ChromaFlow等产品积累的皮肤和颜色数据，建设美容科技数据平台，旨在将已开发的人工智能模型接入一个涵盖皮肤分析、化妆品配方和生产的综合系统。该公司官员表示：“连续获得‘最佳创新奖’认可了我们的数据库驱动制造技术，该技术通过人工智能将化妆品从测量到生产的各个环节连接起来。”该官员表示，Kolmar Korea将利用积累的数据开发该平台，以引领美容科技市场

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.summary_zh: 据韩国消费者 Agency 于星期二发布的消费者报告，韩国的辣味方便面辣度从略带刺激到辣得让人流泪不等，有些方便面一碗的含盐量甚至超过一整天的推荐摄入量。在炒面中，三养食品旗下在全球广受欢迎的不二辣炒面（Hot Chicken Flavor Ramyeon）位居首位，每千克含盐量达到285毫克。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body: Spicy instant noodles in Korea range from mildly kicky to tear-inducingly hot — and some pack more than a full day’s worth of salt into a single bowl, according to a consumer report released Tuesday by the Korea Consumer Agency. The state-run watchdog conducted a comprehensive safety and quality assessment of 12 top-selling instant noodle products. The test group comprised seven traditional soup-based ramyeon products and five brothless, stir-fried varieties, evaluating them across key metrics including spiciness intensity, nutritional content, safety standards and retail pricing. Laboratory analysis revealed that the concentration of capsaicinoids — the natural chemical compounds in chili peppers responsible for their fiery burn — varied by nearly seven times among the tested brands. In the soup-based category, Paldo’s Teumsae Ramen Red Pepper Rice Cake registered the highest heat level at 650 milligrams of capsaicinoids per kilogram. Among stir-fried noodles, Samyang Foods’ globally popular Buldak Bokkeum Myeon (Hot Chicken Flavor Ramyeon) took the top spot, recording 285 milligrams per kilogram. Under Korea’s standardized industrial guidelines for spicy processed foods, four products earned the highest "very spicy" rating: Teumsae Ramen Red Pepper Rice Cake, Nongshim’s Shin Ramyun The Red, Samyang Ramen Spicy Flavor and Buldak Bokkeum Myeon. Sodium levels proved exceptionally high across the entire sample set. The soup-based varieties delivered between 1,611 and 2,080 milligrams of sodium per package, representing 81 percent to 104 percent of the daily recommended limit of 2,000 milligrams established by Korean health authorities. Nongshim’s Shin Ramyun The Red recorded the highest sodium count at 2,080 milligrams per serving. For consumers who drink the entire bowl of broth, a single meal exceeds the recommended daily intake cap. Because roughly 70 percent of the total sodium content in soup-based instant noodles concentrates in the liquid rather than the noodles, agency officials explicitly advised consumers to reduce their intake of the broth and use less seasoning powder during preparation. On the safety front, all 12 products passed with flying colors. Laboratory screenings confirmed that none contained harmful levels of heavy metals, toxic chemical residues or pathogenic microorganisms, meeting all national food safety requirements. Retail prices also showed significant variance. Soup-based instant noodles ranged from 684 won ($0.47) to 1,300 won per package, while stir-fried varieties cost between 995 won and 1,420 won. The agency urged shoppers to inspect nutrition facts labels carefully and consider their personal tolerance, warning that consuming ultra-spicy noodles on an empty or sensitive stomach can trigger severe gastrointestinal discomfort. This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.title_zh: 多辣才算太辣？韩国测试人气方便面
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/t.body_zh: 韩国辣味方便面从 mildly kicky 到辣得让人流泪，跨度很大；韩国消费者协会周二发布的一份消费者报告称，有些产品一碗所含的盐分甚至超过一整天的推荐摄入量。韩国消费者协会这家国有监管机构对12款畅销方便面进行了全面安全与质量评估。测试对象包括7款传统汤煮拉面和5款无汤炒面，评估指标涵盖辣度、营养成分、安全标准和零售价格。实验室分析显示，在受测品牌中，辣椒素类——辣椒中导致灼热感的天然化合物——的浓度相差近7倍。在汤煮方便面类别中，Paldo的Teumsae Ramen Red Pepper Rice Cake辣度最高，每公斤含650毫克辣椒素类。炒面类别中，全球畅销的Samyang Foods Buldak Bokkeum Myeon（Hot Chicken Flavor Ramyeon）位居首位，每公斤含285毫克。按照韩国针对辣味加工食品的标准化工业指南，4款产品获得最高级的“very spicy”评级，分别为Teumsae Ramen Red Pepper Rice Cake、Nongshim的Shin Ramyun The Red、Samyang Ramen Spicy Flavor和Buldak Bokkeum Myeon。整个样本的钠含量都异常高。汤煮方便面每包含钠1,611至2,080毫克，相当于韩国卫生部门所定每日2,000毫克推荐上限的81%至104%。Nongshim的Shin Ramyun The Red钠含量最高，每份达2,080毫克。对于把整碗汤汁全部喝掉的消费者而言，一餐摄入量就会超过每日建议上限。由于汤煮方便面中约70%的钠集中在汤汁而非面条中，该机构官员明确建议消费者少喝汤，并在冲泡时少放调味粉。在安全方面，全部12款产品均以优异成绩通过检测。实验室筛查确认，这些产品均不含达到有害水平的重金属、有毒化学残留或致病微生物，符合韩国所有食品安全要求。零售价格也存在显著差异。汤煮方便面每包售价从684韩元（0.47美元）到1,300韩元不等，炒面则介于995韩元至1,420韩元之间。该机构敦促购物者仔细查看营养成分标签，并结合个人耐受程度作出选择，同时警告称，空腹或肠胃敏感者食用超辣方便面可能引发严重的胃肠不适。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由The Korea Times编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Top-trim Neolun makes bold bid to challenge Mercedes-Maybach, Bentley Genesis is stepping up competition in the full-size luxury SUV market with the full-electric GV90, taking aim at German rivals — BMW and Mercedes-Benz — as it seeks to carve out a bigger share of the lucrative high-end segment. The brand unveiled on Tuesday pricing for the GV90, its first full-size flagship SUV, starting at 139.5 million won ($103,000) in Korea. This places the vehicle in a similar price range to the BMW X7 and Mercedes-Benz GLS, positioning Genesis to compete directly for buyers who have traditionally favored German luxury SUVs. The launch represents a significant test for Genesis, which has spent years building its reputation as a premium brand, but has yet to establish the same level of recognition as BMW and Mercedes-Benz in the upper reaches of the luxury market. The GV90 sets itself apart from its rivals with an all-electric powertrain, along with a focus on rear-seat comfort and advanced technology. It uses a 123.5-kilowatt-hour battery, the largest among Hyundai Motor Group's electric vehicles (EVs), and can travel up to 500 kilometers on a single charge. The Korean automaker is placing particular emphasis on the vehicle's interior, as it attempts to compete with the luxury and refinement associated with German rivals. The GV90 features a 23.6-inch OLED display, a 25-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system and massage seats, while its extensive driver-assistance technology is intended to strengthen its technology credentials. The GV90 Neolun takes the positioning a step further. Priced at up to 239.5 million won, it features coach doors with a hidden B-pillar and front seats that can rotate 180 degrees to create a lounge-like interior. The four-seat Executive Suite trim adds luxury-focused features including radiant heated flooring, a rear refrigerator and dedicated rear seating. However, the Neolun's price puts it beyond the most direct X7 and GLS comparison and closer to the ultra-luxury end of the market. Competing head-on with models, such as the Mercedes-Maybach GLS or Bentley Bentayga, will be more difficult for Genesis, given the established brands' long-standing prestige and wealthy customer base. The GV90 is also expected to play an important role in improving Genesis' profitability here, as Korea's large luxury SUV market continues to grow. According to data from the Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association, sales of BMW X7 rose from 4,332 units in 2024 to 4,593 last year, while Mercedes-Benz GLS sales increased from 1,225 to 1,893 units. Porsche’s Cayenne SUV sales also grew from 3,584 to 3,768 units over the same period. “The sales figure from sensitive Korean customers will be a critical early test of whether Genesis can turn its flagship luxury SUV into a credible alternative to German’s established luxury counterparts,” an auto industry official said

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: Neolun高配版大胆出价挑战Mercedes-Maybach，Bentley Genesis加码大型豪华SUV市场竞争。该品牌周二公布GV90价格，这款首次推出的全尺寸旗舰SUV在韩国起售价为1.395亿韩元（$103,000）。这使该车的价格区间与BMW X7和Mercedes-Benz GLS相近，让Genesis直接争夺历来青睐德国豪华SUV的消费者。此次推出是对Genesis的一次重大考验。该品牌多年来致力于打造高端品牌形象，但在豪华市场的高端领域，其知名度尚未达到BMW和Mercedes-Benz的水平。GV90凭借全电动动力系统、后排舒适性和先进技术脱颖而出。该车搭载123.5千瓦时电池，是Hyundai Motor Group电动汽车（EV）中容量最大的电池，单次充电续航里程最高可达500公里。这家韩国汽车制造商格外强调该车的内饰，力求与德国竞争对手所代表的豪华感和精致感抗衡。GV90配备23.6英寸OLED显示屏、25扬声器Bang & Olufsen音响系统和按摩座椅，并提供大量驾驶辅助技术，以强化其科技实力。GV90 Neolun进一步提升了产品定位。其最高售价为2.395亿韩元，配备隐藏式B柱的对开式车门，以及可旋转180度的前排座椅，营造出类似休息室的内部空间。四座Executive Suite版本增加了以豪华体验为导向的配置，包括辐射式加热地板、后排冰箱和独立后排座椅。然而，Neolun的价格使其超出了最直接的X7和GLS对标车型， closer to 超豪华市场的一端。考虑到这些成熟品牌长期积淀的声望和富裕客户群，Genesis若要正面对抗Mercedes-Maybach GLS或Bentley Bentayga等车型，难度将更大。随着韩国庞大的豪华SUV市场持续增长，GV90预计还将在提升Genesis在当地的盈利能力方面发挥重要作用。据Korea Automobile Importers & Distributors Association的数据，BMW X7的销量从2024年的4,332辆增至去年的4,593辆，Mercedes-Benz GLS的销量则从1,225辆增至1,893辆。同期，Porsche Cayenne SUV的销量也从3,584辆增至3,768辆。一位汽车行业人士表示：“来自对品质要求苛刻的韩国消费者的销售数据，将是Genesis能否将这款旗舰豪华SUV打造为德国成熟豪华车型可信替代选择的早期关键考验。”
