https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A city-run hospital for houseplants? Welcome to modern Seoul. Seoul’s dedicated emergency room for sickly flora has administered 10,886 diagnoses, treatments and house-call consultations since opening its doors in 2023, the Seoul Metropolitan Government said Tuesday. Nestled inside the Seoul Agricultural Technology Center in Seocho District, the Companion Plant Hospital functions like a full-scale medical center for dramatic greenery. Resident plant doctors diagnose bug infestations and mysterious wilting, prescribing everything from targeted pesticides to emergency repotting. Plants needing intensive care can even be admitted for up to three months of inpatient recovery, while anxious plant parents leave with tailored home-care prescriptions. The hospital often handles high-stakes, emotional cases. In one instance, a resident rushed in a wilting Chinese money tree — the final gift from their late mother. The facility immediately admitted the botanical heirloom into critical care, nursing it back to life. In another success story, a Rhaphidophora tetrasperma — the trendy "mini monstera" — was admitted in January after losing every single root to a lethal cocktail of overwatering and winter drafts. Following three months of specialized hydroponic therapy, the patient made a full recovery and was discharged home in April. City officials revealed that 87 percent of hospital admissions stem not from exotic pests or plant diseases, but from "physiological disorders" — the official medical term for accidental plant torture via improper lighting, freezing air or overzealous watering. With winter approaching, plant doctors advise green thumbs to chill out on the watering can, empty soggy saucers, and pull leafy companions away from drafty windows during daily room airings. For light-starved apartments, moving pots to sunnier spots or deploying LED grow lights can prevent a trip to the intensive care unit. The medical service is free for Seoul residents, who can check in up to three potted plants per monthly visit. Consultations run weekdays from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. through Nov. 30 via the center’s website, with phone and video telehealth options available. Eighteen of Seoul’s 25 district offices also run neighborhood triage clinics for minor checkups, escalating the most severe cases to the main hospital. "Companion plants share in citizens' daily lives and memories," said Cho Sang-tae, director of the Seoul Agricultural Technology Center. "Through professional plant medical care and seasonal maintenance guidance, we will help citizens care for their plants while relieving loneliness and finding comfort in their everyday lives." This article was published with the assistance of generative AI and edited by The Korea Times
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔植物医院自2023年开诊以来已收治1万名盆栽患者
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh:
由市政府运营的室内植物医院？欢迎来到现代首尔。首尔市政府周二表示，自2023年开门营业以来，首尔专门为病弱植物设置的急诊室已进行10,886次诊断、治疗和上门咨询。该院坐落于瑞草区首尔农业技术中心内，名为伴侣植物医院，像一家综合性医疗中心一样为绿植提供救治。常驻植物医生会诊断虫害和神秘枯萎，开出从针对性农药到紧急换盆等各种处方。需要 intensive care 的植物甚至可以住院接受最长3个月的康复治疗，而焦虑的植物父母则会带着定制化的居家护理处方离开。

这家医院经常接诊风险高、情绪色彩浓烈的病例。有一次，一位居民抱着一株正在枯萎的金钱树匆忙赶来——那是已故母亲留给他的最后礼物。医院立即将这株植物遗产收入重症监护，通过护理让它恢复生机。另一个成功病例是一株龟背竹（Rhaphidophora tetrasperma），也就是时下流行的“迷你龟背竹”。它于1月入院，此前因浇水过多和冬季寒风的双重致命侵害而失去了全部根系。经过3个月的专门水培治疗后，这名“患者”完全康复，并于4月出院回家。

市政官员透露，87%的住院病例并非源于外来害虫或植物疾病，而是所谓的“生理紊乱”——这是对因照明不当、冰冻空气或浇水过度而意外折磨植物的官方医学称呼。随着冬季临近，植物医生建议园艺爱好者少浇水，倒掉湿漉漉的托盘积水，并在每天给房间通风时让绿叶伙伴远离漏风的窗户。对于采光不足的公寓，把花盆移到阳光更充足的地方，或使用LED植物生长灯，可以避免一趟重症监护之旅。

这项医疗服务对首尔居民免费，他们每次月度就诊最多可登记3盆盆栽。11月30日前，可通过该中心网站预约工作日上午10点至下午5点的咨询，并提供电话和视频远程医疗服务。首尔25个区办事处中有18个还设有社区分诊诊所，为轻微问题提供检查，并将最严重的病例转诊至主医院。

首尔农业技术中心主任赵相泰表示：“伴侣植物与市民的日常生活和回忆密不可分。通过专业的植物医疗护理和季节性养护指导，我们将帮助市民照顾植物，同时缓解孤独，让他们在日常生活中找到慰藉。”

https://www.myjoyonline.com/womens-devel.body: The proposed Women's Development Bank has submitted an application to the Bank of Ghana (BoG) for a banking licence, marking a major step towards its establishment. Vice President Professor Jane Naana Opoku-Agyemang says a dedicated committee tasked with developing the institution has completed its work and submitted the application through the Ministry of Finance for regulatory consideration. Speaking at the 15th Ghana Economic Forum organised by the B&FT, she said the bank is being designed to address persistent financing challenges confronting women-owned businesses, particularly those operating in the informal sector. She explained that the institution will adopt a different approach from conventional banks by bringing financial services closer to women entrepreneurs and traders. "We therefore constituted a dedicated committee that brought together market women, susu collectors, representatives of women's business associations, financial sector professionals and other key stakeholders," she said. The Vice President noted that the committee's work was guided by the need to ensure that the bank reflects the actual experiences and financial needs of women. "My conviction has always been that an institution established to serve women must be shaped by the experiences, aspirations and everyday realities of those very women," she added. Professor Opoku-Agyemang cited Ghana Statistical Service data indicating that women manage nearly 60 per cent of micro-establishments but account for less than 10 per cent of large businesses. She said the disparity highlights the need for targeted financial interventions to help women-owned enterprises expand and become more competitive. "This bank is not meant to be just another financial institution. It is conceived as a last-mile bank designed to bring financial services closer to the women whose enterprise and hard work sustain our markets and local economies," she stated

https://www.myjoyonline.com/womens-devel.body_zh: 拟议中的妇女开发银行已向加纳银行（BoG）提交银行业牌照申请，标志着该行筹建取得重要进展。副总统简·娜娜·奥波库-阿吉芒教授表示，负责筹建该机构的专门委员会已完成工作，并通过财政部提交申请，交由监管机构审议。她在B&FT组织的第15届加纳经济论坛上说，该银行旨在解决女性拥有的企业，尤其是非正规部门企业，长期面临的融资困难。她解释说，该机构将采取有别于传统银行的模式，让金融服务更贴近女性创业者和商人。她说：“因此，我们组建了一个专门委员会，汇聚了市场妇女、susu收款人、女性商业协会代表、金融行业专业人士及其他关键利益相关方。”副总统指出，委员会开展工作的指导原则，是确保该银行反映女性的真实经历和金融需求。她补充道：“我一直坚信，一个为女性服务的机构，必须依据这些女性自身的经历、抱负和日常生活来塑造。”奥波库-阿吉芒教授援引加纳统计局的数据指出，女性经营着近60%的微型企业，但在大型企业中所占比例不足10%。她说，这一差距凸显了有必要采取有针对性的金融干预措施，帮助女性拥有的企业扩大规模并提升竞争力。她表示：“这家银行并非要成为又一家普通金融机构。我们设想将其打造为一家‘最后一公里银行’，让金融服务更贴近那些以创业和辛勤付出支撑我们市场及地方经济的女性。”

In November 2025, he chaired a hearing after President Donald Trump’s redesignation of Nigeria as a ‘country of particular concern’. Unlock these with Subscription The Delhi Police’s Crime Branch has registered a case over fraudulent notices purportedly issued in the name of the force, seeking the removal of social media posts and the blocking of accounts belonging to the Internet Freedom Foundation (IFF) and the Software Freedom Law Centre (SFLC), an official close to the development told The Hindu. The FIR has been registered on charges of impersonating a public servant and forgery under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Section 66 of Information Technology (IT) Act. The development comes days after social media platform X told the Delhi High Court that an internal investigation had established that the notices were not genuine police communications and had been sent by an “imposter”. The platform also told the court that it had not acted on the requests and would not take down the organisations’ accounts. The case follows a November 6 hearing before Justice Amit Mahajan, who was hearing petitions filed by the two digital rights organisations challenging the purported takedown requests. X’s counsel told the court that the platform had conducted an internal investigation and found that someone had impersonated the Delhi Police. “We did not act on it. Notices are not sent by the Delhi Police. We have filed a complaint with the Delhi Police last night to find the imposter,” X’s counsel submitted. The court recorded the platform’s assurance and disposed of the petitions, granting the organisations liberty to approach it again if any action was taken against their accounts. The controversy began after X forwarded two purported ‘Illegal Content Reports’ to IFF on November 3. The first, dated October 31, sought the removal of a post published by IFF on October 30 and another post by SFLC. The second, dated November 2, sought the removal of 37 posts and the blocking of three accounts — @internetfreedom, @SFLCin and @geoblockedindia — in their entirety. The notices alleged that the posts were “defamatory” towards the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) under Section 356 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS). They reportedly called for the content to be removed or withheld within three hours, citing provisions of the Information Technology Act and the IT Rules, 2021. IFF had said that the posts in question reproduced and commented on a legal notice purportedly sent to the organisation on behalf of the RSS. It maintained that the posts constituted protected speech under Article 19(1)(a) of the Constitution and that it had not been given prior notice before the takedown requests were submitted. The organisation subsequently served a legal notice on the Delhi Police and X Corp. through its counsel, seeking clarification over the requests. SFLC, meanwhile, had questioned the authenticity of the communications after attempting to verify them with the Delhi Police. It said an email sent to the address mentioned in the purported notices was returned as undelivered, with an error stating that the user did not exist. The organisation pointed out that the same email address was listed on the Delhi Police website at the time, further raising questions about the communications. The organisations had approached the Delhi High Court after failing to obtain clarity on whether the notices had actually been issued by the police. Efforts are underway to trace the sender by examining IP address details and other digital footprints as part of the investigation being conducted by the Crime Branch’s cyber wing. 德里警察局犯罪调查处已就据称以该警察局名义发出的欺诈通知立案，要求删除社交媒体帖子，并封锁互联网自由基金会（IFF）和软件自由法律中心（SFLC）的账号。一名接近调查进展的官员告诉《印度教徒报》，根据《印度刑法典》（BNS）和《信息技术法》第66条，案件已以冒充公职人员和伪造罪名立案。

此事发生在社交媒体平台X告知德里高等法院数日后。X表示，内部调查已确认这些通知并非警方 genuine 通信，而是由一名“冒名者”发送。该平台还告诉法院，它没有执行相关要求，也不会删除这些组织的账号。

此案源于11月6日由Amit Mahajan法官主持的一次听证。法官当时审理的是两家数字权利组织针对这些要求下架通知提出的申请。X的律师告诉法院，该平台已开展内部调查，发现有人冒充德里警察。X的律师向法院表示：“我们没有对此采取行动。这些通知并非德里警察发出。我们昨晚已向德里警察局报案，以查明冒名者身份。”

法院记录了平台的保证，并终结了两项申请，同时准许这些组织在账号受到任何处置时再次向法院提出申诉。

这场争议始于X于11月3日向IFF转交两份据称属于“违法内容报告”的文件。第一份文件日期为10月31日，要求删除IFF于10月30日发布的一篇帖子以及SFLC发布的另一篇帖子。第二份文件日期为11月2日，要求删除37篇帖子，并全面封锁三个账号——@internetfreedom、@SFLCin和@geoblockedindia。

这些通知称，根据《印度刑法典》（BNS）第356条，相关帖子对国民志愿服务团（RSS）构成“诽谤”。据报道，通知援引《信息技术法》和《2021年信息技术规则》，要求在3小时内删除或停止显示相关内容。

IFF表示，有关帖子转载并评论了一份据称代表RSS向该组织发送的法律通知。该组织坚持认为，这些帖子属于《宪法》第19(1)(a)条保护的言论，而且在提出下架要求之前未收到任何事先通知。此后，该组织通过其律师向德里警察局和X Corp发出法律通知，要求就相关要求作出澄清。

与此同时，SFLC在尝试向德里警察局核实相关通信后，对这些通信的真实性提出质疑。该组织称，一封发送至据称通知中所列地址的电子邮件因投递失败而退信，错误提示称该用户不存在。该组织指出，当时同一电子邮箱地址还列在德里警察局网站上，这进一步引发了人们对这些通信真实性的疑问。

由于未能确认这些通知是否确由警方发出，两家组织已向德里高等法院寻求救济。

犯罪调查处网络犯罪部门正通过检查IP地址详情和其他数字痕迹追查发送者。德利警察局情报融合与战略行动（IFSO）部门也将协助调查。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Nigerian Institute of Journalism Alumni Association (NIJAA) has congratulated Adewale Akodu on his election as the chairman of the Nigeria Union of Journalists (NUJ), Lagos State Council. The association, in a congratulatory letter dated 10 November 2026, issued and signed by its Global Secretary, Dimeji Kayode-Adedeji, said that Mr Akodu, as an alumnus of the institute, is a source of pride for the association. “On behalf of the executive and the entire members of the Nigerian Institute of Journalism Alumni Association (NIJAA), I write to heartily congratulate you on your well-deserved election as Chairman of the Nigeria Union of Journalists (NUJ), Lagos State Council,” Mr Kayode-Adedeji wrote. The letter emphasised that the association is proud that Mr Akodu has been found worthy by his colleagues to have been elected to lead the largest and most vibrant council of the great union. ‘Your victory is not only a personal triumph, but a thing of pride to all of us at NIJAA. That a proud alumnus of the Nigerian Institute of Journalism has been found worthy by colleagues to lead the largest and most vibrant council of the great union is a testimony to your competence, character, humility and years of dedicated service to journalism,” the letter read. “We have noted, with great delight, your acceptance speech and your three-point agenda of welfarism, professionalism and capacity building, as well as your commitment to members’ welfare, dignity, security, regular payment of salaries, improved working conditions and respect for journalists’ rights. These are values the Nigerian Institute of Journalism has always stood for, and we are confident you will live up to them,” he added. “NIJAA assures you of our full support and partnership throughout your tenure. We are ready to collaborate with your executive in the areas of training, mentorship, capacity building, ethical re-orientation and welfare of members, particularly young journalists who look up to leaders like you,” Mr Kayode-Adedeji wrote. “We also urge you to be a chairman for all — to extend a hand of fellowship to all contestants and members, and to run an inclusive, transparent and unifying administration, as you have already promised,” the letter added. “Once again, congratulations, our dear alumnus. We wish you a peaceful, successful and impactful tenure. May your leadership bring renewed pride to the NUJ Lagos State Council and to the NIJ family at large. Please accept the assurances of our highest regards.”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 尼日利亚新闻学院校友会（NIJAA）祝贺Adewale Akodu当选尼日利亚记者工会（NUJ）拉各斯州委员会主席。该会在一份日期为2026年11月10日、由全球秘书Dimeji Kayode-Adedeji签发的贺信中表示，Akodu先生作为该学院校友，是协会的骄傲。Kayode-Adedeji先生写道：“我谨代表尼日利亚新闻学院校友会（NIJAA）执行委员会及全体成员，热切祝贺您光荣当选尼日利亚记者工会（NUJ）拉各斯州委员会主席。”信中强调，协会为Akodu先生获得同僚认可、获选领导这个伟大工会规模最大、最充满活力的委员会感到自豪。信中写道：“您的胜利不仅是个人成就，也是我们所有NIJAA成员的共同骄傲。尼日利亚新闻学院的一名优秀校友获得同僚认可，获选领导这个伟大工会规模最大、最充满活力的委员会，证明了您的能力、品格、谦逊精神以及多年来对新闻事业的奉献。“我们十分欣喜地注意到您的就职演说及以福利保障、专业精神和能力建设为重点的三点议程，也注意到您对成员福利、尊严、安全、及时发放工资、改善工作条件以及维护记者权利所作的承诺。这些始终是尼日利亚新闻学院所坚持的价值观，我们相信您会践行这些价值观。”他补充道：“NIJAA向您保证，在您任期内将给予我们全力支持并与您携手合作。我们愿与您的执行团队在培训、导师指导、能力建设、伦理重塑以及成员福利等领域开展合作，尤其是为像您一样受到年轻记者崇敬的领导者提供支持。”Kayode-Adedeji先生写道：“我们还敦促您成为全体成员共同认可的主席——向所有参与者和成员伸出友好之手，并以包容、透明和团结的方式开展管理工作，正如您已经承诺的那样。”信中补充道：“再次祝贺您，我们亲爱的校友。我们祝愿您任期内平安顺利、富有成效。愿您的领导为NUJ拉各斯州委员会乃至整个NIJ大家庭带来新的骄傲。请接受我们最崇高的敬意。

https://leadership.ng/peter-obi-supporte.summary_zh: 这些抗议者在商用摩托车和三轮车运营商协会（COMTOA）组织下，从Summit Road前往三角洲州警察总部，要求逮捕并起诉对杀害事件负责的人。运营商们举着标语牌，呼吁警方确保正义得到伸张，并坚称他们遇害的同事当时正在从事合法营生。
https://leadership.ng/peter-obi-supporte.body: The protesters, operating under the Commercial Motorcycles and Tricycles Operators Association (COMTOA), marched from Summit Road to the Delta State Police Command headquarters, demanding the arrest and prosecution of those responsible for the killing. Armed with placards, the operators called on the police to ensure that justice was served, insisting that their deceased colleague was carrying out his legitimate business when he was killed. Receiving the protesters at the police headquarters, the Deputy Commissioner of Police, Administration, Philip Adejo, assured the association that the command would investigate the incident and ensure that those found culpable were brought to justice. Adejo, who confirmed receipt of the association’s petition, urged the protesters to remain calm and avoid taking the law into their hands. “We have received your petition. Sometimes self-help can become a serious problem. We sympathise with you; go home and rest because you will see results. It is not going to be like other situations,” he said. He also encouraged the association’s leadership to cooperate with investigators by providing relevant information that could help establish the circumstances surrounding the killing. “Your leaders can meet us, and if you have any strong information concerning this, you can come to us so that we can iron it out together,” Adejo added. Speaking on behalf of the association, a member of its Board of Trustees, Okeoghene Kingsley, described the killing as unjustified, maintaining that the deceased was at his duty post conducting his legitimate business when he was attacked. Kingsley said COMTOA had operated in Delta State for more than 30 years, spanning military administration and successive democratic governments, while consistently promoting discipline and orderliness among its members. He expressed confidence in the police but urged the command to ensure that those responsible for the death were identified and prosecuted. “The young man that was murdered was at his duty post carrying out his legitimate duty, where he met his untimely death. As you have said, we want to believe that we have confidence in the Nigerian Police that they will do justice to this issue and those persons should be brought to book,” he said. The association’s representative further disclosed that members were prepared to assist the police with relevant evidence, including video recordings and information about individuals allegedly involved in the violence. He also rejected any suggestion that the deceased was involved in criminal or political activities, insisting that he was neither an armed robber nor a political thug. “Chinasa has not been an armed robber. He has not been a thug or a political thug. Everybody you are seeing here is going about our lawful duties. Nobody here is a thug,” Kingsley said. He maintained that members of the association were entitled to exercise their constitutional rights to freedom of association and peaceful assembly, including supporting political organisations of their choice, provided they acted within the law. “Everybody here has the right to belong to anybody he likes to belong to because there is freedom of association, which includes lawful assembly,” he added. Kingsley said the association would hold the police to their promise to investigate the killing and ensure that justice was served. The protest followed a violent confrontation on Saturday, November 7, along Nnebisi Road, Asaba, during a procession organised by the Obidient/OK Movement in support of Nigerian Democratic Congress presidential candidate, Peter Obi. The incident reportedly resulted in one death and left five other persons injured. The Delta State Police Command, through its Police Public Relations Officer, SP Bright Edafe, had said it received intelligence indicating a possible outbreak of violence ahead of the procession. According to the police, the organisers were invited to a security meeting and advised against conducting an open street march. However, the command alleged that the organisers disregarded the advice. The Delta State Government also blamed the organisers for failing to comply with the security recommendations, arguing that the violence could have been prevented if the procession had been relocated to a designated venue where adequate security arrangements could be made. However, the Nigerian Democratic Congress rejected the accounts presented by the police and state government, describing the incident as a deliberate attack on opposition supporters. The party called for an independent investigation, the arrest of those responsible and the public disclosure of the identities of those killed and injured. https://leadership.ng/peter-obi-supporte.body_zh: 隶属于商用摩托车和三轮车运营商协会（COMTOA）的抗议者从萨米特路游行至三角洲州警察司令部总部，要求逮捕并起诉对杀害事件负有责任的人。运营商们举着标语牌，呼吁警方确保正义得到伸张，并坚持称他们遇害的同事当时正在从事合法业务。警察行政事务副警长菲利普·阿德乔在警察总部接见抗议者时，向协会保证，警察司令部将调查此事，并确保查明有罪者受到法律制裁。阿德乔确认已收到协会的请愿书，同时敦促抗议者保持冷静，避免私自执法。他说：“我们收到了你们的请愿书。有时自行解决可能演变成严重问题。我们对你们的遭遇深感同情；请回家休息，因为你们将会看到结果。这次不会像其他情况那样。”他还鼓励协会领导层向调查人员提供合作，提供有助于查明遇害事件周围情况的相关信息。阿德乔补充道：“你们的领导可以来见我们，如果你们掌握任何有关此事的可靠信息，也可以来找我们，以便我们共同把事情查清楚。”协会董事会成员奥凯奥吉内·金斯利代表协会发言，将这起杀害事件描述为毫无正当理由，并坚称死者在执勤期间从事合法业务时遭到袭击。金斯利表示，COMTOA在三角洲州运营已有30多年，经历了军政府统治以及历届民主政府，但始终推动成员遵守纪律、维持秩序。他对警方表示有信心，同时敦促警察司令部确保查出并起诉这起死亡事件的责任者。他说：“遇害的年轻人当时正在执勤岗位上履行合法职责，却在那里遭遇了意外身亡。正如你们所说，我们愿意相信尼日利亚警察会公正处理此事，那些人应该被绳之以法。”协会代表进一步透露，成员准备向警方提供相关证据，包括录像以及据称参与暴力事件的人员信息。他还驳斥了任何认为死者参与犯罪或政治活动的说法，强调死者既不是武装劫匪，也不是政治打手。金斯利说：“奇纳萨不是武装劫匪。他不是打手，也不是政治打手。你们在这里看到的每个人都在履行我们的合法职责。这里没有人是打手。”他坚称，协会成员有权行使宪法保障的结社自由和和平集会权利，包括支持自己选择的政治组织，只要他们在法律范围内行动。他补充道：“这里的每个人都有权加入自己喜欢的任何组织，因为享有结社自由，其中包括合法集会。”金斯利表示，协会将监督警方是否履行承诺，调查这起杀害事件并确保正义得到伸张。此次抗议源于11月7日星期六在阿萨巴内内比西路发生的一次暴力冲突。当时，Obidient/OK Movement组织了一场游行，支持尼日利亚民主大会党总统候选人彼得·奥比。报道称，该事件造成1人死亡，另有5人受伤。三角洲州警察司令部通过其警察公共关系官高级警员布赖特·埃达费表示，警方收到情报，显示游行前可能发生暴力事件。警方称，组织者获邀参加安全会议，并被劝阻不要在开放街道上举行游行。然而，警察司令部指控组织者无视了这项建议。三角洲州政府也指责组织者未遵守安全建议，认为如果将游行改至指定场所并在那里采取充分的安全措施，暴力事件本可避免。然而，尼日利亚民主大会党驳斥了警方和州政府的说法，称这起事件是对反对派支持者的蓄意袭击。该党要求展开独立调查、逮捕责任人，并公开披露死伤者的身份。此前，警方曾表示受害者身份尚未确定，但据称对该事件的调查仍在进行。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接推送到你的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，获取全天候最新动态 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 利亚·恩达吉 利亚·法蒂玛·恩达吉是《领导力报》的内容与数字记者，拥有丰富的社交媒体管理经验和三年议会报道经历，将这些经验运用于自己的工作。她的履历涵盖数字内容创作和立法报道，使其处于传统新闻与现代数字叙事的交汇点

https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.summary: Argentines stretched for miles down the Avenida del Libertador, waving the white-and-yellow Vatican flag and pressing against security barriers for a glimpse of the pontiff at the largest event yet of the pope’s 12-day South American tour, and of his 18-month tenure leading the global Catholic Church. https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.summary_zh: 阿根廷人沿着解放者大道绵延数英里，挥舞白黄两色的梵蒂冈旗帜，挤在安保隔离栏前，只为一睹教宗尊容。这是教宗南美12日行程中规模最大的一场活动，也是他领导全球天主教会18个月任期内的最大活动。晴空之下，教宗乘坐敞篷教宗车驶来，街道两旁树木成行，“教皇利奥万岁！”的欢呼声回荡其间。
https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.body: Argentines stretched for miles down the Avenida del Libertador, waving the white-and-yellow Vatican flag and pressing against security barriers for a glimpse of the pontiff at the largest event yet of the pope’s 12-day South American tour, and of his 18-month tenure leading the global Catholic Church. Chants of “Long live Pope Leo!” echoed down the tree-lined street as the pope was driven by in an open-top popemobile under sunny skies. Leo said in his sermon how happy he was to see Catholics in a region that has long been a stronghold for the Church but where it has been losing ground recently to fast-growing evangelical denominations. “It fills my heart with joy to celebrate… with you,” said the pope. “My visit to this land of Argentina has allowed me to see on your faces the enthusiasm of your faith.” Leo, 71, is on an ambitious 50-event, three-country tour less than a month after undergoing lung cancer surgery. He visited Uruguay before arriving in Argentina on Sunday and will travel on to Peru on Wednesday before returning to Rome on November 17. The first US-born pope spent decades as a missionary in Peru and the Vatican has described the tour, one of the most demanding foreign tours by a pope in decades, as a “homecoming”. People had gathered in the early hours of Monday ahead of the Mass. Some normally bustling parts of the city stood near-empty as police cordoned off a security zone. Vendors along the pilgrims’ route were selling souvenirs of the visit, including flags featuring the pope’s face. “I love that (Leo) is visiting us,” said Claudia Pardo, 37, who waited for Leo with her husband and two young children. “It’s a unique, historic moment, and we should listen to his message.” Alejandra Frias, 56, was sleepless after camping out all night to get a front-row view of the pope. “This is an emotional and spiritual moment,” she said. A pope has not visited majority-Catholic Argentina since 1987. Leo has emerged as a forceful voice on the world stage, lamenting what he sees as a failure of global leadership. On his tour he has urged South American nations to set an example of regional cooperation and patient diplomacy instead of conflict. On Sunday, the pope addressed Argentine President Javier Milei, a libertarian seen as a close ally of US President Donald Trump. He urged Milei, who has pushed an austerity agenda that the Church has strongly criticized for cutting social services, to not target Argentina’s poorest. He also told Milei, a theatrical figure known for bombastic statements, that leaders should be careful with their words and know the limits of their power. The pope lamented the difficulties faced by Argentine families at the Mass on Monday. He said they are enduring “instability, social hardship, precarious employment, domestic violence, painful separations and addictions that destroy young people’s futures and damage family relationships.” Ahead of Monday’s Mass, Leo visited a care center for people with disabilities on the southern outskirts of Buenos Aires, where thousands had also gathered in hope of seeing him. Jorge Silanes, religious director of the Pequeño Cottolengo Don Orione center that welcomed Leo, said the visit carried added significance because Milei’s spending cuts have reduced disability benefits while poverty remains widespread. “A nation’s progress is also measured by how it welcomes all people with disabilities and particular needs,” said the pope. https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.title_zh: 教宗利奥赞扬南美教会的坚韧，数百万民众涌上布宜诺斯艾利斯街头
https://leadership.ng/millions-fill-buen.body_zh: 阿根廷人沿着解放者大道绵延数里，挥舞白黄相间的梵蒂冈旗帜，挤压在安保隔离栏前，只为一睹教宗尊容。这是教宗为期12天的南美洲巡访问中迄今规模最大的一场活动，也是他领导全球天主教会18个月任期中的最大一场活动。晴空之下，教宗乘坐敞篷教皇专车驶入林荫街道时，“教皇利奥万岁！”的欢呼声回荡在街道两旁。利奥在布道中说，他看到该地区的天主教徒感到无比高兴；那里长期以来一直是教会的据点，但近年来正被迅速壮大的福音派教派蚕食。“能与你们共同庆祝……我的心充满喜悦，”教宗说。“我对阿根廷这片土地的访问，让我从你们的脸上看到了你们信仰的热情。”现年71岁的利奥正在接受一项雄心勃勃的访问计划，足迹涉及3个国家、50场活动；就在接受肺癌手术不到一个月后，他便开始了此次巡访。他先访问了乌拉圭，随后于星期日抵达阿根廷；星期三将前往秘鲁，并于11月17日返回罗马。这位美国出生的首位教宗曾在秘鲁传教数十年，梵蒂冈将此次行程——近几十年来教宗行程中最繁重的一次海外巡访——称为一次“回家”。星期一凌晨，人们便聚集在弥撒活动现场附近等待。警方划定安全区后，平日熙熙攘攘的部分城区几乎空无一人。朝圣者沿途的商贩正在出售此次访问的纪念品，包括印有教宗肖像的旗帜。37岁的克劳迪娅·帕尔多与丈夫和两个年幼的孩子一起等待利奥，她说：“我很喜欢（利奥）来访我们。这是一个独一无二、具有历史意义的时刻，我们应当聆听他的信息。”56岁的阿莱杭德娅·弗里亚斯为了占据前排观看教宗的位置，整夜在户外露营，无眠难眠。她说：“这是一个充满情感与精神意义的时刻。”自1987年以来，教宗一直没有访问这个天主教徒占多数的阿根廷。利奥已成为世界舞台上一位有力的发声者，对他所见的全球领导失序深表遗憾。巡访期间，他敦促南美洲各国以区域合作和耐心外交作出榜样，而非诉诸冲突。星期日，教宗对阿根廷总统哈维尔·米莱发表讲话。米莱是一名自由意志主义者，被视为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的亲密盟友。教宗敦促推行紧缩政策、削减社会服务并因此遭到教会强烈批评的米莱，不要针对阿根廷最贫困的人群。他还告诫以夸张言辞著称的戏剧化人物米莱，领导人应当谨慎措辞，并了解自身权力的边界。星期一举行弥撒时，教宗为阿根廷家庭所面临的困境深感痛心。他说，这些家庭正在承受“社会不稳定、困苦生活、脆弱就业、家庭暴力、令人痛心的分离，以及摧毁年轻人未来、损害家庭关系的成瘾问题”。星期一弥撒前，利奥探访了布宜诺斯艾利斯南郊的一所残障人士照护中心，数千人也在那里聚集，满怀希望想见到他。接待利奥的佩克尼约·科托伦戈·唐·奥里奥内中心宗教主任豪尔赫·西拉内斯说，此次访问具有更重要的意义，因为米莱削减开支导致残障福利减少，而贫困现象依然普遍。教宗说：“一个国家的进步，也体现在它如何接纳所有残障人士及有特殊需要的人。”利奥任教皇期间此前规模最大的活动发生在今年6月，当时这位教宗访问西班牙，约有120万人湧上马德里街头迎接。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家爆料和独家视角直接送达你的手机。别再满足于过时新闻。加入 LEADERSHIP NEWS WhatsApp 频道，获取全天候最新动态 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111017.body_zh: （全南光州=韩联社）全南光州北区区长申树正10日访问国会，建议在北区设立国会图书馆光州分馆。申区长当天在自己的脸书上发文称：“我已向国会议长办公室递交在北区设立国会图书馆光州分馆的提案书”，并表示：“我提出将原光州监狱用地和中外公园一带作为候选地点。”他说：“这两个候选地点都具有民主、人权与和平的历史象征意义，同时能够与知识、文化和艺术设施相衔接”，并强调：“它们还毗邻东光州、西光州和北光州的里门，便利性十分突出。”申区长表示：“光州7所大学最多的一区是北区，青年人口比例也高达29.9％，对国会图书馆分馆的知识和信息需求十分旺盛”，并补充道：“我将与民亨培全南光州统合特别市长及地方议员沟通，努力推动这一项目落地。”申区长当天还会见了属于国会产业通商资源中小企业委员会的民主党议员郑镇旭，建议在北区建设光州军机场半导体晶圆厂配套的半导体材料、零部件及装备产业园区。报道可通过KakaoTalk okjebo咨询。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止未经许可转载、再发布以及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026/11/10 20:21发布，2026年11月10日20时21分发布

https://leadership.ng/arewa-youth-group-.title: Arewa Youth Group Backs INEC Over Constituency Delineation In 4 States

https://leadership.ng/arewa-youth-group-.summary_zh: 北部青年进步与发展联盟（AYAPD）支持了独立国家选举委员会（INEC），并回应了围绕本努埃州、科吉州、三角洲州和吉加瓦州选区划分及增设投票站的指控。该组织表示，委员会依照最高法院针对相关选区长期法律争议所作出的指令采取行动，并强调其行动以法治原则为指导。
https://leadership.ng/arewa-youth-group-.body: The Arewa Youth Alliance for Progress and Development (AYAPD) has thrown its weight behind the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) over allegations surrounding the delineation of suppressed constituencies and the creation of additional polling units in Benue, Kogi, Delta and Jigawa states. The group said the commission acted in compliance with a Supreme Court directive arising from longstanding legal disputes over the affected constituencies, insisting that its actions were guided by the rule of law. In a statement issued on Monday and signed by its President, Comrade Victor Duniya, AYAPD described the allegations against INEC as baseless, arguing that the electoral body should not be criticised for implementing a legally binding court judgment. Duniya maintained that INEC was only discharging its constitutional responsibilities and deserved commendation for respecting judicial decisions rather than yielding to political pressure. He also defended the commission’s performance under its Chairman, Professor Joash Amupitan, citing elections conducted in several constituencies where opposition candidates reportedly emerged victorious. According to him, the elections were adjudged free, fair and credible by domestic and international observers, while candidates accepted the outcomes in most cases. The AYAPD president said the development demonstrated INEC’s commitment to transparency and impartiality, urging political stakeholders to support efforts to strengthen democratic institutions. He, however, accused some opposition elements of attempting to undermine the electoral body through what he described as unnecessary criticism instead of engaging constructively with the electoral process. Duniya urged political actors to refrain from making allegations capable of eroding public confidence in INEC ahead of the 2027 general elections. He also pledged to mobilise youth support against what he described as attempts to blackmail or weaken the commission, stressing the need to protect the independence of electoral institutions. The presentation is expected to attract government officials, lawmakers, guests, and other stakeholders to witness the unveiling of the proposed budget for the 2027 fiscal year. As at the time of filing this report, lawmakers and guests were gradually converging on the venue, while top government functionaries had also begun arriving for the event. Among those who had arrived were the Deputy Governor of Oyo State, Barrister Bayo Lawal; the Secretary to the State Government, Professor Musibau Babatunde; the Chief of Staff to the Governor, Akinwale Akinwole; and commissioners overseeing the Ministries of Information, Culture and Tourism, Works and Transport, and Health. Other political appointees and government officials were also arriving at the Assembly complex as preparations continued ahead of the formal proceedings. The gathering is still awaiting the arrival of the Speaker of the Oyo State House of Assembly, Adebo Ogundoyin, and Governor Seyi Makinde, whose presence is expected to precede the budget presentation. The 2027 budget presentation is particularly significant, as it will be the last appropriation bill presented by Governor Makinde during his administration. The proposed estimates are expected to outline the government’s revenue projections, expenditure plans, and development priorities for the 2027 fiscal year, with likely attention to key sectors, ongoing projects, and programmes planned for the final year of the administration. https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.title: Cities and businesses drive global climate action, but major gaps remain
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.summary: Climate action led by cities, regional governments, businesses and civil society organisations is making progress in translating global climate commitments into practical action, although significant gaps remain in efforts to address the climate crisis, according to a new report by the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.summary_zh: 联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）的一份新报告称，由城市、地方政府、企业和公民社会组织推动的气候行动，正在将全球气候承诺转化为实际行动，尽管应对气候危机的努力仍存在显著缺口。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.body: Climate action led by cities, regional governments, businesses and civil society organisations is making progress in translating global climate commitments into practical action, although significant gaps remain in efforts to address the climate crisis, according to a new report by the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC). The 2026 Yearbook of Global Climate Action , launched by UN Climate Change on the opening day of the 31st UN Climate Change Conference (COP31) in Antalya, Türkiye, highlights progress across 44 global indicators aligned with the outcomes of the first Global Stocktake under the Paris Agreement. The report points to growing renewable energy capacity, slowing deforestation and increased implementation of various adaptation measures as evidence of momentum in global climate action. However, it identifies persistent gaps, particularly in reducing methane emissions from the oil and gas sector and addressing food loss. It also highlights the absence of global indicators across some important areas as a limitation to tracking progress and strengthening accountability. UN Climate Change Executive Secretary Simon Stiell said the report demonstrates how climate commitments are increasingly translating into tangible outcomes for communities and economies. “This Yearbook shows how businesses, cities, communities, and more are turning global commitments into change that people are seeing, feeling and benefiting from,” he said. Stiell stressed that the pace and scale of implementation must increase, urging countries and stakeholders to use COP31 to expand existing solutions, mobilise climate finance and extend the benefits of climate action to more people. He said the world could and must go much further and faster, adding that COP31 should help scale up solutions, mobilise finance and ensure more people benefit from climate action. Businesses and communities demonstrate growing climate action The 2026 Yearbook presents the latest available data and trends across 96 global socio-economic indicators aligned with the first Global Stocktake. Structured around the six thematic priorities of the COP31 Action Agenda, it examines developments in climate action while highlighting initiatives by businesses, sub-national governments and other non-Party stakeholders. The indicators are intended to strengthen transparency and make it easier to compare progress over time, while identifying areas where implementation is advancing and where additional efforts are needed. The report also draws on a record number of progress reports submitted through the UNFCCC's Non-State Actor Zone for Climate Action (NAZCA), an online platform that tracks climate initiatives undertaken by businesses, organisations, cities, regions and other sub-national governments. A total of 83 Cooperative Climate Initiatives (CCIs) submitted reports detailing more than 200 actions. According to the Yearbook, these self-reported activities demonstrate how collaborative initiatives can measure and showcase concrete results, strengthen transparency and support the wider implementation of climate action. The findings also indicate progress under the Action Agenda's Plans to Accelerate Solutions (PAS), which are multi-stakeholder workplans outlining key actions and voluntary commitments to speed up implementation. After one year of implementation, 84 per cent of the reported PAS initiatives indicated progress, suggesting that the Action Agenda is beginning to translate commitments into implementation. The release of the 2026 Yearbook coincides with the 10th anniversary of the Marrakech Partnership for Global Climate Action, established in 2016 to strengthen collaboration between governments and non-Party stakeholders. The partnership operates under the leadership of the Climate High-Level Champions and provides a platform for governments, cities, regions, businesses and investors to work together on climate action. The initiative builds on the recognition, during the adoption of the Paris Agreement in 2015, of the important contributions that non-Party stakeholders can make towards addressing climate change. At COP29, the mandate of the Climate High-Level Champions was renewed until 2030. A five-year vision covering 2026–2030 was subsequently launched at COP30 to guide their work and accelerate climate action implementation. The partnership is expected to remain an important component of efforts to advance climate solutions alongside formal negotiations between governments. COP31, taking place from 9 to 20 November 2026 in Antalya, Türkiye, is expected to place strong emphasis on accelerating real-economy climate action through the Global Climate Action Agenda. The agenda is designed to complement the formal negotiation process by supporting practical implementation among governments and non-Party stakeholders. Unlike previous editions, the 2026 Yearbook has been launched in a new online format. UN Climate Change says the publication will be updated to reflect key outcomes on Global Climate Action emerging from COP31. Published annually, the Yearbook provides an assessment of progress and gaps in global climate action, while documenting concrete initiatives by non-Party stakeholders to encourage wider participation and raise ambition
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.title_zh: 城市和企业推动全球气候行动
https://www.myjoyonline.com/cities-and-b.body_zh:
联合国气候变化框架公约（UNFCCC）最新发布的一份报告显示，由城市、区域政府、企业和公民社会组织推动的气候行动，正在将全球气候承诺转化为切实行动，尽管应对气候危机的努力仍存在显著缺口。联合国气候变化组织于2026年11月9日在土耳其安塔利亚举行的第31届联合国气候变化大会（COP31）开幕当天发布了《2026年全球气候行动年鉴》。年鉴突显了与《巴黎协定》首次全球盘点成果相对应的44项全球指标的进展。报告指出，可再生能源装机容量增长、毁林速度放缓以及各项适应措施落实力度加大，均表明全球气候行动正在积蓄动力。然而，报告也指出一些持续存在的缺口，尤其是减少石油和天然气行业甲烷排放以及应对食物损耗方面的工作仍然不足。报告还强调，一些重要领域缺乏全球指标，这是追踪进展和加强问责的一项局限。联合国气候变化执行秘书Simon Stiell表示，这份报告表明，气候承诺正日益转化为为社区和经济带来实际成果。他说：“这本年鉴展示了企业、城市、社区等各方如何将全球承诺转化为人们看得见、感受得到并从中受益的变化。”Stiell强调，落实工作的速度和规模必须加快，敦促各国和相关方利用COP31扩大现有解决方案、调动气候融资，并让更多人从气候行动中受益。他说，世界能够而且必须采取更大力度的行动、加快推进步伐，COP31应帮助推广解决方案、调动资金，并确保更多人受益于气候行动。

企业和社区推动的气候行动日益加强

《2026年全球气候行动年鉴》呈现了与首次全球盘点相对应的96项全球社会经济指标的最新可用数据和趋势。报告以COP31行动议程的六项主题优先事项为框架，考察气候行动的进展情况，同时重点介绍企业、地方政府和其他非缔约方利益相关者的倡议。这些指标旨在加强透明度，使不同时期的进展更易于比较，同时找出落实工作取得进展和仍需加大努力的领域。

报告还采用了通过UNFCCC气候行动非国家行为体专区（NAZCA）提交的数量创纪录的进展报告。NAZCA是一个在线平台，用于追踪企业、组织、城市、地区及其他地方政府开展的气候倡议。共有83项合作气候倡议（CCIs）提交了报告，详细说明了200多项行动。年鉴称，这些自行报告的活动表明，协作倡议能够衡量并展示具体成果、加强透明度，并支持更广泛落实气候行动。

研究结果还显示，行动议程中的《加快解决方案计划》（PAS）取得进展。这些计划由多方利益相关者共同制定，列明关键行动和自愿承诺，以加快落实工作。实施一年后，84%的已报告PAS倡议取得进展，表明行动议程正开始将承诺转化为实际行动。

《2026年全球气候行动年鉴》的发布恰逢《马拉喀什全球气候行动伙伴关系》实施10周年。该伙伴关系于2016年设立，旨在加强政府与非缔约方利益相关者之间的合作。伙伴关系由气候高级别 Champions 领导，为政府、城市、地区、企业和投资者协同开展气候行动提供平台。这项倡议以2015年通过《巴黎协定》时形成的共识为基础，即非缔约方利益相关者能够为应对气候变化作出重要贡献。在COP29上，气候高级别 Champions 的授权延长至2030年。此后，涵盖2026年至2030年的五年愿景在COP30上发布，以指导其工作并加快气候行动的落实。

预计该伙伴关系仍将是推动气候解决方案的重要组成部分，并与各国政府之间的正式谈判相互配合。COP31将于2026年11月9日至20日在土耳其安塔利亚举行，预计将通过《全球气候行动议程》大力强调加快现实经济领域的气候行动。该议程旨在通过支持政府和非缔约方利益相关者切实落实行动，与正式谈判进程形成互补。

与以往版本不同，《2026年全球气候行动年鉴》采用了全新的在线形式发布。联合国气候变化组织表示，将对出版物进行更新，纳入COP31在气候行动方面取得的主要成果。年鉴每年发布一次，既评估全球气候行动的进展和缺口，也记录非缔约方利益相关者采取的具体倡议，以鼓励更广泛参与并提高气候行动雄心

Unlock these with Subscription Union Minister for Ports, Shipping and Waterways Sarbananda Sonowal on Tuesday (November 10, 2026) inaugurated a cruise service on the Yamuna at Sonia Vihar. The project is being developed to promote river-based tourism along the Yamuna stretch upstream of the Wazirabad barrage. The cruise will operate between Sonia Vihar and Jagatpur, covering a stretch of around 4-5 km, with each ride lasting approximately 40 minutes. The ticket has been priced at ₹500 per person. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta said the cruise would bring people closer to the Yamuna, giving Delhi residents an opportunity to enjoy experiences for which they often travel to other cities. Speaking at the event, she said recreational activities, along with light-and-sound shows and the cruise service, would provide people an opportunity to spend quality time with their families. Minister of State for Ports, Shipping and Waterways Shantanu Thakur, Delhi BJP president Harsh Malhotra and other cabinet ministers were also present at the inauguration. Union Minister Sonowal highlighted India's achievements over the past 12 years, particularly in the development of waterways, saying the country had made significant progress in the sector. He praised Delhi Chief Minister Gupta's leadership, saying the national capital was developing at a rapid pace despite the government being in office for a relatively short period. An official said each ride will accommodate a maximum of 30 passengers, while tickets will be available online through the Delhi Tourism website. The service is aimed at offering residents and tourists a new way to experience the city and its riverfront. The Inland Waterways Authority of India (IWAI) and Delhi government agencies signed an agreement in March 2025 to develop cruise tourism on a 4-km stretch between Sonia Vihar and Jagatpur. Ahead of the launch, trial runs of the cruise vessel were successfully conducted last month in the presence of senior officials from the IWAI and the Delhi government. The boats will be equipped with inboard bio-toilets with zero discharge, an announcement system and safety jackets. The operator will be responsible for ensuring a safe, reliable and comfortable service, including the safety of passengers, crew members and other river users. The air-conditioned boats will be either leased or owned and should not be more than two years old. The operator will also be required to run a minimum of four trips per day. Unlock these with Subscription Congress leader and Rajya Sabha Member Sonia Gandhi has a memoir coming out this fall in which she will reflect on the promise and the tragedy of marrying into India’s Nehru-Gandhi political dynasty and on her own career in government. Publishing house Alfred A. Knopf announced on Tuesday (August 18, 2026) that Ms. Gandhi’s “Belonging: A Journey of Love” will be published on November 10. “Much has been written about my family, but few narratives were able to reach into the truth of their motivations, their actions and even their very human failings,” Ms. Gandhi said in a statement issued through Knopf. “In many ways, this book is a homage to their humanness. My story also offers readers a unique perspective of the social and political changes I have witnessed for six decades in the beautiful country of my belonging.” Ms. Gandhi, 79, is a native of Italy who was studying in Cambridge, England, when she met fellow student and future husband Rajiv Gandhi, grandson of India’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, and son of India’s first female Prime Minister, Indira Gandhi. In Belonging , she writes of her life being upended when her mother-in-law was assassinated in 1984 and succeeded by Rajiv Gandhi, who was also murdered seven years later. She too would eventually enter politics and become the longest-serving president of the Indian National Congress Party while also turning down her party’s offer to become Prime Minister. Her party lost power to Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in 2014. “It was heartbreak and loss that threw me into the public world of politics. Up till then I had guarded my privacy fiercely,” she said in her statement. “Writing about my life did not come easily to me. It meant opening myself up, sharing moments and experiences I had always held deep inside,” she said. “Yet as I gradually removed myself from the political sphere and looked back at all I had seen, the thread of love and loyalty that wove through my story began to define itself, from the simplicity of my childhood in small-town Italy, to the complexity of my years in India as the wife of Rajiv Gandhi and the daughter-in-law of Prime Minister Indira Gandhi.” Indian National Congress / politics / books and literature / controversial books Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/s.body_zh: 订阅还可享受《The Hindu》故事、专栏、观点等高级内容。订阅国会议会领袖、印度联邦院议员索尼娅·甘地将在今秋出版回忆录，书中她将回顾嫁入印度尼赫鲁—甘地政治世家后的希望与悲剧，以及自己在政府中的仕途。出版机构阿尔弗雷德·A·克诺普周二（2026年8月18日）宣布，甘地女士的《归属：爱之旅》将于11月10日出版。甘地女士通过克诺普发表的声明称：“关于我的家庭，人们已经写了很多，但很少有叙述能够触及他们行为的动机、行动，甚至他们作为一个人的缺点真相。”“在很多方面，这本书是对他们人性的致敬。我的故事也为读者提供了一个独特视角，让人看到六十年间，在我归属的这个美丽国家里，我所见证的社会和政治变革。”现年79岁的甘地女士出生于意大利。她在英国剑桥求学时遇见了同学、未来丈夫拉杰夫·甘地。拉杰夫·甘地、印度首任总理贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁的孙子，也是印度首任女总理英迪拉·甘地之子。在《归属》中，她写下自己的 life 在婆婆于1984年遇刺后被彻底颠覆，随后拉杰夫·甘地接任首相，但七年后也遭杀害。她后来同样踏入政坛，成为印度国民大会党任职时间最长的主席，并拒绝了党内让她出任总理的提议。2014年，她的政党在选举中败给印度人民党（BJP）。她说：“是心碎与失去把我推向公共政治舞台。在那之前，我始终严格保护自己的隐私。”“动笔书写我的一生对我而言并不容易。这意味着我要敞开心扉，分享那些一直深藏在内心的时刻和经历。”“然而，当逐渐退出政治领域并回顾自己所见的一切时，爱与忠诚这条贯穿我人生的线开始显现出来。它从我童年在意大利小城生活的纯朴，一直延伸到我作为拉杰夫·甘地之妻、印度总理英迪拉·甘地之媳在印度岁月的复杂。”印度国民大会党／政治／图书与文学／争议性书籍 评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子书写；不得包含辱骂性或针对个人的内容。发布评论时请遵守我们的社区准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你是《The Hindu》的注册用户且已登录，可以继续参与文章讨论。如果没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以查看以前在Vuukle上发表的评论。

https://leadership.ng/information-minist.summary: Responding to concerns raised by BON over the rising cost of operating broadcast stations, the Minister reaffirmed the federal government’s commitment to creating a conducive environment for the growth and sustainability of the industry. “Any increase in licence fees is hereby put on hold.
https://leadership.ng/information-minist.summary_zh: 针对广播公司协会（BON）提出的广播电视台运营成本上升问题，这位部长重申联邦政府致力于营造有利于该行业发展和可持续经营的环境。“任何上调许可证费用的措施现已暂缓执行。
https://leadership.ng/information-minist.body: Idris announced the decision in Abuja when he received a delegation of the Broadcasting Organisations of Nigeria (BON), led by its Chairman, Senior High Chief Dr Tony Akiotu, following the organisation’s 82nd General Assembly. Responding to concerns raised by BON over the rising cost of operating broadcast stations, the Minister reaffirmed the federal government’s commitment to creating a conducive environment for the growth and sustainability of the industry. “Any increase in licence fees is hereby put on hold. All reviews relating to licences are suspended until further notice. I am directing the NBC to ensure strict compliance while we review the situation,” he said. The minister also directed the Director-General of the National Broadcasting Commission (NBC) to expedite the review of the National Broadcasting Code to ensure that the regulatory framework reflects developments and emerging realities in the broadcasting industry. On the Digital Switch-Over (DSO), Idris promised to convene a stakeholders’ meeting to address outstanding issues affecting the programme. Addressing BON’s request for the enforcement of the 45-day payment period for advertising services, the minister disclosed that he had already directed the Advertising Regulatory Council of Nigeria (ARCON) to ensure full implementation of the policy. He further assured the delegation that the ministry would engage relevant stakeholders on concerns relating to access to affordable financing and spectrum allocation. Idris emphasised the critical role of broadcasting in strengthening democracy, promoting national cohesion and ensuring that citizens have access to credible and accurate information. He urged broadcasters to uphold the highest standards of professionalism, fairness and ethical journalism, particularly as the country prepares for the 2027 general elections. “Freedom of expression must go with responsibility. You cannot simply say anything and claim to be practising journalism. Journalism has standards, procedures and ethics. I urge broadcasters to ensure that what they report is factual, responsible and promotes national unity and peaceful coexistence,” the minister said. Earlier, BON chairman, Akiotu, commended the minister for his intervention during the June 2026 DSO launch, noting that the stakeholders’ meeting he convened helped address concerns about ensuring a level playing field for operators. Akiotu identified several challenges confronting the industry, including the review of the National Broadcasting Code, broadcast licence fees, rising operational costs, access to financing, spectrum allocation and the implementation of the 45-day advertising payment period. “BON believes in dialogue, consultation and mediation to prevent a breakdown of industrial harmony in the broadcasting industry. We are grateful for your personal intervention during the DSO launch and seek your continued support in addressing the challenges affecting our members,” he said. The minister congratulated BON on the successful hosting of its 82nd General Assembly in Calabar, Cross River State, and reiterated the federal government’s commitment to sustained dialogue and collaboration with broadcasting stakeholders to strengthen the industry and promote its long-term development. https://leadership.ng/information-minist.title_zh: 信息部长暂停审查广播牌照费
https://leadership.ng/information-minist.body_zh: 伊德里斯在阿布贾接见由主席、高级酋长托尼·阿基奥图博士率领的尼日利亚广播组织（BON）代表团后宣布了这一决定。此次会面是在该组织举行第82届大会之后进行的。针对BON提出的广播站运营成本不断上升等关切，这位部长再次确认了联邦政府致力于营造有利环境，推动广播行业增长和可持续发展的承诺。他说：“现决定暂停任何广播许可证费的上涨。在另行通知前，所有与许可证有关的审查均予暂停。我已指示NBC在审查局势期间确保严格遵守规定。”部长还指示国家广播委员会（NBC）总司长加快审查《国家广播守则》，确保监管框架反映广播行业的发展和新出现的实际情况。在数字转换（DSO）方面，伊德里斯承诺召集利益相关方会议，处理影响该计划的遗留问题。针对BON要求执行广告服务45天付款期的请求，部长透露，他已经指示尼日利亚广告监管委员会（ARCON）确保该政策得到全面落实。他进一步向代表团保证，部里将就获得可负担融资和频谱分配等关切与相关利益方磋商。伊德里斯强调，广播在巩固民主、促进国家凝聚力以及确保公民能够获得可信、准确的信息方面发挥着关键作用。他敦促广播机构坚守最高标准的专业精神、公平原则和新闻伦理，特别是在该国筹备2027年大选之际。他说：“言论自由必须与责任相伴。不能随口说什么都说是实践新闻业。新闻业有标准、程序和伦理。我敦促广播机构确保其报道内容符合事实、负责任，并促进国家统一与和平共处。”此前，BON主席阿基奥图赞扬部长在2026年6月DSO启动期间所作的干预，并指出部长召集的利益相关方会议有助于解决确保运营商公平竞争环境等方面的关切。阿基奥图列举了行业面临的若干挑战，包括审查《国家广播守则》、广播许可证费、运营成本上升、融资渠道、频谱分配以及落实广告45天付款期等。他说：“BON相信对话、协商和调解有助于防止广播行业产业和谐破裂。我们感谢您在DSO启动期间亲自介入，并寻求您继续支持，以解决影响我们成员的挑战。”部长祝贺BON在克罗罗州卡拉巴尔成功举办第82届大会，并再次重申联邦政府将与广播行业利益相关方持续开展对话与合作，以加强该行业并促进其长期发展。我们掌握独家优势。实时报道、独家内幕和独家视角将直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，接收全天候最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 桑松·伊莱亚 桑松·伊莱亚是《Leadership Newspaper》记者，专攻政治报道和公共事务分析。他因深入进行专题分析、超越表面报道而广受认可，在负责领域内赢得了值得信赖和权威的声音

https://www.inquirer.net/495164/robredo-.summary: READ: Sara Duterte, Leni Robredo gap narrows in Octa presidential survey The Robredo-Tulfo tandem was ahead by four percentage points, just above the ±3 percent margin of error. According to Octa, the four-point lead “is slight, and neither tandem commands majority support.” The Robredo-Tulfo tandem posted its strongest showing in Balance Luzon, with 61 percent against 19 percent for Duterte-Padilla.
https://www.inquirer.net/495164/robredo-.summary_zh: 阅读：Octa总统民调显示，莎拉·杜特尔特与莱尼·罗布雷多之间的差距在10月缩小。罗布雷多—图尔福组合领先4个百分点，略高于正负3个百分点的误差范围。Octa表示，4个百分点的领先“幅度较小，两组搭档均未获得过半支持”。罗布雷多—图尔福组合在Balance Luzon取得最佳成绩，得票率为61%，杜特尔特—帕迪利亚组合为19%。
https://www.inquirer.net/495164/robredo-.body: According to the survey, conducted from Sept. 28 to Oct. 4, 43 percent of adult Filipinos said they would vote for the Robredo-Tulfo tandem. Meanwhile, 39 percent said they would choose the Duterte-Padilla tandem, while 18 percent chose neither tandem or said they did not know. This is the first time Octa has conducted a survey on the pairing. “There are no earlier OCTA data on this pairing, so the figures serve as a baseline against which future survey waves can be compared,” it said. At least 1,200 adult Filipinos nationwide were surveyed through face-to-face interviews. The survey had a ±3 percent margin of error and a 95 percent confidence level. READ: Sara Duterte, Leni Robredo gap narrows in Octa presidential survey The Robredo-Tulfo tandem was ahead by four percentage points, just above the ±3 percent margin of error. According to Octa, the four-point lead “is slight, and neither tandem commands majority support.” The Robredo-Tulfo tandem posted its strongest showing in Balance Luzon, with 61 percent against 19 percent for Duterte-Padilla. Support for the tandem reached 69 percent in North Luzon and 53 percent in South Luzon, while 28 percent were uncommitted. They also led in the National Capital Region, with 49 percent against 32 percent, while 18 percent were uncommitted. The Duterte-Padilla tandem posted its strongest showing in Mindanao, where it received 81 percent support, compared with only 4 percent for the Robredo-Tulfo pairing. The two tandems were closely divided in the Visayas, with 43 percent supporting Duterte-Padilla and 41 percent backing Robredo-Tulfo. By socioeconomic class, about four in five adults in Class D were evenly split between the two pairs, with each receiving 41 percent. “The Robredo–Tulfo tandem leads in the smaller Classes ABC and E, and within Class D the two tandems split along the D1 and D2 segments, but these gaps are modest compared with the regional and ethnolinguistic ones,” it explained. Octa noted that the results remained a “snapshot and baseline” and were likely to change, particularly because the Davao City mayor had not yet declared a presidential bid. Meanwhile, Robredo reiterated on Monday that she would not seek any national post in the May 2028 elections. Your subscription could not be saved. Please try again. https://www.inquirer.net/495164/robredo-.title_zh: 罗布雷多—图尔福组合在Octa模拟的2028年大选中领先
https://www.inquirer.net/495164/robredo-.body_zh: 根据9月28日至10月4日开展的调查，43%的菲律宾成年人表示会投票支持罗夫雷多—图尔福组合。与此同时，39%表示会选择杜特尔特—帕迪利亚组合，另有18%两组合都不选或表示不知道。这是Octa首次就总统候选人搭档组合开展调查。调查称：“此前没有关于这一搭档组合的OCTA数据，因此这些数字可作为基准，供未来各轮调查比较。”调查通过面对面访谈覆盖了全国至少1,200名菲律宾成年人。调查误差范围为±3%，置信度为95%。阅读：Octa总统候选人调查显示，莎拉·杜特尔特与莱尼·罗夫雷多的差距缩小。罗夫雷多—图尔福组合领先4个百分点，仅略高于±3%的误差范围。Octa表示，两组搭档的4个百分点差距“很小，双方都未获得多数支持”。罗夫雷多—图尔福组合在中吕宋表现最佳，支持率为61%，杜特尔特—帕迪利亚组合为19%。该组合在北吕宋的支持率达到69%，在南吕宋为53%，另有28%的受访者尚未决定支持对象。两组搭档也领先于首都大区，支持率分别为49%和32%，另有18%的受访者尚未决定支持对象。杜特尔特—帕迪利亚组合在棉兰老表现最佳，获得81%的支持率，罗夫雷多—图尔福组合则仅为4%。在米沙鄢，两组搭档支持率接近，杜特尔特—帕迪利亚组合获得43%支持，罗夫雷多—图尔福组合获得41%支持。按社会经济阶层划分，D类成年人中约每5人就有4人在两组搭档之间 evenly split，双方支持率均为41%。调查解释称：“罗夫雷多—图尔福组合在较小的ABC类和E类中领先，在D类中，两组搭档的支持率分别集中于D1和D2群体，但与各地区及族群语言群体之间的差距相比，这些差距并不显著。”Octa指出，调查结果仍是“一幅快照和一个基准”，很可能发生变化，尤其是达沃市市长尚未宣布参选总统。与此同时，罗夫雷多周一再次表示，她不会在2028年5月选举中竞选任何全国性职位。您的订阅无法保存，请重试。您的订阅已成功保存。Octa表示：“由于领先优势较小、尚未决定支持对象的选民占比较大，而且副总统莎拉·杜特尔特的弹劾审判仍未了结，这一对决目前仍是一个早期且开放的基准，而不能被视为对2028年5月选举结果的预测。”/mcm

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Cabinet approves expanded deployment despite Tehran's objections Korea is facing a diplomatic challenge in convincing Iran that the Cheonghae Unit’s expanded mission closer to the Strait of Hormuz is not an intervention in the ongoing U.S.-Iran war, as the Middle Eastern country warned Korea could be “portrayed as an accomplice” of U.S. military attacks. Although Korea’s defense authorities reiterated that the unit's expanded duties do not cover the strait but rather are aimed at protecting Korean vessels from piracy, experts say it seems Seoul’s message has not been delivered as intended. This raises concerns that Iran could view the move as entry into the war and lead to potential clashes. The concerns come after Iranian foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei delivered a briefing on Monday (local time). “South Korea should keep itself away from entering into an issue that is already complicated enough,” Baghaei said, according to local media reports. "It should refrain from deploying military forces to the region under the name of supporting the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz." He noted that Tehran and Seoul have maintained relations for more than 60 years based on mutual respect and shared interests. “The Iranian people do not expect countries other than the United States, the Zionist regime and their allies to join their military aggression against Iran,” Baghaei added, using the term "Zionist regime” to refer to Israel. He expressed hope that Korea "will not be portrayed as an accomplice of U.S. military aggression," and that "Korea and the international community will pay attention to wide and harmful impacts that the illegal activities by the U.S. and Israel could bring about." Tehran’s warning came hours after Defense Minister Kang Shin-chul rejected criticism and concerns that expanding the Cheonghae Unit’s operation area from the Gulf of Aden to waters south of Oman could provide a backdoor to deploy forces to the Hormuz Strait. “We have clearly stated our principle of noninvolvement and noninterference in the war,” Kang said at a parliamentary National Defense Committee meeting. He added that Korea would retain its own command structure and that the expansion is intended to protect Korean service members, nationals and vessels, citing a more than threefold increase in pirate activity. Korea's foreign ministry did not clarify whether it delivered its stance on the Cheonghae Unit issue to Iran before or after the mission expansion announcement. He also stressed that the purpose of the extended mission is to protect Korean nationals and economic interests, under the principle of noninvolvement and nonintervention in the war. Analysts found the defense and foreign ministries’ explanations insufficient to reassure Tehran of Seoul’s commitment to avoid involvement in the conflict in the strait. “It is unclear whether Seoul adequately explained the Cheonghae Unit’s expanded mission to Tehran before announcing it,” a researcher at a private think tank said on condition of anonymity. Kwak Jin-o, a research professor at Pai Chai University, also warned of the risks posed by differing perceptions of the deployment. “Seoul needs to make sure Iran understands that Korea is staying out of the war,” he said. “Activities such as supporting other countries’ operations could send a different message to Tehran and increase the risk of an accidental clash.” On Tuesday, the Cabinet approved a motion at its weekly meeting to extend the unit’s deployment area. The proposal will be submitted to the National Assembly shortly after the remaining procedures are completed
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 【封面报道】伊朗的警告表明，首尔为清海任务开展的外交努力仍不够充分
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 尽管德黑兰提出反对，韩国内阁仍批准扩大部署行动。韩国在说服伊朗方面面临外交挑战：韩国清海部队扩大后的任务地点更接近霍尔木兹海峡，但这并不意味着介入正在进行的美国与伊朗战争。这个中东国家警告称，韩国可能会被描绘成美国军事袭击的“帮凶”。尽管韩国国防部门重申，该部队扩大后的职责不涉及这条海峡，而是旨在保护韩国船只免遭海盗袭击，但专家认为，首尔的表态似乎没有按预期传达给伊朗。这引发了对伊朗可能将此举视为参战并导致潜在冲突的担忧。伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加埃周一（当地时间）举行记者会并作出上述说明。据当地媒体报道，巴加埃说：“韩国应当远离这个已经足够复杂的问题。”“韩国不应以支持霍尔木兹海峡重新开放为名，向该地区部署军队。”他指出，德黑兰与首尔60多年来一直保持相互尊重和共同利益基础上的关系。巴加埃补充说：“伊朗人民不期待除美国、犹太复国主义政权及其盟友之外的其他国家加入针对伊朗的军事侵略。”他用“犹太复国主义政权”一词指代以色列。他表示，希望韩国“不会被描绘成美国军事侵略的帮凶”，并希望“韩国和国际社会将关注美国和以色列的非法活动可能带来的广泛而有害的影响”。德黑兰发出警告数小时后，国防部长姜成烈驳斥了有关扩大清海部队行动区域、从亚丁湾延伸至阿曼以南水域可能为向霍尔木兹海峡部署兵力提供后门的批评和担忧。姜成烈在国会国防委员会会议上说：“我们已经清楚说明了我们不介入和不干涉战争的立场。”他补充说，韩国将保留自己的指挥架构，扩大行动旨在保护韩国军人、国民和船只，并援引海盗活动增加三倍多的情况。韩国外交部没有说明，在宣布扩大任务之前还是之后向伊朗传达了有关清海部队问题的立场。他还强调，根据不介入和不干涉战争的原则，延长任务的目的是保护韩国国民和经济利益。分析人士认为，国防部和外交部的解释不足以让德黑兰放心，无法确信首尔会避免介入该海峡的冲突。一家私营智库的研究员在匿名条件下说：“尚不清楚首尔是否在宣布清海部队扩大任务之前，向德黑兰充分解释了相关情况。”培材大学研究教授郭振浩也警告说，双方对部署行动的看法不同会带来风险。他说：“首尔需要确保伊朗理解，韩国不会参战。”“支持其他国家开展行动等行为可能向德黑兰传递不同的信息，并增加意外冲突的风险。”周二，内阁在每周会议上批准了一项延长该部队部署区域的动议。完成其余程序后，该提案将很快提交国会。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: A former U.S. diplomat said Tuesday that the envisioned transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) from Washington to Seoul may not move forward swiftly, citing "no consensus" on the key alliance issue in the United States. Speaking virtually at a forum, Joseph Yun, former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea and special representative for North Korea, also said that there is no consensus in Washington over Seoul's push to secure rights to enrich uranium for peaceful civilian purposes and acquire nuclear submarines. Yun offered his forecasts over what will happen during the remaining two years of U.S. President Donald Trump's administration, particularly in the wake of this month's U.S. midterm elections, in which Democrats won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives. "I cannot imagine (the OPCON transfer efforts) moving very rapidly," Yun said during the forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Parliamentarians' Union. "Same thing with nuclear issues. There is no consensus in Washington that Korea ought to have enrichment or nuclear submarines." South Korea and the U.S. have been working on the "conditions-based" OPCON transfer without a target year for the transition. Seoul wants to retake wartime OPCON before the five-year term of President Lee Jae Myung's administration ends in 2030, while Washington highlights the importance of fulfilling the conditions for the transfer. The allies have also agreed on bilateral cooperation on the uranium enrichment issue, as well as the nuclear submarine project, as stipulated in a joint fact sheet released last year to outline bilateral summit agreements between Lee and Trump. Commenting on the OPCON transfer efforts, Yun raised concerns that the transition could weaken the bilateral alliance, arguing that South Korea views the transfer as a "political" issue while it is a "technical" issue in the U.S. "In South Korea, people want to have the OPCON back with no weakening of the alliance. That is impossible," he said. "Of course, if the Korean capability is so great, a little bit of weakening of the alliance is OK. Then, that's OK. But that's a political decision South Korea has to make." His remarks appear to align with a view that after the U.S. transfers wartime OPCON to Seoul, its security burden would lessen, potentially weakening its military commitment to the Asian ally — a development that some say could be offset by South Korea's growing military capabilities. In Seoul, the OPCON transfer has long been a divisive issue. Proponents say that the transfer is equated with the "restoration" of the country's "military sovereignty," while opponents argue that the transfer could undercut the bilateral alliance amid North Korea's evolving nuclear threats. South Korea handed over operational control of its troops to the U.S.-led U.N. Command during the 1950-53 Korean War. It was then transferred to the allies' Combined Forces Command when the command was launched in 1978. Seoul retook peacetime OPCON in 1994, but wartime OPCON still remains in U.S. hands
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 前美国外交官称，OPCON移交可能进展缓慢，并援引华盛顿“未达成共识”的说法
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名前美国外交官周二表示，将战时作战指挥权（OPCON）从华盛顿移交给首尔的设想可能无法迅速推进，原因是美国国内在这一关键盟友问题上“尚未形成共识”。曾任美国驻韩国代办、朝鲜问题特别代表的约瑟夫·云在一场线上论坛上说，对于首尔争取获得和平民用铀浓缩权利以及采购核潜艇的努力，华盛顿同样没有共识。云就美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本届政府任期剩余两年内可能发生的情况作出预测，尤其是美国本月中期选举之后的前景；在此次选举中，民主党赢得了参议院和众议院的控制权。约瑟夫·云在韩国—美国议员联盟主办论坛上说：“我无法想象（移交OPCON的努力）会非常迅速地推进。”“核问题也是如此。华盛顿尚未就是否应当让韩国拥有浓缩能力或核潜艇形成共识。”韩国和美国一直在推进以“条件”为基础的OPCON移交，但尚未设定过渡的目标年份。首尔希望在李在明总统本届政府五年任期于2030年结束前收回战时OPCON，而华盛顿则强调完成移交条件的重要性。根据去年发布的一份联合情况说明书，双方还就铀浓缩问题以及核潜艇项目达成双边合作协议；该文件旨在说明李在明与特朗普举行双边峰会时达成的协议。约瑟夫·云在评论OPCON移交努力时提出担忧，认为这一过渡可能削弱双边联盟。他指出，韩国将移交视为“政治”问题，而美国则将其视为“技术”问题。他说：“在韩国，人们希望收回OPCON，同时不削弱联盟。这是不可能的。”“当然，如果韩国的能力足够强，联盟受到一点削弱也可以接受。那样也可以。但这是韩国必须作出的政治决定。”他的言论似乎与这样一种看法相符：美国将战时OPCON移交给首尔后，其安全负担将有所减轻，进而可能削弱其对这个亚洲盟友的军事投入——一些人认为，韩国不断增强的军事能力可以抵消这一影响。在首尔，OPCON移交长期是一个存在分歧的问题。支持者认为，移交等同于“恢复”该国的“军事主权”；反对者则称，在朝鲜核威胁不断演变的背景下，移交可能削弱双边联盟。1950年至1953年朝鲜战争期间，韩国将其部队的作战指挥权移交给美国主导的联合国军司令部。1978年该司令部成立时，指挥权随后移交给了盟国的联合部队司令部。首尔于1994年收回和平时期OPCON，但战时OPCON仍掌握在美国手中

https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.summary_zh: 在中尼合作框架下，中华人民共和国商务部将于2026年11月10日至30日在北京举办面向尼日尔新闻官员和记者的研讨会。该研讨会属于面向发展中国家官员的培训项目，纳入中国对外援助项目，并得到中国领导人的积极支持。
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.body: Dans le cadre de la coopération sino-nigérienne, le Ministère du Commerce de la République Populaire de Chine organise du 10 au 30 novembre 2026, à Pékin, un séminaire dédié aux fonctionnaires de l’information et aux journalistes du Niger. Ce séminaire s’inscrit dans le cadre des programmes de formation destinés aux fonctionnaires des pays en développement, des programmes relevant de l’aide extérieure chinoise et activement encouragés par les dirigeants chinois. Ces échanges et des discussions visent à renforcer l’amitié traditionnelle entre la Chine et le Niger, promouvoir la coopération dans le domaine des médias ainsi que dans d’autres domaines, et contribuer au développement des ressources humaines, de l’économie et de la société. La cérémonie d’ouverture a été présidée par M. ZHU Zhongshu, Directeur adjoint du Centre d’études internationales et de formation du CICG, en présence du chef de la délégation nigérienne, M. Abdoulaye Tiémogo, Conseiller spécial du Président de la République du Niger, responsable de la Cellule de communication de la Présidence. Dans un contexte mondial marqué par la bataille de l’information et la nécessité pour les États du Sud de faire entendre leur propre narratif, cette formation prend tout son sens. Pour le Niger engagé dans une nouvelle dynamique au sein de la Confédération des États du Sahel, la maîtrise de l’information et la professionnalisation des acteurs des médias constituent un enjeu de souveraineté. Le programme est riche et diversifié. Il comprend des conférences thématiques sur les politiques publiques chinoises, le modèle de développement économique et les stratégies de communication, des discussions spécialisées entre professionnels chinois et nigériens sur les défis communs du secteur de l’information, des visites d’étude dans des villes chinoises au sein de groupes de presse, d’entreprises technologiques et d’institutions médiatiques, ainsi que des expériences culturelles pour permettre aux participants de découvrir la richesse historique et culturelle de la Chine. Un programme qui vise à présenter les politiques et expériences de développement de la Chine tout en offrant aux participants nigériens une immersion complète dans l’évolution des médias chinois, de la presse traditionnelle aux nouveaux médias numériques. Ce séminaire témoigne une fois de plus de la vitalité de la coopération entre Niamey et Pékin, une coopération qui se diversifie au-delà des infrastructures pour s’étendre au capital humain et au secteur stratégique de l’information. Il illustre la volonté des deux pays de bâtir un partenariat durable fondé non seulement sur les investissements matériels mais aussi sur le partage de connaissances. Dans son mot de bienvenue, M. ZHU Zhongshu a salué la présence de la délégation nigérienne, soulignant que malgré l’hiver qui s’installe à Beijing, leur présence apporte une chaleur particulière à la rencontre. Il a rappelé que les relations sino-nigériennes poursuivent leur développement régulier avec une coopération élargie dans le pétrole, l’agriculture, la santé, l’éducation et les infrastructures. Il a mis en exergue l’élévation des relations au rang de partenariat stratégique décidée par les deux Chefs d’Etat lors du Sommet de Beijing du Forum sur la coopération sino-africaine en septembre 2024. Selon lui, ce séminaire est une initiative concrète pour mettre en œuvre ce consensus. Il vise à offrir un espace de dialogue direct et d’apprentissage mutuel sur les pratiques journalistiques, la communication internationale et la formation des talents. M. ZHU a également présenté le CICG. Fondée en 1949, cette organisation professionnelle publie plus de 4 000 livres par an en plus de 40 langues et édite 36 revues multilingues. Il a cité l’ouvrage Xi Jinping La gouvernance de la Chine, publié en 44 langues et diffusé dans plus de 180 pays. Il a assuré que le Centre veillera à offrir un accompagnement attentif pour que le séjour soit enrichissant et fructueux, permettant aux participants de découvrir une Chine authentique et de partager à leur retour ce qu’ils auront vu et entendu. S’exprimant au nom de la délégation nigérienne, M. Abdoulaye Tiémogo a exprimé l’honneur de participer à cette rencontre qui célèbre l’amitié des peuples épris de paix et de respect mutuel. Il a indiqué que ce séminaire offre aux participants l’opportunité de se remettre en cause et de questionner les usages et pratiques professionnelles. « Celui qui arrête d’apprendre, cesse d’avancer et qui n’avance pas recule nécessairement. Nous, nous avons choisi d’avancer », a-t-il déclaré. Comparant la coopération sino-nigérienne à une plante ayant germé sur le terreau fertile de la solidarité entre les peuples partageant la même communauté de destin, le Conseil Spécial en communication du Président de la République du Niger a estimé qu’elle a besoin d’être arrosée, entretenue et soutenue pour fleurir. Le cœur de son intervention a porté sur la responsabilité du journaliste. Il a appelé ses confrères à favoriser l’harmonie entre les pays et à contribuer à désamorcer les crises éventuelles. « Loin de nous toute idée de minimiser notre devoir d’informer ou de mépriser le droit d’être informé des publics, mais ce n’est pas parce qu’on a froid dans sa maison qu’on doit y mettre le feu », a martelé M. Abdoulaye Tiemogo. Il a rappelé la puissance des outils du journaliste en ces termes : « avec nos plumes, nos micros et nos caméras, nous pouvons faire bien plus que nous n’imaginons. Car là où le fusil ne sert à rien, nos outils ouvrent les portes les plus verrouillées ». M. Tiémogo a enfin remercié les autorités chinoises pour l’organisation du séminaire et pour l’accueil chaleureux depuis l’arrivée de la délégation nigérienne en terre chinoise, en formulant le vœu que Dieu bénisse nos pays et qu’il raffermisse la coopération entre la Chine et nos pays. Point d’orgue de la cérémonie, la remise symbolique des ouvrages de Xi Jinping ‘’La Gouvernance de la Chine’’ et ‘’Sortir de la pauvreté’’ a précédé la clôture. Les deux parties ont conclu sur une note d’optimisme, en réaffirmant leur volonté commune de faire des médias un pilier de la communauté d’avenir partagé Chine-Afrique
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.title_zh: 中国—尼日尔双边研讨会：尼日利亚新闻官员和记者在中国接受培训
https://www.lesahel.org/seminaire-bilate.body_zh: 在中尼合作框架下，中华人民共和国商务部将于2026年11月10日至30日在北京举办面向尼日尔新闻官员和记者的研讨会。此次研讨会属于面向发展中国家官员的培训项目，是中国对外援助项目的一部分，并受到中国领导人的积极推动。这些交流与讨论旨在加强中尼传统友谊，推动媒体及其他领域合作，并为人力资源、经济和社会发展作出贡献。开幕式由中国国际传播中心（CICG）国际研究与培训副主任朱忠书先生主持，尼日尔总统特别顾问、总统府传播-cellscells负责人 Abdoulaye Tiémogo 先生率领的尼日尔代表团出席。在全球信息竞争加剧、南方国家有必要发出自身叙事的背景下，此次培训具有充分的意义。对于正以新姿态参与萨赫勒国家联盟的尼日尔而言，掌握信息并提升媒体从业人员的专业化水平，关乎国家主权。培训内容丰富多样，包括就中国公共政策、经济发展模式和传播战略举办专题讲座，组织中尼新闻从业专家围绕信息行业共同挑战开展专题讨论，分组参观中国城市的新闻机构、科技企业和媒体院校，并安排文化体验，让参与者感受中国悠久而丰富的历史文化。该项目旨在介绍中国的政策和发展经验，同时让尼日尔参与者全面了解中国媒体从传统新闻出版到数字新媒体的发展进程。此次研讨会再次展现了尼亚美与北京之间合作的活力，这种合作已超越基础设施领域，延伸至人力资本和战略信息行业。它体现了两国建设持久伙伴关系的意愿，即不仅依托物质投资，也重视知识共享。朱忠书先生在欢迎辞中欢迎尼日尔代表团出席，强调尽管北京正值寒冬，代表团的到来仍为本次聚会增添了特别的温暖。他指出，中尼关系持续稳步发展，两国在石油、农业、卫生、教育和基础设施等领域的合作不断扩大。他强调，2024年9月中国—非洲合作论坛北京峰会期间，两国元首决定将双边关系提升为战略伙伴关系。他认为，此次研讨会是落实这一共识的具体举措，旨在为新闻实践、国际传播和人才培养提供直接对话与相互学习的平台。朱忠书先生还介绍了CICG。该职业机构成立于1949年，每年以40多种语言出版4000多册图书，并编辑36种多语种期刊。他提到习近平著作《习近平谈治国理政》，该书以44种语言出版，并在180多个国家发行。他保证，中心将提供周到的支持，使参与者此次行程充实而富有成果，让他们认识真实的中国，并在回国后分享所见所闻。Abdoulaye Tiémogo 先生代表尼日尔代表团发言，表示很荣幸参加此次盛会，以纪念爱好和平、尊重彼此的两国人民之间的友谊。他指出，此次研讨会为参与者提供了重新审视并反思职业惯例和实践的机会。他说：“停止学习的人就会停止前进，不前进的人必然后退。我们已经选择前进。”他将中尼合作比作生长在人民团结这片肥沃土壤上的植物；两国人民同属一个命运共同体，这项合作仍需浇水、维护和支持，才能开花结果。他发言的核心是记者的责任。他呼吁同行促进国家之间的和谐，并为化解可能发生的危机作出贡献。Abdoulaye Tiemogo 先生强调：“我们绝不能轻视报道的职责，也绝不能蔑视公众知情权，但不会因为家里寒冷就纵火烧房。”他还这样强调记者工具的力量：“凭借我们的笔、麦克风和摄像机，我们能够做到远超想象的事情。因为在枪支无能为力之处，我们的工具能够打开一道道紧锁的大门。”Tiémogo 先生最后感谢中国有关部门组织此次研讨会，并自尼日尔代表团抵达中国以来给予热情接待，同时祝愿上帝保佑两国，并加强中国与两国的合作。闭幕式的高潮是举行象征性赠书仪式，向尼日尔代表团赠送习近平《习近平谈治国理政》和《摆脱贫困》两部著作，随后会议闭幕。双方以乐观的态度结束会议，再次重申共同意愿，将媒体打造为中非未来命运共同体的支柱

White House special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are once again mediating the talks, which last through Wednesday. Both men have held a series of meetings with officials across Europe and Russia in recent weeks as they engage in a renewed charge of shuttle diplomacy. Delegates from Russia and Ukraine last met in Geneva in February, though negotiations were put on hold following the outbreak of the U.S. Israel war against Iran. Since then, Ukraine and Russia have dramatically ramped up their attacks on each other ’s territory, inflicting significant economic pain and a growing human toll. Kremlin adviser Vladimir Medinsky, an arch-conservative who previously served as Russia’s culture minister, is again serving as the chief negotiator of the Russian delegation. The team also includes senior military and intelligence officials. The primary focus of the latest round of negotiations, Umerov wrote , includes a “cessation of hostilities, reliable post-war security guarantees, Ukraine’s economic recovery and development, as well as humanitarian steps. ” A source in Russia’s delegation told Reuters that Moscow hopes the Abu Dhabi talks will lay the groundwork for key elements of a post-war security framework for Europe. U.S. officials also told the Financial Times that they are looking to resolve the Ukraine war and broader security arrangements for the continent in tandem, but emphasized that European officials should have a seat at the table, something that Moscow has so far rejected . https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung said Tuesday that Korea will continue to closely cooperate with the U.S. administration following the recent U.S. midterm elections, while also seeking to expand bipartisan support in Congress for issues related to the country and the alliance. Lee made the remarks at a Cabinet meeting after the opposition Democratic Party in the United States won control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives in last week's midterm elections. "After the U.S. midterm elections, many changes are expected to take place in the external environment," the Korean president said, instructing officials to prepare thoroughly for any possible changes. "Utmost attention should be paid to minimizing negative effects from external uncertainties on the domestic economy." "More important than anything would be strengthening and expanding the foundation for cooperation and trust between the two countries from the mutually beneficial perspective," Lee added, calling for efforts to ensure the implementation of bilateral diplomatic and security agreements. The president, in particular, stressed the importance of sufficiently protecting national interests and investments of Korean firms. "To that end, (Korea) would need to continue close cooperation with the U.S. administration, while, at the same time, establishing a bipartisan foundation for cooperation in Congress and expanding the scope of communication with the state governments and the economic sector," the president noted. He also stressed the importance of consistency and flexibility amid global uncertainties, pledging to focus on diplomacy that prioritizes national interests and policies benefiting the people
