https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title: Does Korea need midterm elections?
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 总统任期单独计算，而国民议会选举则另有时间安排，这让中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统造成了全面否定。韩国定期举行选举，可充当中期检验，但没有确定在总统任期中期举行的选举。若要建立有保障的中期制衡机制，韩国还须另行安排一场选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——并将其固定在总统任期内的特定时间举行。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: Single presidential tenure with National Assembly election on its own calendar makes midterm assessment more difficult The 2026 U.S. midterm elections delivered a sweeping rebuke to President Donald Trump. Democrats won control of both chambers of Congress, flipping Senate seats even in Republican strongholds such as Texas, Kansas and South Carolina. The night also brought historic firsts such as the first Muslim and the first openly gay man elected to the U.S. Senate. Voters were passing judgment on Trump’s performance. Many blamed his policies for the high cost of living. The Iran war added to their frustration, through higher fuel prices and doubts about the decision to enter the conflict. Aggressive immigration enforcement was another visible and divisive part of his agenda. No single issue explains the result, but the election gave Americans a chance to voice their discontent and to change who controls Congress. Watching the results from New York, I found myself thinking about how differently Korea delivered its own verdict on a president not long ago. When then-President Yoon Suk Yeol declared martial law in December 2024, citizens rushed to the National Assembly as lawmakers moved swiftly to reject the order. Months of powerful yet peaceful mass protests followed, and Yoon was ultimately removed from office. Of course, the two cases are not equivalent. One was an extraordinary effort to defend constitutional government from an immediate threat. The other was a routine election that shifted the balance of power. But together they show that democratic resilience takes different forms: citizens filling a public square, legislators refusing an unlawful order, voters using the ballot box to constrain a government. Democracies need more than one way for people to hold power to account. Protest is an essential democratic right. When institutions are under threat, public assembly shows that people will not accept the erosion of their rights in silence. But protest cannot carry the whole burden of accountability. The U.S. midterm elections matter because they give citizens a regular, consequential opportunity to judge a government while it is still in office. It is not simply a date on the calendar; it is a constitutional choice about when the public gets its say. Korea has regular elections that can serve as midterm tests, but no guaranteed presidential midterm. Because the presidential term is a single, nonrenewable five years and the National Assembly term is four, general elections fall at a different point in each presidency. In April 2024, about two years into Yoon’s term, voters handed the opposition a landslide, a midterm rebuke in all but name. Under President Lee Jae Myung, the next general election will not come until April 2028, three years into his term. This June’s elections offered voters an early chance to assess Lee’s administration, but they came just one year into his presidency and were shaped mostly by local candidates and concerns, even when national politics loomed large. Korea’s check exists, but its timing is left to the arithmetic of the calendar. Lee has advocated a constitutional amendment to introduce a U.S.-style, four-year presidency with the possibility of a second term, arguing that it would allow a “midterm evaluation” of the administration. A renewable term would give voters a chance to approve or reject a president at the next presidential election. But that election would come at the end of a term, not halfway through it. To create a guaranteed midterm check, Korea would also need to arrange for a separate election — most plausibly a National Assembly election — to fall at a defined point during the presidential term. Together, these changes could strengthen accountability. An incumbent seeking reelection would have to win voters’ approval again, and a scheduled election during the term would give the public an earlier chance to reward or rebuke the government. That might make presidents more attentive to how their policies affect people. It would also give citizens a peaceful, predictable outlet for frustration. There are real risks, too. More frequent national campaigning could deepen polarization, encourage short-term decision-making and leave governments in near-permanent election mode. Local contests might become even more dominated by national battles. And constitutional change is no technical fix. It would require approval by at least two-thirds of the National Assembly and a national referendum, as well as durable public consensus about how the new election schedule should work. Korea does not have to copy the U.S. system to learn from its underlying idea: People should not have to wait until the end of a president’s term to deliver their verdict. Protest, the courts, the National Assembly and elections each serve different purposes. A well-designed midterm could add another democratic check, but no calendar can guarantee accountability on its own. Korea’s recent history makes the point. In 2024, voters delivered a clear midterm verdict on Yoon. Eight months later, he declared martial law against an opposition-controlled Assembly. This week, even Trump, who never conceded his 2020 loss, said he would accept the midterm results. The value of any midterm depends not only on whether it gives citizens a real choice, but on whether political leaders accept the result. Min Seong-jae (smin@pace.edu) is a professor of communication and media studies at Pace University in New York
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 总统单一任期与国民议会选举各自按照自己的时间表进行，使得中期评估更加困难。2026年美国中期选举对唐纳德·特朗普总统作出了全面否定。民主党人赢得国会两院控制权，甚至在得克萨斯州、堪萨斯州和南卡罗来纳州等共和党 stronghold 翻转了参议院席位。当晚还出现了历史性首次，例如首位穆斯林和首位公开出柜同性恋男性当选美国参议员。选民是在评价特朗普的施政表现。许多人把生活成本高企归咎于他的政策。伊朗战争通过推高燃油价格，以及引发人们对决定参战的疑虑，加剧了他们的不满。激进移民执法是他议程中另一项显眼且引发分歧的内容。没有任何单一议题能够解释这一结果，但这次选举给了美国人表达不满并改变国会控制权归属的机会。从纽约看到选举结果时，我不禁想到，韩国不久前以多么不同的方式对一位总统作出了裁决。2024年12月，时任总统尹锡悦宣布戒严时，民众涌向国民议会，议员迅速行动起来否决该命令。随后发生了持续数月、力量强大但保持和平的大规模抗议，尹锡悦最终被免职。当然，这两个案例并不等同。一个是为抵御迫在眉睫的威胁而捍卫宪政的非凡行动，另一个则是改变权力平衡的例行选举。但两者共同表明，民主的韧性有不同表现形式：民众填满公共广场，议员拒绝非法命令，选民利用投票箱约束政府。民主制度需要不止一种让人民追究权力责任的方式。抗议是一项基本的民主权利。当制度受到威胁时，公众集会表明人民不会默默接受权利遭到侵蚀。但不能把全部问责重担都压在抗议上。美国中期选举之所以重要，是因为它们让公民在政府仍在任时获得定期且具有实质影响的机会来评判政府。它不只是日历上的一个日期，而是一项关于公众何时能够发言的宪政选择。韩国定期举行选举，可以充当期中检验，却没有确定的总统任期中期选举。由于总统任期是单一且不可连任的5年，而国民议会任期为4年，大选会在每届总统任期的不同时间举行。2024年4月，也就是尹锡悦任期约两年时，选民以压倒性优势把胜利交给反对派，这是一场除了名义之外各方面都算得上期中否定的选举。在李在明总统领导下，下一次大选要到2028年4月才会举行，届时他的任期已过去三年。今年6月的选举让选民得以提前评估李在明政府，但距离他就任仅一年，而且主要由地方候选人和地方议题塑造，即便国家政治占据重要位置。韩国的制衡机制确实存在，但其时机取决于日历上的算术。李在明一直主张修宪，引入美国式4年总统制，并允许连任一个任期，认为这将使政府能够接受“中期评估”。可连任的任期会让选民有机会在下一次总统选举中批准或否决总统。但那次选举将在任期结束时举行，而不是在任期中途举行。若要建立确定的期中制衡，韩国还需要另行安排一次选举——最有可能的是国民议会选举——在总统任期内的某个明确时间举行。这些变化结合起来可以加强问责。寻求连任的在任总统必须再次赢得选民的认可，而任期中定期举行的选举会让公众更早获得奖励或批评政府的机会。这可能促使总统更加关注政策对民众的影响，也会为公民提供一个和平且可预期的发泄不满渠道。这里也存在现实风险。更频繁的全国竞选活动可能加剧两极分化、助长短期决策，并使政府几乎永久处于选举状态。地方选举也可能变得更加受全国政治斗争支配。宪法改革同样不是技术性修补方案。它需要国民议会至少三分之二多数通过，并经全国公投批准，同时还需要公众就新的选举时间安排形成持久共识。韩国不必照搬美国制度，也能从其内在理念中汲取教训：人民不应非得等到总统任期结束才有机会作出裁决。抗议、法院、国民议会和选举各自发挥不同作用。设计良好的期中选举可以增加一项民主制衡，但仅靠任何日历安排都无法保证问责。韩国近期的历史恰好说明了这一点。2024年，选民对尹锡悦作出了明确的期中裁决。8个月后，他宣布在一个由反对派掌控的国民议会面前实施戒严。本周，就连从未承认自己2020年败选的特朗普也表示将接受中期选举结果。任何期中选举的价值，不仅取决于它是否给公民提供真正的选择，也取决于政治领导人是否接受结果。Min Seong-jae（smin@pace.edu）是纽约佩斯大学传播与媒体研究教授。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: SK hynix Inc.的母公司周一表示，韩国芯片制造商SK hynix Inc.正准备扩大其美国员工队伍，此举似乎是为了加强与包括Nvidia Corp.在内的美国主要客户的联系。SK hynix计划在12月前后增聘高级管理人员，并对其美国业务进行重组。SK hynix此前新设了一个负责美国业务的高管职位，并任命负责开发工作的总裁Ahn Hyun担任该职。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Korean chipmaker SK hynix Inc. is preparing to expand its U.S. workforce, its parent company said Monday, in what appears to be a move to strengthen ties with major U.S. clients, including Nvidia Corp. SK hynix plans to make additional executive appointments and reorganize its U.S. operations around Dec. 3, according to SK Group. The planned changes follow a recent executive reshuffle at SK Group, a Korean conglomerate with businesses spanning semiconductors, construction and other sectors. SK hynix had created a new executive-level post overseeing its U.S. operations and appointed Ahn Hyun, its president in charge of development, to the position. Ahn has led the development of artificial intelligence (AI) memory products, including high bandwidth memory (HBM) at SK hynix. The appointment marks a shift in the company's approach to managing its U.S. operations, which have traditionally been headed by executives with sales and marketing backgrounds. Industry sources said the move reflects changes in how HBM contracts are secured as memory chipmakers increasingly work with customers from the early stages of product development to tailor chips to their AI infrastructure. "Companies can no longer maintain their competitiveness without working closely with customers, starting from the R&D stage," an industry official said, requesting anonymity

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Leaders of the main opposition People Power Party (PPP) gathered outside Cheong Wa Dae on Monday to protest the recent passage of a bill calling for a special counsel investigation into alleged fabricated indictments targeting President Lee Jae Myung and others. The PPP leadership held a Supreme Council meeting outside the presidential office, after the ruling Democratic Party of Korea railroaded the bill through a plenary session of the National Assembly on Friday. The legislation calls for appointing an independent counsel to investigate suspicions the prosecution under former President Yoon Suk Yeol fabricated evidence or induced false testimonies to build cases against then opposition leader Lee and others. The PPP has denounced the effort as a pretext to cancel all of Lee's indictments, as his trials have been suspended under an article of the Constitution that exempts a sitting president from criminal prosecution except in cases of insurrection or treason. Lee faces charges of involvement in corrupt development schemes, illegal remittances to North Korea, and the misuse of a government charge card, stemming from his time as mayor of Seongnam or governor of Gyeonggi Province. "Lee Jae Myung's 'prison break bill' has passed the National Assembly and arrived at Cheong Wa Dae," PPP leader Jang Dong-hyeok said during the meeting, suggesting it would be approved at Tuesday's Cabinet meeting. "The key to freeing prisoner Lee Jae Myung has been placed in prisoner Lee Jae Myung's hands." Jang warned of judgment from the people should the bill be approved, including through possible impeachment. The PPP's resistance to the bill has taken various forms, with a rally held Friday outside the National Assembly and a massive outdoor rally staged near Gyeongbok Palace in central Seoul on Saturday. A relay of one-person protests outside Cheong Wa Dae has been scheduled for Monday. Rep. Jeong Jeom-sig, the party's floor leader, started it off as the first participant. On Tuesday, the party has vowed to hold a general meeting of lawmakers outside the presidential office

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 韩国最大的健康美容零售连锁店CJ Olive Young周一表示，将在2027年上半年之前于加利福尼亚州再开设5家门店，使其在美国的门店总数达到7家。Olive Young表示，其门店还向顾客介绍韩国常见的产品，例如防晒棒、通过海绵 dispensing 防晒霜的气垫粉饼，以及预先浸有爽肤水化妆水的化妆棉。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: CJ Olive Young, Korea’s largest health and beauty store chain, will open five more stores in California by the first half of 2027, bringing its U.S. total to seven, the company said Monday. The retailer opened its first U.S. store in Pasadena in May and a second at Westfield Century City in Los Angeles in June. Four of the new stores will be in the greater Los Angeles area: Spectrum Center, a lifestyle shopping center in Irvine; Del Amo Fashion Center in the South Bay area; Bloom on 3rd, a shopping complex near the Farmers Market in central Los Angeles; and Brea Mall in Orange County. The fifth will open at Fashion Valley in San Diego, its first outside the Los Angeles area. Opening dates for each store have not been set. Three of the sites — Del Amo Fashion Center, Brea Mall and Fashion Valley — are operated by Simon Property Group, a major U.S. mall owner. The company said the expansion will help small and independent Korean cosmetics brands, collectively known as K-beauty, reach American consumers without their own distribution networks. Olive Young said its stores also introduce shoppers to product types common in Korea, such as sunscreen sticks, cushion compacts that dispense sunscreen through a sponge, and toner pads, which are cotton pads presoaked in skin toner. Its in-store Skin Scan service, which analyzes a customer’s skin condition and recommends products, had been used by about 27,000 customers as of late October, roughly five months after the first store opened. “Olive Young’s U.S. stores serve as a bridge that helps emerging brands settle into the mainstream market,” an Olive Young official said. https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.summary_zh: 中国浙江华友钴业寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium，目前在刚果民主共和国受到审查，原因是其一家子公司污染给周边社区造成影响，却迟迟未支付赔偿。与此同时，华友钴业正在推进对加纳拟建的首座锂矿的投资。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益达成协议。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body: Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt, the Chinese company seeking to acquire Atlantic Lithium, the developer of Ghana’s Ewoyaa lithium mine, is facing scrutiny in the Democratic Republic of Congo over delayed compensation to communities affected by pollution from one of its subsidiaries. Congo’s mines ministry said on November 6, 2026 that Congo Dongfang International Mining (CDM) remains obliged to pay $6 million to affected communities, despite financial difficulties and a suspension of its operations, Reuters reported . The development comes as Huayou advances its investment in Ghana’s proposed first lithium mine. Atlantic Lithium shareholders are scheduled to vote on the proposed takeover on December 14, following court approval. The Congo case concerns an industrial wastewater spill at CDM’s Lubumbashi operation in November 2025. According to the Congolese ministry, a basin intended to retain water had been used to store acidic solutions. The incident affected surrounding communities and prompted authorities to suspend the company’s operations for three months. Authorities subsequently required CDM to provide $2 million each to Kasapa, Kamatete and Kamisepe. A separate $6.6 million penalty was imposed for payment to the state treasury. However, implementation of the community compensation programme has been delayed. The ministry attributed the delays partly to financial difficulties cited by CDM, which recently announced that it had halted its activities. “Financial difficulties or the suspension of operations do not exempt the operator from its obligations toward affected populations,” the ministry said. For Ghana, the development draws attention to the environmental and community obligations of the group moving into Ewoyaa. Huayou’s involvement in the project is already progressing independently of its proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium. The company has completed an agreement to acquire Elevra Lithium’s rights and interests in the Ewoyaa project and Ghana portfolio. The proposed acquisition of Atlantic Lithium remains a separate transaction, subject to shareholder approval, regulatory approvals from Ghana’s Securities and Exchange Commission and the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, alignment with the Minerals Income Investment Fund, and the fulfilment of the remaining conditions. The Congo incident does not establish that similar problems will arise at Ewoyaa. It does, however, provide a record against which Ghanaian regulators and affected communities can examine the proposed investor’s environmental safeguards and arrangements for compensation. The issue extends beyond whether a company can finance a mine. It is also about whether its obligations to affected communities can be enforced when financial difficulties force it to suspend operations
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.title_zh: 华友钴业寻求控制加纳Ewoyaa锂矿之际，因刚果补偿款延迟而受到审查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/huayou-seeki.body_zh: 寻求收购加纳Ewoyaa锂矿开发商Atlantic Lithium的中国公司Zhejiang Huayou Cobalt，正因旗下子公司污染影响社区后的赔偿支付延迟，在刚果民主共和国受到审查。据Reuters报道，刚果矿业部于2026年11月6日表示，尽管面临财务困难且已暂停运营，Congo Dongfang International Mining（CDM）仍有义务向受影响的社区支付600万美元。与此同时，Huayou正推进其对加纳拟建首座锂矿的投资。经法院批准后，Atlantic Lithium股东定于12月14日就拟议收购进行表决。刚果此案涉及CDM位于Lubumbashi的业务于2025年11月发生的工业废水泄漏事故。据刚果方面称，该公司的水坝原本用于蓄水，却被用来储存酸性溶液。事故影响了周边社区，并促使当局暂停该公司运营三个月。当局随后要求CDM分别向Kasapa、Kamatete和Kamisepe提供200万美元。此外，公司还被处以660万美元罚款，须向国库支付。然而，社区赔偿计划的执行一直延迟。该部将部分延误归因于CDM所称的财务困难；该公司最近宣布已停止业务。该部表示：“财务困难或暂停运营并不能免除运营方对受影响居民的义务。”对加纳而言，此事凸显Huayou进入Ewoyaa项目后所承担的环境和社区义务。即使不收购Atlantic Lithium，Huayou参与该项目的相关工作也已在推进。该公司已就收购Elevra Lithium在Ewoyaa项目及加纳资产组合中的权利和权益签署协议。拟议收购Atlantic Lithium仍是一项单独交易，须获得股东批准、加纳Securities and Exchange Commission及Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources的监管批准，符合Minerals Income Investment Fund的要求，并满足其余条件。刚果事件并不能证明Ewoyaa也会出现类似问题，但它留下了一份记录，供加纳监管机构和受影响社区据以审查拟议投资者的环保保障措施及赔偿安排。问题不仅在于一家公司能否为矿山融资，也在于当财务困难迫使其暂停运营时，其对受影响社区承担的义务能否得到强制执行

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Seoul stocks bucked gains on Wall Street to open lower Monday as investors dumped tech heavyweights.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 华尔街股市上涨之际，韩国股市周一反而低开，投资者抛售科技行业权重股。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Seoul stocks bucked gains on Wall Street to open lower Monday as investors dumped tech heavyweights. The benchmark Korea Composite Stock Price Index (KOSPI) was down 31.68 points, or 0.63 percent, to 5,028.01 points, as of 9:15 a.m. Major stock indexes in the U.S. closed higher Friday (local time), led by a rebound in chipmakers despite fears of tighter artificial intelligence (AI) regulations after the Democrats' midterm sweep linger. The S&P 500 added 0.31 percent, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq rose 1.09 percent. Investors are digesting fresh uncertainties surrounding Nvidia Corp. after the company announced it has launched an independent investigation into allegations its chief Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy. They are also closely following the moves from the Federal Reserve for cues on the next U.S. policy directions. Chip giant Samsung Electronics edged up 0.26 percent, while SK hynix inched down 0.09 percent. Carmaker Hyundai Motor shed 0.89 percent, defense giant Hanwha Aerospace fell 3.33 percent, and financial firm KB Financial declined 1.13 percent. The Korean won was quoted at 1,360 won against the U.S. dollar as of 9:15 a.m., up 3 won from the previous trading session's close
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 华尔街股市上涨之际首尔股市低开，未能跟涨
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 周一，受投资者抛售科技权重股拖累，首尔股市逆华尔街涨势低开。截至上午9时15分，韩国综合股价指数（KOSPI）下跌31.68点，跌幅0.63%，报5,028.01点。美国主要股指当地时间周五收高，芯片制造商反弹带动大盘上涨，尽管民主党在中期选举中大获全胜后，人工智能（AI）监管趋严的担忧仍未消退。标普500指数上涨0.31%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数上涨1.09%。Nvidia Corp.宣布已启动独立调查，调查有关其首席执行官Jensen Huang遭中国间谍针对的指控，投资者正在消化由此带来的新不确定性。他们还密切关注美联储的动向，以判断美国下一轮政策方向。芯片巨头Samsung Electronics小幅上涨0.26%，SK hynix微跌0.09%。汽车制造商Hyundai Motor下跌0.89%，防务巨头Hanwha Aerospace下跌3.33%，金融公司KB Financial下跌1.13%。截至上午9时15分，韩元兑美元报1,360韩元，较上一交易日收盘价升值3韩元

https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.summary: "This administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities," the White House said in a statement to the BBC. Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff had signalled no climbdown from the administration on border security. "There has never been a President stronger on immigration enforcement than President Trump," said White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.summary_zh: 白宫在向英国广播公司发表的声明中表示：“本届政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”特朗普周五提拔移民鹰派人物斯蒂芬·米勒担任白宫办公厅主任，这表明政府在边境安全问题上不会退让。白宫发言人劳伦·比斯说：“在移民执法方面，从来没有哪位总统比特朗普总统更强硬。”
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body: US President Donald Trump's administration has vowed not to change course on its mass deportation plans after last week's midterm elections defeat. "This administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities," the White House said in a statement to the BBC. Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff had signalled no climbdown from the administration on border security. Exit polls indicate immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy. In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the party's landslide congressional majorities. But multiple US officials sources told the BBC's US partner CBS that the administration had put the midterm losses down to concerns about the economy, affordability and the war with Iran, rather than its immigration crackdown. The White House maintained on Sunday there would be no change of direction. "There has never been a President stronger on immigration enforcement than President Trump," said White House spokeswoman Lauren Bis. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also said it would forge ahead. "ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told CBS. Following Tuesday's results, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy. "I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results. But the White House's posture appears to have hardened after Trump promoted Stephen Miller to chief of staff on Friday. Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target. Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles. In Minneapolis, two US protesters, Renee Good and Alex Pretti, were fatally shot by immigration agents
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.title_zh: 白宫誓言在中期选举失利后继续加强移民执法
https://www.myjoyonline.com/white-house-.body_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的政府上周中期选举失利后，誓言不会改变其大规模驱逐计划。白宫在向英国广播公司（BBC）发表的声明中表示：“本届政府不会放缓逮捕和驱逐那些恐吓我们社区的犯罪非法移民的努力。”特朗普周五提拔移民强硬派人士斯蒂芬·米勒出任白宫幕僚长，这表明该政府在边境安全政策上不会退缩。各州出口民调显示，移民问题是中期选举选民最看重的第三大问题，仅次于经济和民主状况。在得克萨斯州等历来保守的州，拉丁裔选民转向民主党，帮助该党锁定国会的压倒性多数席位。然而，多名美国官员向英国广播公司的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司（CBS）表示，政府将中期选举失利归咎于人们对经济、生活成本以及与伊朗战争的担忧，而非其收紧移民政策。白宫周日照例表示不会改变方向。白宫发言人劳伦·比斯说：“在移民执法方面，从来没有哪位总统比特朗普总统更坚定。”国土安全部（DHS）也表示将继续推进工作。一名国土安全部发言人对哥伦比亚广播公司说：“移民与海关执法局（ICE）绝不会后退或放慢行动。”周二投票结果公布后，副总统JD·万斯似乎愿意调整移民战略。万斯在一篇反思选举结果的长篇网络帖子中写道：“我愿意考虑我们是否应调整执法重点，例如更多地关注雇用非法劳工的企业。”但特朗普周五提拔斯蒂芬·米勒出任幕僚长后，白宫的立场似乎变得更加强硬。widely被视为特朗普第一和第二任总统任内强硬移民政策策划者的米勒，也是这一政策的设计者。移民与海关执法局（ICE）消息人士对哥伦比亚广播公司表示，近几周官员接到指示，每天目标是逮捕约2,700名非法移民，高于此前每日逮捕2,000人的目标。今年开展的执法突袭行动在芝加哥、明尼阿波利斯和洛杉矶等城市引发了反对移民与海关执法局的示威。在明尼阿波利斯，两名美国示威者蕾妮·古德和亚历克斯·普雷蒂被移民执法人员开枪致命打死

https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO’s affair with suspected Chinese spy
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.summary_zh: 美国科技巨头英伟达启动独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍有交往。《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄艾丽丝是北京派来的间谍。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body: US tech giant Nvidia has opened an independent investigation following reports that its CEO, Jensen Huang, had a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy. The company, one of the world's most valuable, said its board had no reason to believe its secrets or national security were compromised, adding that the CEO was committed to continuing to lead the company. Separately, Jensen Huang admitted to having been "unfaithful" to his wife and apologised for hurting her and their children. US intelligence officials believed that Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, who had a close relationship with Jensen Huang, was a spy for Beijing, according to a New York Times report. Jensen Huang said he took "full responsibility" for what he did, adding that he had fallen short of his responsibilities to Nvidia's employees, board and shareholders. Nvidia is one of the world's largest companies and is seen as central to making the hardware for emerging AI technologies. Its CEO said: "I was unfaithful to my wife. My actions hurt her and our children. There is no excuse for what I did. I am deeply sorry." His statement continued: "Regarding the national security concerns raised in news reports, Nvidia's Board of Directors has initiated an independent investigation. I support the investigation and will cooperate fully. "I love our country and our company. I am committed to protecting Nvidia and supporting America's national security. I am proud and grateful to be an American." A separate statement issued by Nvidia's board of directors said it would begin an investigation in "light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort". It continued: "The Board prioritises US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of Nvidia and its shareholders. Alice Huang, who is of no relation to Jensen Huang, is linked to Singapore-based data centre firm Megaspeed. The company told the New York Times last month its current leadership took the allegations seriously and had appointed external legal advisers to conduct an internal investigation. Nvidia is a central player in AI infrastructure, providing chips to leading AI model developers including OpenAI and Meta. The microchip manufacturer is worth some $4.5 trillion, making it one of the most valuable companies ever. China previously rejected allegations of an espionage operation targeting Nvidia's chief, calling the claims "groundless speculation" . US intelligence agencies monitored Alice Huang and concluded she was acting on behalf of the Chinese government, according to unnamed sources cited by The New York Times. Surveillance reportedly revealed communications between Alice Huang and an American citizen, who was subsequently identified as Jensen Huang through a process known as "unmasking". It remains unclear what information Alice Huang – who is also known as Huang Le – allegedly passed to Beijing, how valuable it was, or when she is believed to have begun gathering intelligence. Alice Huang did not respond to the paper's request for comment. Last week, members of Congress wrote to Jensen Huang, asking him to appear before them in the light of the reported relationship. Three House Republican committee leaders asked the CEO to appear later in the month, to talk about Nvidia's "security protocols against foreign adversary espionage" given his reported relation Alice Huang. "Recent reports raise significant national security concerns regarding the PRC's [China's] access to sensitive US technology and information. "The issue of PRC infiltration and access to cutting-edge US technology is core to the investigative work of our three committees this Congress," the letter said. Nvidia's AI chips have been a major focus of the rivalry between the US and China, and Washington has previously imposed controls on where its advanced products can be sold. The H200, Nvidia's second most advanced semiconductor, had previously been restricted by Washington over concerns that it would give China's technology industry an edge over the US. In January, the Trump administration said it would allow the company to sell its H200 chips to Chinese customers under certain conditions
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.title_zh: Nvidia就首席执行官涉嫌与疑似中国间谍有染展开调查
https://www.myjoyonline.com/nvidia-launc.body_zh:
美国科技巨头英伟达启动了一项独立调查。此前有报道称，该公司的首席执行官黄仁勋与一名疑似中国间谍存在关系。英伟达是全球市值最高的企业之一。公司表示，董事会没有理由相信公司的机密或国家安全受到损害，并补充称，首席执行官致力于继续领导公司。

与此同时，黄仁勋承认自己曾对妻子“不忠”，并为伤害妻子和孩子道歉。据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报官员认为，与黄仁勋关系密切的中国女商人黄爱丽是为北京效力的间谍。黄仁勋表示，他对自己所做的事承担“全部责任”，并称自己没有尽到对英伟达员工、董事会和股东的责任。他说：“我背叛了妻子。我所做的事伤害了妻子和孩子。我的所作所为没有任何借口。我深感抱歉。”

他的声明接着说：“关于新闻报道提出的国家安全问题，英伟达董事会已启动独立调查。我支持这项调查，并将全力配合。

“我热爱我们的国家和公司。我致力于保护英伟达，并支持美国的国家安全。我很自豪，也很感激自己是一名美国人。”

英伟达董事会另行发表声明称，鉴于近期有报道称创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋成为外国情报行动的目标，董事会将展开调查。声明称：“董事会将美国国家和经济安全置于首位，这是压倒英伟达及其股东利益的大事。黄爱丽与黄仁勋没有亲属关系，她与总部位于新加坡的数据中心企业Megaspeed有关联。该公司上月告诉《纽约时报》，现任管理层认真对待相关指控，并已聘请外部法律顾问开展内部调查。

英伟达是人工智能基础设施领域的核心企业，向包括OpenAI和Meta在内的领先人工智能模型开发商提供芯片。这家微芯片制造商市值约4.5万亿美元，成为有史以来市值最高的公司之一。中国此前驳斥了针对英伟达首席执行官的间谍行动指控，称这些说法是“毫无根据的猜测”。

《纽约时报》援引未具名消息人士称，美国情报机构监视黄爱丽后得出结论，认为她代表中国政府行事。据报道，监视记录显示黄爱丽与一名美国公民有过通信，这名公民随后通过名为“身份揭露”的程序被确认为黄仁勋。目前尚不清楚黄爱丽——也被称为黄乐——据称向北京传递了什么信息、这些信息有多大价值，以及人们认为她从何时开始收集情报。黄爱丽没有回应该报置评请求。

上周，国会议员致函黄仁勋，要求他就这段被曝光的关系出席作证。众议院三个共和党的委员会领导人要求这位首席执行官于本月晚些时候出席，讨论英伟达“防范外国对手间谍活动的安全规程”，理由是他与黄爱丽之间被曝存在关系。信中写道：“近期报道引发了对中国获取美国敏感技术和信息这一重大国家安全问题的关注。中国渗透并获取美国尖端技术，是我们本届国会三个委员会调查工作的核心。”

英伟达的人工智能芯片一直是中美竞争的一个主要焦点，华盛顿此前也对该公司先进产品的销售地区实施限制。英伟达最先进的半导体产品H200此前受到华盛顿限制，原因是外界担心它会令中国科技产业获得相对于美国的优势。今年1月，特朗普政府表示，将在满足特定条件的情况下允许该公司向中国客户出售H200芯片

https://leadership.ng/adc-will-be-on-bal.body: The Minister of Aviation and Aerospace Development, Festus Keyamo, has said the African Democratic Congress (ADC) will participate in the 2027 general elections, but warned that candidates produced by the David Mark-led faction, including former Vice-President Atiku Abubakar, may not appear on the ballot. Keyamo said the fate of the candidates would depend on the final determination of the party’s leadership dispute by the Supreme Court. The minister stated this in a post on his verified X handle on Sunday, following concerns that a recent Federal High Court judgment against the Mark-led leadership could prevent the opposition party from fielding candidates in the elections. The Federal High Court in Abuja had on Thursday nullified the Mark-led National Working Committee and invalidated decisions taken by the faction, including the presidential primary that produced Atiku as the ADC’s candidate for the 2027 election. The judgment followed a suit filed by former ADC Deputy National Chairman (North-East), Nafiu Gombe, in which he challenged the process through which Mark and other members of the caretaker committee assumed control of the party. Gombe argued that following the resignation of former National Chairman, Ralph Nwosu, he was constitutionally entitled to take over the party’s leadership. Reacting to the ruling, Keyamo dismissed suggestions that it meant the ADC would be excluded from the 2027 elections. “For the education of the public, those raising false alarm that the court judgment on ADC means the party will not be on the ballot are spreading misinformation. “The ADC will be on the ballot. It is the David Mark faction of candidates, including Atiku Abubakar, that may not be on the ballot, depending on the final judgment of the Supreme Court,” he said. The minister also questioned why the judgment was being portrayed as an attempt to prevent the opposition party from participating in the elections. He argued that candidates who emerged through the party’s original leadership structure should not be denied their political rights because of the dispute. “Therefore, the question we must ask those raising hell is: are those Nigerians who successfully won their primaries under the faction of the original owners of the ADC lesser humans or lesser Nigerians than David Mark and Atiku Abubakar?” he asked. Meanwhile, the Mark-led faction has rejected the judgment and vowed to challenge it in court. Atiku and the party have also indicated plans to appeal the ruling. The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has said it would not take a position on the dispute until it obtains and studies the certified true copy of the judgment. The outcome of the pending appeals is expected to determine which faction has the legal authority to control the ADC and nominate candidates for the 2027 general elections. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/zamfara-moves-to-r.body: The Zamfara State Government has taken a decisive step to reclaim its gold fields from illegal miners and criminal elements with the inauguration of a 13-man Anti-Illegal Mining Committee. The committee was inaugurated on Friday in Gusau, the state capital, by the Secretary to the State Government (SSG), Malam Abubakar Mohammad Nakwada. The move is part of the state government’s renewed effort to support the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector, restoring order in mining communities, and cutting off the funding source for banditry and terrorism in the state. The committee is headed by the State Commissioner for Environment, Hon. Abdulrahman Tumbido. It draws membership from security agencies, traditional institutions, and relevant federal and state government agencies — a structure the government says will ensure coordination, intelligence sharing and effective enforcement across all mining areas. Inaugurating the committee, Nakwada charged members to work closely with security agencies, regulatory bodies and local authorities to identify locations where illegal mining is taking place and profile the operators. He said the committee must also ensure that even licensed companies comply with relevant laws and regulations, take adequate measures to prevent environmental degradation, and safeguard the safety and rights of host communities. “The initiative is part of the state government’s efforts to assist the Federal Government in formalising the mining sector in the state,” Nakwada said. In his remarks, the Chairman of the Committee, Hon. Tumbido, assured that the committee would work with reliable information, respect for the law, fairness and regard for the rights and livelihoods of the people. He added that the committee would ensure its efforts contribute to lasting security, environmental protection and sustainable development in the state. The inauguration comes against the background of worsening insecurity in mining communities in Anka Local Government Area. On October 15, elderly residents of Birnin Doki in Anka LGA were reportedly ordered out of their homes by terror leader Muhammad Gwaska for allegedly refusing forced labour in the gold mines controlled by his gang. Displaced residents said they were forced to walk about 15 kilometres to an abandoned clinic, with no food, water or immediate state aid. Residents in the area have also alleged that terror groups now control some gold fields, decide who mines, who farms and who lives there, and tax farmers and miners to fund further attacks. The state government says the new committee is part of its response to dismantle that criminal economy, restore state authority in mining areas, and protect vulnerable communities like Birnin Doki from exploitation. Zamfara is one of Nigeria’s richest gold belts, but years of illegal mining have fuelled insecurity, environmental degradation and exploitation of host communities. With the inauguration of the committee, the state government says it is moving from rhetoric to action — to ensure that Zamfara’s mineral wealth works for its people, not for criminals. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Senior U.S. Navy and Marine Corps officials have visited Korean shipbuilding giant HD Hyundai Heavy Industries' shipyard to assess its naval shipbuilding capabilities, photos showed Sunday. Their Nov. 4 visit to the shipyard in the southeastern Korean city of Ulsan came as Seoul and Washington are jointly seeking to revive the U.S. shipbuilding industry under the MASGA, or "Make American Shipbuilding Great Again," initiative. "The visit brought together senior U.S. Navy and Marine Corps leaders to assess naval shipbuilding capabilities, installation infrastructure and logistics support across South Korea," read a photo caption of one of the uploaded photos on the Pentagon's Defense Visual Information Distribution Service (DVIDS). The delegation included Brendan P. Rogers, assistant secretary of the U.S. Navy for energy, installations and environment; U.S. Marine Corps Lt. Gen. Andrew M. Niebel, deputy commandant for installations and logistics; and U.S. Marine Corps Maj. Gen. Valerie A. Jackson, commander of U.S. Marine Corps Forces Korea. As part of the itinerary, the delegation also assessed opportunities to strengthen maritime sustainment, enhance operational readiness and reinforce the Korea-U.S. alliance, according to DVIDS. In October, HD Hyundai signed an agreement with U.S. engineering and construction company Kiewit to establish a joint venture to build a new shipyard in the United States, with plans to begin construction next year and full-scale operations in 2029

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 执政党一名官员周日在政府表示，政府已同意考虑拨款约2万亿韩元（15亿美元），用于消防工作相关的必要投资。朴表示，用于筹备消防设备和训练设施的额外预算资金，以及加强以消防工作为核心的医疗体系，也将纳入明年预算审查的考量。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The government has agreed to consider funding about 2 trillion won ($1.5 billion) for essential investments related to firefighting efforts, a ruling party official said Sunday. The move came as part of discussions to ease the fiscal burden on provincial governments, Democratic Party of Korea chief spokesperson Park Sung-joon said at a press briefing following a consultation session between the government, the ruling party and Cheong Wa Dae. Additional budget funds to prepare firefighting equipment and training facilities, as well as strengthening a medical system centered on firefighting efforts, will also be factored in for a review of next year's budget, Park said. Currently, provincial governments fund the bulk of the firefighting-related budget, with only about 10 percent of the total amount funded by the central government. At the meeting, Prime Minister Han Seong-sook said the government will review whether it is providing full support for firefighters before asking them to devote themselves to public safety. In the meeting, held a day ahead of the 64th anniversary of the Day of Firefighting, Han paid tribute to the late Kim Jin-seok, a firefighter who died while responding to a factory fire in Bucheon, west of Seoul, last month. "There are many things for the government to take care of, but the lives and safety of the public are one of the top priorities. There is nothing that precedes this," Han said. Han, meanwhile, vowed to thoroughly inspect preparations for the winter cold, stressing that heavy snow and cold are natural disasters that threaten people's daily lives
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 政府将审查为消防工作提供的15亿美元资金支持

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 分析师周日表示，韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国将限制人工智能数据中心建设而引发的股市大幅下跌，可能外溢至实体经济；如果实施此类限制，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Korea is facing growing concerns that a sharp stock market decline triggered by fears of U.S. restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) data center construction could spill over into the real economy, as such curbs, if implemented, could threaten semiconductor exports and weigh on next year’s growth, analysts said Sunday. The Democrats’ victory in the U.S. midterm elections last week has fueled speculation that the party could push for tighter oversight of data center projects, although specific measures have yet to be announced. Korea’s economy has benefited substantially from the global AI boom this year, with strong semiconductor exports providing a major boost to growth. Semiconductors accounted for 49 percent of the country’s total exports in October, and the Bank of Korea (BOK) estimates that the industry will contribute roughly half of the country's economic growth this year. These concerns have already taken a toll on Korean stocks. Both the benchmark KOSPI and secondary bourse Kosdaq lost 10.43 percent and 8.54 percent, respectively, over the three trading sessions following the U.S. midterm elections, from Wednesday to Friday. Samsung Electronics fell 14.03 percent, while SK hynix tumbled 19.03 percent. A prolonged stock market slump could erode household wealth and further weaken private consumption, which declined in the third quarter despite stronger-than-expected economic growth. The economy grew 1 percent from the previous quarter, well above the central bank's forecast of 0.3 percent, its advance estimate showed. While semiconductor exports and equipment investment supported growth, household spending declined 0.2 percent, with purchases of both goods and services falling. He added that the extent of the economic impact would depend largely on the scope and severity of any restrictions. “Close attention should be paid to whether policymakers and lawmakers seek to halt data center construction altogether or instead allow projects to proceed under stricter requirements,” he said. Potential changes to U.S. data center policy have added uncertainty to Korea’s growth outlook for 2027. The BOK projected Korea's economy to grow by 2.9 percent next year in its August forecast. The state-run Korea Development Institute and the Ministry of Finance and Economy both forecast 2.2 percent, in August and July respectively. The International Monetary Fund projected 2.8 percent growth in October, and the OECD forecast 2.6 percent in September. The outlook could change depending on the scope of any U.S. restrictions and their impact on AI infrastructure investments. Later this month, the central bank is set to release updated economic projections, which the government is expected to reflect in its economic policy plan for next year. The developments in the U.S. are being closely watched by Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, both of which are expanding their manufacturing operations there. Texas, where Samsung Electronics is building a new foundry, has drawn particular attention following the midterm elections. Democrats Gina Hinojosa and James Talarico won the state's gubernatorial and Senate races, respectively. Hinojosa has called for conditions on taxes, electricity rates, water use and construction labor for newly approved data center projects, though she noted that projects that have already received approval can proceed. Long-term supply agreements between chipmakers and major customers could help cushion any near-term fluctuations in demand. However, much will depend on how U.S. policy takes shape and whether new restrictions affect projects already in the pipeline
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 封面故事：韩国由芯片驱动的增长面临美国可能限制数据中心的风险
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 韩国正面临越来越多的担忧：因市场担忧美国可能限制人工智能（AI）数据中心建设而引发的股市大跌，可能外溢至实体经济。分析人士周日表示，此类限制一旦实施，可能威胁韩国半导体出口，并拖累明年的增长。上周美国中期选举中，民主党获胜，这加剧了外界猜测：该党可能推动对数据中心项目实施更严格的监管，尽管目前尚未公布具体措施。今年全球人工智能热潮显著带动韩国经济，强劲的半导体出口为增长提供了主要支撑。10月，半导体占该国出口总额的49%；韩国银行（BOK）估计，该行业今年将贡献该国约一半的经济增长。这些担忧已经对韩国股市造成打击。在美国中期选举后的三个交易日，即周三至周五期间，主要指数KOSPI和二级市场KOSDAQ分别下跌10.43%和8.54%。Samsung Electronics下跌14.03%，SK hynix重挫19.03%。股市长期低迷可能侵蚀家庭财富，并进一步削弱私人消费；第三季度私人消费下降，尽管经济增长强于预期。央行预估数据显示，经济环比增长1%，远高于央行此前预测的0.3%。半导体出口和设备投资支撑了增长，但家庭支出下降0.2%，商品和服务购买量均出现下滑。他补充称，经济受影响程度将在很大程度上取决于任何限制措施的范围和严厉程度。他说：“应密切关注政策制定者和议员究竟是寻求彻底叫停数据中心建设，还是允许项目在更严格的要求下继续推进。”美国数据中心政策可能发生的变化，为韩国2027年的增长前景增添了不确定性。韩国银行在8月的预测中预计韩国经济明年增长2.9%。国有机构韩国开发研究院和财政经济部分别在8月和7月预测增长2.2%。国际货币基金组织10月预测增长2.8%，经济合作与发展组织9月预测增长2.6%。前景可能因美国限制措施的范围及其对人工智能基础设施投资的影响而发生变化。本月晚些时候，央行将发布 updated 经济预测，预计政府将在明年的经济政策计划中反映这些预测。Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正密切关注美国的发展局势，两家公司都在扩大其在该国的制造业务。中期选举后，Samsung Electronics正在那里新建晶圆厂的得克萨斯州引起了特别关注。民主党人Gina Hinojosa和James Talarico分别赢得该州州长和联邦参议员选举。Hinojosa主张对新建数据中心项目的税收、电价、用水和建筑用工设置附加条件，但她指出，已经获得批准的项目可以继续推进。芯片制造商与主要客户之间的长期供应协议，有助于缓冲近期需求波动。然而，最终结果将很大程度上取决于美国政策的形成方式，以及新限制措施是否影响已经进入实施阶段的项目

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权后，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 周日，专家和业内人士表示，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，Coupang在美国扩大游说策略、拓展共和党盟友以外政治关系的压力日益增加。业内人士表示，Coupang可能会加大在美国的游说力度，以抵御韩国监管压力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: E-commerce giant feels pressure to broaden political ties as Republican allies lose control of key committees Coupang is facing growing pressure to broaden its lobbying strategy in the United States beyond its Republican allies following the Democrats' sweeping midterm election victory, experts and industry officials said Sunday. The change could be particularly impactful for the e-commerce giant, whose lobbying efforts have helped draw attention in Washington to its dispute with Korean regulators. Republican lawmakers, including members of the House Judiciary Committee, have publicly criticized what they described as discriminatory treatment of the U.S.-headquartered firm in Korea. With Democrats now set to control both chambers of Congress, the institutional backing Coupang has received from Republican lawmakers is expected to weaken, prompting experts and industry watchers to say the company will have to broaden its relationships across both parties to maintain its influence in Washington. “Especially for a digital-focused firm like Coupang, which remains subject to policies under the Republican administration, it is important to balance lobbying efforts between Democrats and Republicans,” said Shin Won-kyu, head of the global economic research team at the Federation of Korean Industries. Coupang's political spending already shows signs of such a shift. According to political contribution records filed with the Federal Election Commission, COUPAC, a political action committee established by Coupang to support U.S. congressional candidates, contributed $185,000 (252 million won) to members of Congress and affiliated political organizations during the first three quarters of this year, up 18.2 percent from a year earlier. Of this year's contributions, $107,000 went to Democratic lawmakers, Democratic-affiliated election organizations and political action committees, while $78,000 went to Republicans and their affiliated groups. Coupang's contributions to Democrats jumped 52.9 percent from a year earlier, while those to Republicans fell 9.8 percent. The figures indicate that the company had already stepped up its overall political spending ahead of the midterms, anticipating a Democratic victory. The shift suggests Coupang had begun preparing for a possible change in the balance of power. "Coupang should pursue lobbying on roughly a 50-50 basis to maintain a balance in the U.S.," said Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University. “U.S. President Donald Trump is still a Republican, while Democrats now control both chambers of Congress.” The need for a bipartisan strategy is closely tied to the nature of Coupang's regulatory dispute in Korea. The company has faced scrutiny from Korean authorities over its handling of a massive data breach and other alleged business malpractices, and some U.S. lawmakers have raised concerns about whether Korean regulators are treating U.S. companies fairly. In July, Republican Rep. Michael Baumgartner, a vocal supporter of Coupang in Congress, introduced a bill that would bar foreign government officials from entering the U.S. if they engage in economic discrimination against U.S. companies. He won reelection in Washington state, but will return to a House controlled by Democrats — underscoring the need for Coupang to expand its lobbying reach beyond Republican allies. Industry officials said Coupang could step up its lobbying efforts in the U.S. as it seeks to defend itself against regulatory pressure in Korea. “Korean regulatory authorities show no signs of backing down from their hard-line stance against Coupang’s data breach or other unfair business activities, so the company will rely more on U.S. lobbying to raise its voice against Korean authorities,” an industry official said. A Coupang spokesperson declined to comment on the details of its U.S. lobbying strategy
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: 中期选举后，Coupang面临扩大美国游说战略的压力
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 共和党盟友失去关键委员会控制权，电商巨头面临扩大政治关系的压力 专家和行业官员周日报道称，在民主党于中期选举中取得全面胜利后，电商巨头Coupang面临越来越大的压力，需要将其在美国的游说策略从共和党盟友扩大到其他阵营。这一变化对这家电商巨头的影响可能尤其显著，因为其游说努力曾帮助提请华盛顿关注该公司与韩国监管机构的争端。包括众议院司法委员会成员在内的共和党议员，曾公开批评他们所称的美国总部设在韩国的企业遭受歧视性待遇。随着民主党即将控制国会两院，Republican议员给予Coupang的机构支持预计将减弱，促使专家和行业观察人士表示，该公司必须扩大与两党的关系，才能维持在华盛顿的影响力。 韩国商工联会全球经济研究团队负责人Shin Won-kyu表示：“尤其是对于Coupang这样一家以数字业务为主的公司而言，其业务仍受共和党政府政策约束，因此在民主党和共和党之间平衡游说努力十分重要。” Coupang的政治支出已经显现出这种转变的迹象。根据提交给联邦选举委员会的政治献金记录，Coupang为支持美国国会候选人而成立的政治行动委员会COUPAC，今年前三个季度向国会议员及其关联政治组织捐出185,000美元（2.52亿韩元），较上年同期增长18.2%。今年捐款中，107,000美元流向民主党议员、民主党关联选举组织和政治行动委员会，78,000美元则流向共和党及其关联团体。Coupang对民主党的捐款较上年同期跃升52.9%，对共和党的捐款则下降9.8%。这些数字显示，公司在中期选举前已加大整体政治支出，预判民主党将取得胜利。这一转变表明，Coupang已经开始为权力格局可能发生的变化做准备。 世宗大学工商管理学教授Kim Dae-jong表示：“Coupang应当以大约五五开的比例开展游说，以维持在美国内部的平衡。”“美国总统唐纳德·特朗普仍是共和党人，而民主党现在控制着国会两院。” 采取两党战略的需要与Coupang在韩国所面临监管争端的性质密切相关。该公司因处理大规模数据泄露及其他涉嫌不当商业行为而受到韩国当局审查，一些美国议员则担忧韩国监管机构是否公平对待美国企业。7月，共和党众议员Michael Baumgartner在国会上大力支持Coupang，并提出一项法案，禁止对实施经济歧视的美国企业的外国政府官员进入美国。他在华盛顿州成功连任，但将回到由民主党控制的众议院，这进一步凸显了Coupang需要将游说触角扩大到共和党盟友之外。 行业官员表示，Coupang正在寻求抵御韩国的监管压力，因此可能加大在美国的游说力度。一名行业官员说：“韩国监管机构没有迹象表明会放弃针对Coupang数据泄露及其他不公平商业活动的强硬立场，因此该公司将更多依靠美国游说活动来反对韩国当局。” Coupang发言人拒绝对其美国游说策略的细节置评

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策有关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权移交首尔，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，根据商定条件推进移交。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The United States acknowledged that certain policy-related variables could affect the transfer of wartime operational control (OPCON) to Seoul, but reaffirmed its commitment to the existing bilateral agreement that the handover will proceed based on agreed conditions, a Korean lawmaker said Sunday. Rep. Jin Sung-joon of the ruling Democratic Party of Korea (DPK), who chairs the National Assembly’s National Defense Committee, briefed reporters at the National Assembly on the outcome of a parliamentary delegation’s trip to the United States from Nov. 1 to 5. He said the delegation was granted entry approval only at the last minute, but was still able to proceed with its scheduled visit to U.S. Indo-Pacific Command and its subordinate component commands in Hawaii. Asked whether the Democratic sweep in the U.S. midterm elections could affect the OPCON transfer process, Jin said he did not expect any significant changes. "Korea and the U.S. have discussed and reached agreements over OPCON transfer for more than 20 years. A Democratic victory (in the U.S.) would not affect the existing bilateral agreements," he said. Regarding the postponement of the Security Consultative Meeting between Korea and the U.S., originally scheduled for November, until next year, Jin cited U.S. officials saying the delay was unrelated to any differences over the OPCON transfer. "The U.S. said the decision was made after taking into account the two countries' defense ministers' and senior military officials' schedules," he added. Jin said U.S. officials assessed the security situation on the Korean Peninsula as stable, despite a series of North Korean actions in the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ), including the demolition of inter-Korean connecting roads and the fortification of areas along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL). "However, the officials stressed the need to maintain military readiness, citing North Korea's growing nuclear and missile capabilities and the possibility of abrupt policy shifts," said Jin. Adm. Stephen T. Koehler, commander of the U.S. Pacific Fleet, reportedly said Korea's pursuit of nuclear-powered submarines could strengthen the alliance, expressing willingness to cooperate pending policy decisions by both governments. On Seoul’s request for cooperation in relocating Gwangju Air Base to build a mega semiconductor cluster, Gen. Kevin B. Schneider, commander of Pacific Air Forces, said the relocation is a sovereign decision for the Korean government, while the U.S. military's role is to assess and advise on potential military risks. Asked whether United States Forces of Korea Commander Gen. Xavier Brunson came up in the talks, Jin said he did, but declined to elaborate. Brunson recently drew criticism from ruling party lawmakers after he said, at a seminar in Washington on Oct. 14, that Korea begins at the southern boundary fence line of the DMZ from the perspective of the United Nations Command. The remark sparked controversy because it could be interpreted as placing Korea’s territorial boundary at the southern edge of the DMZ, 2 kilometers south of the MDL. The southern half of the DMZ, which includes villages where South Korean residents live, lies north of that line
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 国防委员会主席称，尽管美国中期选举结果如何，OPCON协议仍然有效
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 一名韩国议员周日表示，美国承认某些与政策相关的变量可能影响战时作战指挥权（OPCON）移交首尔的时间，但再次强调将遵守现有双边协议，在既定条件下推进移交。执政的韩国民主党的金成埈议员担任国会国防委员会主席，他在国会向记者介绍国会代表团于11月1日至5日访问美国的成果。他说，该代表团直到最后一刻才获准入境，但仍得以按计划访问美国印太司令部及其下属驻夏威夷各司令部。记者问，美国中期选举中民主党获胜是否可能影响OPCON移交进程，金成埈表示，他预计不会出现重大变化。他说：“韩国和美国就OPCON移交问题已经讨论并达成协议超过20年。民主党（在美国）获胜不会影响现有双边协议。”谈及原定于11月举行、后推迟至明年的韩美安全磋商会议，金成埈援引美国官员的话称，推迟与双方在OPCON移交问题上的分歧无关。他补充说：“美国表示，这一决定是在考虑两国国防部长和高级军事官员的日程后作出的。”金成埈说，尽管朝鲜在非军事区（DMZ）采取一系列行动，包括拆除南北连接道路以及在军事分界线沿线加固设施，美国官员仍评估朝鲜半岛安全局势保持稳定。金成埈说：“不过，这些官员强调必须维持战备状态，理由是朝鲜的核与导弹能力不断增强，其政策也可能突然转向。”据报道，美国太平洋舰队司令斯蒂芬·T·科勒海军上将表示，韩国发展核动力潜艇的努力能够加强同盟，并表示愿意在两国政府作出政策决定前提供合作。应首尔请求，为建设大型半导体产业集群而合作搬迁光州空军基地，太平洋空军司令凯文·B·施奈德将军表示，搬迁是韩国政府的主权决定，而美国军队的职责是评估潜在军事风险并提供建议。记者问，驻韩美军司令泽维尔·布伦森将军是否在会谈中被提及，金成埈表示确有提及，但拒绝进一步说明。布伦森最近受到执政党议员批评。他于10月14日在华盛顿的一场研讨会上表示，从联合国司令部角度看，韩国始于非军事区南侧围栏线。这番言论引发争议，因为它可能被解读为把韩国的领土边界划在非军事区南缘，即军事分界线以南2公里处。非军事区南半部包括有韩国居民居住的村庄，位于该界线以北

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.summary_zh: 韩国股市遭遇“黑色星期五”，亟需改革。韩国股市最近的“黑色星期五”引发熔断机制与卖方停牌机制同时启动，主要交易所指数下跌逾6%。与此同时，上周中期选举后立即上涨的美国股市指数也出现下跌。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body: 'Black Friday' for KOSPI prompts needs for reforms The recent "Black Friday" for the Korean stock market brought a frantic mixture of a circuit breaker and sell-side sidecars as the main bourse fell more than 6 percent. Benchmark KOSPI heavyweights SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also took a hit, with their shares falling 10.44 percent and 6.35 percent, respectively, as investors sold in panic, driving the index below 5,000 during trading. Meanwhile, U.S. indexes that had risen immediately after last week's midterm elections also fell. Investors and policymakers woke up to a changed economic climate, triggered by a shift in the U.S. political landscape. Any optimism that last week's U.S. midterm elections had reaffirmed the country’s democratic values was tempered by concerns over the Democrats’ agenda to regulate artificial intelligence (AI) and restrict data center construction. A deeper concern is that these policy shifts come amid growing skepticism over whether the AI boom is actually a bubble and whether massive investments in the sector will ultimately generate profits. Other Asian stock markets, including Taiwan's, also declined Friday. But Seoul’s heavy reliance on its semiconductor sector amplified market volatility, which was pushed up even higher by President Lee Jae Myung's strong pledge to tackle the so-called "Korea discount." In response to the sharp decline, senior officials from Korea’s economic, financial regulatory and monetary agencies convened to discuss emergency measures, including a three-month exemption from collateral reserve requirements on loans to investors in an effort to curb further selling. The measure may for the time being bring some peace to investors, but they now depressed and distrustful are also likely to be wary of government measures. Aggressive investments in AI and a sustained drive in the U.S. to build data centers also contributed to the strong performance by Korea's top chipmakers. But the market landscape has shifted, as has the balance of power in the U.S. Congress. The episode should prompt Korea and its financial authorities to pursue more fundamental reforms to guard against future market shocks. Structural reforms take time, but with the Korean economy forecast to grow by around 3 percent this year, the country must use that momentum to diversify its economic base and reduce its vulnerability to external shocks. We have repeatedly called for greater economic diversification, particularly to reduce the concentration of semiconductors in Korea’s exports and stock market. Exports of semiconductors including high-bandwidth memory and conventional memory chips are estimated to account for about 40 percent of the country’s total exports, which are on track to reach a record $1 trillion as early as this month. SK hynix and Samsung Electronics also make up about 40 percent of KOSPI's total market capitalization. This structure cannot continue to drive sustainable growth for Korea, nor can it produce the surplus profits that fill government coffers. At the same time, Korea cannot afford to lose its competitive edge in semiconductors and must continue investing in research, development and innovation, as reflected in the government’s plans for three major semiconductor projects. The surplus profits from the current chip boom gave the government the confidence to pursue its "three megaprojects," but it still needs future growth engines. Policymakers should focus on deregulation to revive the automotive, shipping and battery sectors, while fostering an environment for emerging sectors such as robotics, biotechnology and small modular reactors to become new engines of growth
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.title_zh: 美国中期选举结果影响韩国股市指数
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/edi.body_zh: 韩国股市经历“黑色星期五”，凸显改革需求。韩国股市近期经历“黑色星期五”，主要交易所综合指数跌幅超过6%，熔断机制与卖方临时停牌机制同时启动，市场陷入恐慌。基准指数KOSPI的权重股SK hynix和Samsung Electronics也遭重创，股价分别下跌10.44%和6.35%。投资者恐慌抛售，指数在交易期间跌破5,000点。与此同时，上周美国中期选举结束后一度上涨的美国各大股指也出现下跌。投资者和政策制定者醒来后面对的是一种已经改变的经济环境，其诱因是美国政治格局的转变。上周美国中期选举重新确认该国民主价值观，本应令人们感到乐观，但民主党监管人工智能（AI）和限制数据中心建设的议程引发了担忧。更深层的忧虑在于，人们日益怀疑人工智能热潮是否真是一股泡沫，以及对该行业的大规模投资最终能否创造利润。包括台湾在内的其他亚洲股市周五也出现下跌。然而，首尔过度依赖半导体行业，加剧了市场波动；李在明总统大力承诺解决所谓的“韩国折价”，进一步推高了波动。为应对这一急跌，韩国经济、金融监管和货币机构的高层官员召开会议，讨论应急措施，包括对投资者贷款实施3个月的抵押品准备金要求豁免，以遏制进一步抛售。这项措施或许能暂时安抚投资者，但当前情绪低落、疑虑重重的投资者也可能对政府措施保持警惕。对人工智能进行激进投资，以及美国持续推动建设数据中心，也助力韩国头部芯片制造商取得亮眼表现。然而，市场格局已经改变，美国国会中的权力平衡也是如此。这一事件应促使韩国及其金融 authorities推进更为根本的改革，以防范未来的市场冲击。结构性改革需要时间，而预计韩国经济今年将增长约3%，该国必须利用这一势头实现经济基础多元化，降低对外部冲击的脆弱性。我们反复呼吁推进更大程度的经济多元化，尤其是降低半导体在韩国出口和股市中的集中度。包括高带宽内存和传统存储芯片在内的半导体出口，据估计约占该国出口总额的40%；出口总额最早有望在本月达到创纪录的1万亿美元。SK hynix和Samsung Electronics还合计占KOSPI总市值约40%。这种结构无法继续为韩国推动可持续增长，也无法创造充盈政府财政的过剩利润。与此同时，韩国不能失去在半导体领域的竞争优势，必须继续投资研发和创新；政府计划推进的3个大型半导体项目正体现了这一点。当前芯片热潮带来的过剩利润使政府有信心推进其“三大超级项目”，但韩国仍需打造未来的增长引擎。政策制定者应重点推进放松管制，以重振汽车、航运和电池行业，同时为机器人、生物技术和小型模块化反应堆等新兴行业营造环境，使其成为新的增长引擎

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: US calls for coordinated action against N. Korean cyber threats following Binance hack
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 美国星期六呼吁加强国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动，此前发生了涉及Binance的大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复中告诉韩联社：“尤其考虑到Binance近期遭黑客攻击，各国政府必须携手合作，尽到各自责任，减轻朝鲜带来的网络威胁，并切断朝鲜的非法收入来源。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: The United States on Saturday called for international cooperation to combat North Korea's illicit cyber activities following a massive cryptocurrency theft involving Binance. "Particularly in light of the recent hack of Binance, it is critical for governments to work together and do their own part to mitigate the DPRK cyber threat and curb illicit DPRK revenue generation," a State Department spokesperson told Yonhap News Agency in a written response. DPRK stands for the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, North Korea's official name. The remarks were made in response to an inquiry about potential coordination between Washington and Seoul on additional sanctions following the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's attribution of the cryptocurrency theft to North Korean actors. The spokesperson also emphasized the importance of enforcing existing international sanctions and taking measures to prevent Pyongyang from financing its weapons programs. "We expect all U.N. member states to enforce existing sanctions and take proactive measures to prevent the DPRK from funding its unlawful WMD and ballistic missile programs," the spokesperson said. "Coordinated unilateral sanctions continue to be a strong tool to prevent the flow of money that supports the proliferation of weapons," the spokesperson added. The remarks came after a South Korean unification ministry official said Thursday that Seoul had not yet begun discussing sanctions over the incident because the circumstances surrounding the theft had not been fully established. South Korea's foreign ministry separately said it was internally reviewing possible additional measures, including unilateral cyber sanctions, but that no decision had been made. The State Department did not directly address whether Washington had shared investigative findings with Seoul or held bilateral discussions on additional sanctions in connection with the incident
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: Binance遭黑客攻击后，美国呼吁协调应对朝鲜网络威胁
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 美国周六呼吁开展国际合作，打击朝鲜的非法网络活动。此前，Binance遭遇大规模加密货币盗窃案。美国国务院发言人在书面回复韩联社时表示：“尤其考虑到近期Binance被盗事件，各国政府必须加强合作，各尽其责，减轻朝鲜网络威胁，并切断朝鲜非法收入来源。”DPRK是朝鲜的正式名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”。这番表态是在回应有关华盛顿与首尔可能协调追加制裁的问题。此前，美国联邦调查局将该起加密货币盗窃案归咎于朝鲜方面。该发言人还强调，执行现有国际制裁以及采取措施阻止平壤资助其武器计划至关重要。发言人说：“我们期望所有联合国会员国执行现有制裁，并采取主动措施，防止朝鲜为其非法的大规模杀伤性武器和弹道导弹计划提供资金。”发言人补充道：“协调一致的单边制裁仍是阻止资金流向支持武器扩散势力的有力工具。”此前，韩国统一部官员周四表示，由于围绕这起盗窃案的有关情况尚未完全查明，首尔尚未开始讨论针对此事的制裁。韩国外交部则单独表示，正在内部审查可能采取的追加措施，包括单边网络制裁，但尚未作出决定。美国国务院没有直接回应华盛顿是否与首尔共享了调查结论，或双方是否就与此案有关的追加制裁举行了双边讨论

https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.title: 2027 Elections: 70 Attacks, 27 Dead As Political Violence Escalates
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti.
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.summary_zh: CentreSGD在周日的新闻声明中表示，不断加剧的暴力行为对选举进程构成系统性威胁，距离2027年1月16日举行的总统和国民议会选举已不足70天。CentreSGD列举了恩古、卡塔西、埃基蒂、索科托和凯比等地近期发生的袭击，包括据报道在恩古的一次竞选启动集会上杀害一名全国民主大会党支持者、在卡塔西袭击全尼日利亚进步大会党车队，以及在阿多-埃基蒂袭击争取人民民主党总统候选人奥莫耶莱·索沃雷。
https://leadership.ng/2027-elections-70-.body: In a press statement on Sunday, CentreSGD said the rising violence posed a systemic threat to the electoral process, with fewer than 70 days remaining before the January 16, 2027 presidential and National Assembly elections. . Citing Yiaga Africa’s September 2026 National Voting Intentions Survey, the centre said 61 per cent of Nigerians feared violence could prevent them from voting, with the figure rising to 78 per cent in the North-East. She added that 84 per cent of respondents were likely or very likely to vote, while 83 per cent said improved security would encourage participation. CentreSGD identified recent attacks in Enugu, Katsina, Ekiti, Sokoto and Kebbi, including the reported killing of an NDC supporter during a campaign flag-off in Enugu, attacks on APC convoys in Katsina, and the assault on AAC presidential candidate Omoyele Sowore in Ado-Ekiti. The ED also cited allegations of attacks on ADC campaign convoys in Sokoto and Kebbi. The centre noted that some of the incidents were disputed by the parties and authorities concerned, stressing that it did not pronounce on culpability but demanded thorough investigations and prosecution where evidence warranted. The Centre said police arrests linked to the Katsina and Ekiti incidents should lead to transparent prosecutions. It warned that fear could undermine voter participation, particularly among young people, women and persons with disabilities, noting that only 40 per cent of young respondents were very likely to vote, compared with 64 per cent of Nigerians aged 61 and above. The organisation also expressed concern over alleged use of state-linked security outfits and administrative machinery against opposition parties, citing the Sokoto convoy allegations, the sealing of the ADC state office and reported campaign billboard permit fees of up to N200 million in Abia and N150 million in Enugu, Kogi and Cross River. CentreSGD called on the Nigeria Police Force and other security agencies to conduct prompt, transparent and non-partisan investigations into election-related attacks and prosecute perpetrators and sponsors regardless of political affiliation. It also urged political leaders and candidates to condemn violent rhetoric and enforce discipline among party supporters. The centre further called on INEC and the Inter-Agency Consultative Committee on Election Security to publish a threat-based national election security plan, while urging state governments to guarantee equal access to campaign venues, public facilities, permits and advertising spaces. https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.title: Olawepo-Hashim Meets US Commission Over Nigeria’s 3.6m IDPs, Maisango’s Release
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.summary: Olawepo-Hashim made the call during an engagement with the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF), where he raised concerns over religious persecution, ethnic discrimination, insecurity and the continued displacement of vulnerable communities across the country.
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.summary_zh: 奥拉韦波-哈希姆在与美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF）举行活动时提出上述呼吁。他在活动中表达了对此全国范围内宗教迫害、族群歧视、安全局势恶化以及弱势社区持续流离失所的担忧。
https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.body: Olawepo-Hashim made the call during an engagement with the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom (USCIRF), where he raised concerns over religious persecution, ethnic discrimination, insecurity and the continued displacement of vulnerable communities across the country. The Accord Party candidate, described as the first major opposition political leader to be engaged by the Commission, also called for the immediate release of Hausa cultural activist, Maisango, whom he alleged was being unlawfully detained without trial. According to a statement from his media office on Sunday, during the engagement on Friday, Olawepo-Hashim acknowledged that Christians in Northern Nigeria face persecution but stressed that religious intolerance and discrimination in the country extend beyond the Christian-Muslim divide. He identified Shia Muslims, minority Islamic sects and Hausa Muslim communities among groups whose experiences of persecution, exclusion and discrimination deserve greater international attention. According to him, Nigeria’s religious freedom challenges are more complex than often portrayed, as ethnic identity and cultural affiliation can also determine how individuals and communities are treated, even among people who share the same religious beliefs. Olawepo-Hashim particularly highlighted the alleged marginalisation of Hausa Muslims in parts of Northern Nigeria, arguing that some communities experience unequal treatment despite professing the same Islamic faith as other groups. He also raised concerns over the continued detention of Maisango, a Hausa cultural activist, who he said remained in custody without trial despite reportedly having been dismissed from his employment with the Department of State Services (DSS). He called for Maisango’s immediate release, emphasising the need for due process, respect for fundamental human rights and protection of citizens against unlawful detention. On the humanitarian situation, Olawepo-Hashim cited approximately 3.68 million internally displaced persons in Nigeria, referencing UNHCR figures as of October 2026. He argued that the displacement crisis cuts across religious and ethnic boundaries, insisting that the plight of displaced Hausa communities and other vulnerable populations should receive equal international recognition. The Accord Party presidential candidate specifically drew attention to reported attacks on communities in Shanga Local Government Area of Kebbi State, including Kalkami, Tungar Bori and Kawara. Reports of the April 2026 attacks indicated that suspected bandits killed residents, set buildings ablaze and forced several families to flee their homes. Olawepo-Hashim said reports of the burning of 11 villages in the area required sustained international attention, alleging that some armed groups operating in the region were more interested in killing residents, destroying settlements and taking control of territories than pursuing religious conversion. He expressed concern over what he described as the government’s failure to adequately protect vulnerable communities and decisively confront armed groups responsible for violence and displacement. He warned that Nigeria must not allow its security and religious freedom challenges to deteriorate further as the country approaches another political transition. Olawepo-Hashim also criticised what he described as inadequate accountability under the present administration, alleging that political considerations had undermined efforts to confront terrorism and other forms of armed violence. Nigeria was designated a Country of Particular Concern by the United States in October 2025, following earlier recommendations by USCIRF. The Commission also called for the designation in its 2026 recommendations. Olawepo-Hashim maintained that international attention must recognise all victims of religious and ethnic persecution rather than concentrate on one religious community to the exclusion of others. He called for a comprehensive approach that acknowledges the experiences of Christians, Shia Muslims, Hausa communities and other vulnerable populations, while holding relevant state institutions accountable for their constitutional responsibility to protect citizens and guarantee fundamental rights. The Accord Party presidential candidate commended USCIRF for its work on religious freedom in Nigeria and acknowledged President Donald Trump’s interest in the issue. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/olawepo-hashim-mee.body_zh: 奥拉韦波-哈希姆在与美国国际宗教自由委员会（USCIRF）会面期间提出诉求，表达了对于宗教迫害、族群歧视、安全局势不佳以及全国脆弱社区持续流离失所的担忧。作为协议党候选人，他被描述为首位接受该委员会会面的主要反对派政治领导人，并呼吁立即释放豪萨文化活动人士迈桑戈，称其据指未经审判即遭非法拘禁。其媒体办公室周日在声明中称，在周五的会面期间，奥拉韦波-哈希姆承认尼日利亚北部的基督徒遭受迫害，但强调该国的宗教不宽容和歧视现象并不限于基督徒与穆斯林之间的分歧。他指出，什叶派穆斯林、少数伊斯兰教派以及豪萨穆斯林社区等群体遭受迫害、排斥和歧视，其经历值得国际社会给予更多关注。据他表示，尼日利亚宗教自由面临的挑战往往比外界描绘的更为复杂，因为族群身份和文化归属也会影响个人和社区的待遇，即便他们持有相同的宗教信仰。奥拉韦波-哈希姆特别强调了据称尼日利亚部分地区边缘化豪萨穆斯林的问题，认为一些社区尽管与其他群体信仰同样的伊斯兰教，却仍遭受不平等对待。他还对豪萨文化活动人士迈桑戈持续被拘禁表示关切，称尽管有报道称其已被国家安全局（DSS）解雇，但其仍在未经审判的情况下被关押。他呼吁立即释放迈桑戈，强调应依法正当行事、尊重基本人权，并保护公民免遭非法拘禁。在人道主义局势方面，奥拉韦波-哈希姆援引联合国难民署截至2026年10月的数据，称尼日利亚境内流离失所者约有368万人。他认为，流离失所危机横跨宗教和族群界限，坚持认为流离失所的豪萨社区及其他脆弱群体同样应得到国际社会的同等关注。协议党总统候选人特别提请关注据报发生在凯比州尚加地方政府辖区对社区的袭击，包括卡尔卡米、通加博里和卡瓦拉。有关2026年4月袭击的报道称，疑似匪徒杀害居民、纵火焚烧建筑，并迫使数个家庭逃离家园。奥拉韦波-哈希姆表示，该地区11个村庄遭焚烧的报告需要国际社会持续关注，并指称在该地区活动的某些武装组织更热衷于杀害居民、摧毁聚居点和控制领土，而非追求宗教皈依。他对政府未能充分保护脆弱社区、果断打击应对暴力和流离失所的武装团体表示担忧。他警告称，随着尼日利亚即将再次进行政治权力交接，该国不能让安全和宗教自由方面的挑战进一步恶化。奥拉韦波-哈希姆还批评现任政府被指问责不足，称政治层面的考量削弱了打击恐怖主义及其他形式武装暴力的努力。在USCIRF此前提出建议后，美国于2025年10月将尼日利亚列为“特别关注国家”。该委员会在其2026年建议中也呼吁作出这一指定。奥拉韦波-哈希姆坚持认为，国际社会在关注宗教和族群迫害受害者时，必须顾及所有受害者，而不应将目光集中于一个宗教群体并排斥其他群体。他呼吁采取全面方针，承认基督徒、什叶派穆斯林、豪萨社区及其他脆弱群体的经历，同时追究相关国家机构的责任，要求其履行保护公民和保障基本权利的宪法职责。协议党总统候选人赞扬USCIRF为尼日利亚宗教自由所做的工作，并认可美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对该问题的关注。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、独家内幕和独到视角，直接传送至您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，随时掌握24/7最新动态 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> 奇布佐·乌凯贝 奇布佐·乌凯贝是《领导力报》的政治记者，专门报道各政党、国民议会和选举委员会

https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.summary: The National Emergency Management Agency has received six Nigerian returnees from the United States at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos State. NEMA disclosed this in a statement posted on its X handle on Sunday, saying the returnees arrived at the airport’s Cargo Terminal on November 4, 2026.
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.summary_zh: 国家紧急事务管理局在拉各斯州穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场接收了6名从美国返回的尼日利亚人。国家紧急事务管理局周日在其X账号发布的声明中透露，这些归国人员于2026年11月4日抵达机场货运航站楼。
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.body: The National Emergency Management Agency has received six Nigerian returnees from the United States at the Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos State. NEMA disclosed this in a statement posted on its X handle on Sunday, saying the returnees arrived at the airport’s Cargo Terminal on November 4, 2026. The agency said the reception exercise was conducted through its Lagos Operations Office in collaboration with the United States Consulate, the Federal Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Nigeria Immigration Service and ExecuJet. “The returnees arrived at approximately 10:13 p.m. aboard a Beechcraft 1900 aircraft with registration number N62FF. The group comprised five males and one female, all adults. “Upon arrival, officers of the Nigeria Immigration Service conducted the necessary immigration documentation and profiling to ensure proper identification, record-keeping and a smooth arrival process. “NEMA coordinated the reception in collaboration with the relevant agencies, while necessary reception and post-arrival support services were provided to facilitate the returnees’ transition following their arrival in the country,” the statement said. The agency did not state the circumstances under which the six returned, whether they were deported or returned of their own free will. US, under President Donald Trump, intensified US immigration enforcement, which has prioritized stricter rules, accelerated removals of individuals without legal status, and targeted those with criminal records through initiatives such as the “worst of the worst” lists and West Africa Operations Watch. Nigeria has featured prominently in these efforts, with the US Department of Homeland Security publishing multiple lists of Nigerian nationals identified for deportation in 2026, often linked to offences including fraud and other violations. Meanwhile, NEMA said the returning exercise reflected the Federal Government’s efforts to ensure the safe, orderly and dignified return of Nigerian citizens through coordinated engagement among relevant agencies and partners. https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.title_zh: 图片：国家紧急情况管理局接收6名从美国返回的尼日利亚公民
https://punchng.com/photos-nema-receives.body_zh: 国家紧急事务管理局已在拉各斯州穆尔塔拉·穆罕默德国际机场接回6名从美国返回的尼日利亚人。国家紧急事务管理局周日通过其X账号发布的声明披露，这些返回人员于2026年11月4日抵达机场货运航站楼。该机构表示，接机工作由其拉各斯行动办公室协同美国领事馆、联邦外交部、尼日利亚移民局和ExecuJet开展。声明称：“这些返回人员于当地时间晚上10时13分左右抵达，乘坐一架注册号为N62FF的Beechcraft 1900飞机。该团队包括5名男性和1名女性，均为成年人。“抵达后，尼日利亚移民局工作人员办理了必要的入境文件和身份登记手续，以确保身份核验准确、记录完整以及入境流程顺畅。“国家紧急事务管理局协同相关机构统筹接机工作，并提供必要的接待和抵境后支持服务，帮助返回人员抵达本国后顺利过渡。”该机构没有说明这6人是在何种情况下返回，也没有说明他们是遭遣返还是自愿返回。在唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下，美国加强移民执法，优先执行更严格的规定，加快遣返没有合法身份的人员，并通过“最恶劣中的最恶劣”名单和西非行动观察等行动，针对有犯罪记录者。美国国土安全部在2026年公布了多份拟遣返的尼日利亚公民名单，其中许多人涉及欺诈及其他违法行为，尼日利亚在这些行动中受到广泛关注。与此同时，国家紧急事务管理局表示此次接回行动体现了联邦政府通过相关机构及合作伙伴协同努力，确保尼日利亚公民安全、有序且有尊严地回国的决心。Saheed Oyelakin Saheed是Punch Newspapers记者，拥有两年多报道都会新闻、科技、体育、政治和人物故事的经验。他专注于报道不同领域的清晰、生动新闻，其工作体现了亲自参与新闻编辑部的经验，以及对准确和平衡新闻报道的承诺
