https://www.myjoyonline.com/seven-compan.body: President John Mahama has announced that seven companies have been shortlisted for the development of the Keta Port in the Volta Region. The companies were selected from 47 that submitted expressions of interest to partner with the Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority (GPHA) as strategic partners for the project. Addressing the 2026 Hogbetsotso Festival, President Mahama said the shortlisted companies have successfully completed the due diligence stage and will now proceed to the next phase of the process. He explained that the next stage would involve completing the designs and securing financing to pave the way for construction to begin. “Due diligence has been conducted, and the list has been shortlisted to seven companies. These seven companies are proceeding to the next stage, which involves completing the designs and arranging the financing for the project to commence,” he said. The President also disclosed that the administration block for the port, which was started under the previous administration, is expected to be completed by the end of the first quarter of 2027. “Government remains committed to advancing the project on a credible foundation,” he assured. On other development projects in the Volta Region, President Mahama announced that the Sogakope-Agodome-Keta Water Project, which stalled following Ghana's debt restructuring, is expected to resume. He said the government signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the contractors in October to facilitate their return to site and the completion of the first phase. On road infrastructure, President Mahama said the Ho-Denu Road is progressing steadily and is expected to be completed in 2027. He added that procurement processes are underway for the reconstruction of the road from Central University at Miotso, near Dawhenya, to Aflao. The government is also working to secure a contractor for the Dabala-Savietula-Keta-Denu Highway. President Mahama further disclosed that several roads in the Anlo area, including the Abor-Atiavi road, has been captured under the World Bank Feeder Roads Project, with procurement expected to begin soon. On healthcare, he said discussions have been initiated during his recent visit to Korea for the resumption of financing for the upgrade of the Volta Regional Hospital in Ho. He said the upgrade would ensure that the facility is befitting of a teaching hospital. The President also announced progress towards establishing a School of Pharmacy under the University of Health and Allied Sciences (UHAS), saying land had been secured and inspected by the committee overseeing its establishment. He said the next steps would involve designing the campus and proceeding to procurement. President Mahama also pledged to support other educational infrastructure requests in the region, including a new dormitory block for Anlo-Afiadenyigba Senior High School, proposed E-Blocks for Shime and Anlo Senior High Schools, and infrastructure improvements at Atiavi Senior High School and Technical School. He further acknowledged calls for the upgrading of Ohawu Agricultural College into a university. On housing, the President said an additional GH¢500 million has been allocated for district housing projects and assured the people of Anlo that the area would benefit. He also said the Anloga 24-hour market project is on track, while preparations for the proposed Aflao Ashigame market have advanced, with land secured and designs completed. According to him, a technical team from China, financed through a grant from the Chinese Government, is expected to visit the project sites to confirm the designs before the release of a US$30 million grant to commence the project. President Mahama urged the Volta Regional Coordinating Council to closely monitor the implementation of the various projects to ensure their timely delivery

Unlock these with Subscription An ancient mound in Bihar's East Champaran district has been declared an archaeological site of national importance through a central government notification. The site – Ranivas Mound, at Kesariya – is spread over 1.63 acres and is under the ownership of the Bihar government, reads the gazette notification dated November 4 that was issued by the Ministry of Culture. Copies of the said notification were made available to the public on June 8, 2026 and "no objection has been received" from any person with regard to the declaration by the central government, said the notification signed by Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) Director General Yadubir Singh Rawat. A copy of the notification was affixed at a conspicuous place as required under sub-section (1) of section 4 of the Ancient Monuments and Archaeological Sites and Remains (AMASR) Act, 1958. A total of 3,686 sites around the country are under the care of the ASI, the Centre had informed Parliament in February 2026. A recommendation for listing the ancient Ranivas mound in Bihar as a centrally protected monument was sent to ASI headquarters in Delhi in 2021, a senior official told PTI in September 2022. According to the existing procedure, proposals or recommendations sent by regional ASI circles are examined by a team at the organisation’s headquarters before a final decision is taken on naming them monuments or sites of national importance. In case of meritorious proposals and recommendations, a provisional notification is first made, followed by the issuance of a final gazetted notification. A senior official said the inclusion of new sites under the ambit of the ASI is an ongoing process, based on recommendations received from various ASI “circles”, or regions, across the country from time to time. Centrally protected sites in Bihar fall under the jurisdiction of the ASI’s Patna Circle. Currently, 70 sites in Bihar are under the ambit of the ASI and governed by the Patna Circle, which is one of the oldest regional circles in India. The Patna Circle was earlier known as the Mid-Eastern Circle, and still earlier as the Buddhist Circle, ostensibly because of the important Buddhist monuments lying in the area, according to the Circle’s website. The ruins of the ancient Nalanda University in Bihar, also under the ASI, are a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The ancestral house of India’s first president Rajendra Prasad in Ziradei, Siwan, north Bihar, was officially declared a protected monument on May 27, 1991. Its provisional notification was done on October 30, 1990. The Shiva Temple in Gaya was notified by the ASI in 1996. Since then, no fresh site in Bihar had been brought under the ambit of the ASI, the senior official had said in September 2022. The Patna Circle earlier covered Jharkhand and a large number of sites in eastern Uttar Pradesh. While the Ranchi Circle was created in 2003 after Jharkhand was carved out of Bihar in 2000, a separate Sarnath Circle was created in 2013 for sites falling in eastern Uttar Pradesh. The ASI was established in 1861, with Alexander Cunningham as the first head of the institution. Comments have to be in English, and in full sentences. They cannot be abusive or personal. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/b.body_zh: 订阅账户还可享受 Premium Stories、Editorials、Opinions 等内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。印度比哈尔邦东昌帕兰县的一座古土丘，经中央政府发布通知，已被宣布为国家重要考古遗址。文化和旅游部于11月4日发布的官方公报通知称，该遗址位于克萨里亚的拉尼瓦斯土丘，占地1.63英亩，归比哈尔邦政府所有。通知副本于2026年6月8日向社会公开，并由印度考古局（ASI）总监察长亚杜比尔·辛格·拉瓦特签署。通知称，中央政府作出这一宣布后，“未收到任何人的异议”。根据《1958年古迹与考古遗址及遗迹法》（AMASR Act, 1958）第4条第（1）款的规定，通知副本已张贴在显著位置。2026年2月，中央政府告知议会，全国共有3,686处遗址由印度考古局负责管理。2022年9月，一名高级官员告诉印度报业托拉斯（PTI），将比哈尔邦古老的拉尼瓦斯土丘列为中央保护古迹的建议，于2021年送交位于德里的印度考古局总部。按照现行程序，各地区印度考古局分局提交的提案或建议，均由该机构总部的团队审查，之后再就是否将其命名为国家重要古迹或遗址作出最终决定。对于有价值的提案和建议，首先会发布临时通知，随后发布正式的官方公报通知。一名高级官员称，将新遗址纳入印度考古局管理范围是一项持续进行的工作，依据的是该局各分局或地区不时提交的建议。印度考古局在比哈尔邦管理的中央保护遗址，隶属该局巴特那分局管辖。目前，比哈尔邦有70处遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围，由巴特那分局负责监管；该分局是印度历史最悠久的地区分局之一。据该分局网站称，巴特那分局此前称为中东部分局，更早时称为佛教分局，表面上是因为该地区分布着重要的佛教古迹。同样由印度考古局管理的比哈尔邦古老那烂陀大学遗址，是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。印度首任总统拉金德拉·普拉萨德位于比哈尔邦北部锡万县齐拉代伊的祖居，于1991年5月27日正式宣布为受保护古迹，其临时通知于1990年10月30日发布。加亚的湿婆神庙于1996年被印度考古局列入通知名录。这名高级官员曾在2022年9月表示，自那以后，比哈尔邦没有新增遗址纳入印度考古局的管理范围。巴特那分局此前还负责贾坎德邦以及北方邦东部的大量遗址。2000年贾坎德邦从比哈尔邦分出后，兰契分局于2003年成立；2013年，又为北方邦东部境内的遗址成立了萨纳特分局。印度考古局成立于1861年，亚历山大·坎宁安担任该机构首任负责人。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得含有辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论指南。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你还没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录自己的账户后，可以查看此前在 Vuukle 上发表的旧评论。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/npp-usa-elec.body: A member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP)’s United States branch, Opoku Boateng, has called for in-person voting and an immediate election timetable as the November 30 deadline for outstanding party polls approaches. In a statement, he raised concerns about what he described as inadequate communication from the committee overseeing the NPP-USA elections. According to Mr Boateng, members have yet to receive an election date, a published timetable or information on the register of eligible voters. “Members are not asking for miracles. They are asking for a timetable,” he said. He cited an October 29, 2026, directive by NPP General Secretary Justin Kodua requiring all outstanding elections to be completed by November 30. Mr Boateng argued that the lack of a clear roadmap was making it difficult for members to prepare and for candidates to organise their campaigns. The statement said the NPP-USA election was initially expected in July 2026 but was postponed after disagreements over an electronic voting system developed by NPP Ghana. According to Mr Boateng, members questioned the platform’s independence and raised concerns that it had not been tested in Ghana's elections. “It is important to understand that rejecting a particular voting platform does not mean rejecting democracy, technology, or the desire to elect leaders,” he said. As an alternative, he proposed voting at the various chapters, with results subsequently collated at the NPP-USA branch level. He also called for consideration of a regulated proxy voting arrangement for members unable to attend physically. He said this should include verification and accountability measures to prevent duplication, impersonation, and abuse. “The proposal is not intended to complicate the election. It is intended to build confidence,” he said. Mr Boateng also questioned how the electoral committee had been constituted. He alleged that the General Secretary established it directly, without the expected consultation with NPP-USA executives. He urged the committee to engage chapter leaders, executives, candidates and members to address concerns and build confidence in the process. His demands include publishing the voter register, allowing members to verify their eligibility and clarifying voting and results-collation procedures. He cautioned against waiting until the final days before the deadline to announce arrangements. “A credible election cannot be organised through last-minute announcements, hurried arrangements, and inadequate communication,” he said. While acknowledging the importance of meeting the deadline, Mr Boateng said speed should not come at the expense of fairness. He appealed to members to remain united despite differences over candidates and voting methods, saying the priority should be an election that strengthens the branch

Unlock these with Subscription Hundreds of students under the aegis of All India Democratic Students’ Organisation (AIDSO) staged a protest at Vivekananda Circle in Dharwad on Friday, condemning the State government’s move to allow adoption of government schools by private institutions and corporate companies. Addressing the protesters, AIDSO district secretary Shashikala Meti alleged that the Congress government, which had promised to protect government schools, was pursuing policies such as the Karnataka Public Schools (KPS)-Magnet initiative and an agreement with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) that would undermine the public education system. She alleged that the government had held a meeting at Vidhana Soudha on November 4 to facilitate the handing over of government schools to private institutions and corporate companies, with 2,000 schools proposed to be taken up in the first phase. She termed the move a betrayal of the people. Ms. Meti also criticised Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and the government representatives for allegedly making derogatory remarks about government school teachers and blaming them for declining educational standards, while overlooking shortcomings in its own policies. She said the government was proposing that private institutions adopt three government schools each, with the provision to name the schools after the adopting institutions. Other proposals reportedly included deputing teachers from private schools and providing old buses, laboratory equipment and computers. The government should address deficiencies in public education and recruit adequate numbers of teachers instead of shifting its responsibility to private entities, she said. Ms. Meti alleged that 14 government schools had already been merged with the KPS at Hegganuru in Kanakapura, Bengaluru South district, contradicting the government’s assurance that no government school would be closed. She demanded the immediate withdrawal of the government’s education policies and called upon the public to join a movement against what she termed the “corporate takeover” of public education. AIDSO district president Sindhu Kou di, district organisers Shantesh Nandikollam, Siddalingappa Chippalakatti and Ravishankar Poladi, among others took part in the protest. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/k.body_zh: 订阅还可享受独家报道、社论、观点等更多内容。订阅即可解锁这些内容。全印度民主学生组织（AIDSO）庇护下的数百名学生于周五在达尔瓦德的维韦坎达广场举行抗议，谴责邦政府允许私立机构和公司接管公立学校的举措。AIDSO地区秘书沙西卡拉·梅蒂在向抗议者发表讲话时指控，国大党政府曾承诺保护公立学校，却正在推行卡纳塔克邦公立学校（KPS）磁吸计划以及与亚洲开发银行（ADB）达成协议等政策，这些政策将削弱公共教育体系。她指控，政府于11月4日在立法会议大厦举行会议，为将公立学校移交给私立机构和公司提供便利，并提议第一阶段接收2,000所学校。她称此举背叛了民众。梅蒂女士还批评首席部长D.K.希瓦库马尔及政府代表，指责他们贬损公立学校教师、将教育水平下降归咎于教师，却忽视自身政策中的缺陷。她说，政府提议由私立机构每接管3所公立学校，并允许学校以接管机构命名。据报道，其他提议还包括从私立学校借调教师，以及提供旧公交车、实验室设备和计算机。她说，政府应当解决公共教育中的不足并招聘足够数量的教师，而不是把责任转嫁给私营实体。梅蒂女士指控，在班加罗尔南区的卡纳克普拉海加努鲁，已有14所公立学校并入KPS，这违背了政府关于不会关闭任何公立学校的保证。她要求政府立即撤回这些教育政策，并呼吁公众加入反对她所称公共教育“企业接管”的运动。AIDSO地区主席辛杜·库迪、地区组织者尚特什·南迪科拉姆、西达林加帕·奇帕拉卡蒂和拉维申卡尔·波拉迪等人参加了抗议。评论必须使用英语，并以完整句子表达。评论不得含有辱骂性或人身攻击内容。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》的注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户登录账户后可在Vuukle上查看过去的评论

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: NEW YORK — AI stocks are bouncing back Friday and recovering some of their sell-off from the last two days. The rest of the U.S. stock market is mixed following a whirlwind few days of Wall Street trying to sort out what this week’s sweeping victories by Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections will mean for the economy. The S&P 500 rose 0.9 percent and trimmed its loss for the week to 2.1 percent. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 3 points, or less than 0.1 percent, as of 11:45 a.m. Eastern time, and the Nasdaq composite was 1.6 percent higher. Even with this week's extreme swings, the S&P 500 remains only 5.1 percent below its all-time high, which was set last month. It and other companies tied to the build-out of AI data centers tumbled this week on worries that Democratic victories in statehouses across the country could mean a slowdown in further construction, particularly in Texas. Voters across political parties say they’re wary about AI and don’t like increases to power bills caused by data centers. That built on top of worries already rattling the industry that further construction of AI data centers may slow because of how expensive it’s become to borrow money. Before that, even, critics were saying AI stock prices had shot too high and were in a bubble. But political power in Washington will still be split between a Democratic Congress and a White House run by the Republican Trump, who retains the power to veto. That could limit federal efforts to rein in the AI industry. In the meantime, companies in the industry still see strong growth. IREN, a company that delivers data centers, compute and software for AI training, reported stronger results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. Its stock jumped 19.5 percent, and it also announced two new contracts signed since the end of the quarter. “We own the land, the power and the data centers under all of it, which gives us more ways to fund growth and lets us set its pace,” co-CEO Daniel Roberts said. Lam Research, a company whose equipment and services help make semiconductors, climbed 9.9 percent after announcing a program to send up to $25 billion to its investors by buying back shares of its own stock. That helped other stocks that have benefited from the build-out of AI data centers recover some of their own sharp losses. CoreWeave, which rents out access to AI chips to customers over the cloud, rose 4.5 percent. Micron Technology, which sells memory for computers, climbed 5.9 percent. Outside of AI, the U.S. stock market was mixed, and slightly more stocks fell within the S&P 500 than rose. Axon Enterprise tumbled 17.6 percent after the seller of Tasers reported weaker results for the latest quarter than analysts expected. It also announced a $1.2 billion investment in Skydio, a drone technology company. Charter Communications sank 5 percent after the internet and video provider reported a loss for the latest quarter, when analysts were expecting a profit. In the bond market, Treasury yields recovered some of their sharp drops from earlier in the week, triggered by tumbling stock prices and hopes that split control of Washington could limit how much more the U.S. government adds to its debt. The yield on the 10-year Treasury edged up to 4.85 percent from 4.84 percent late Thursday. It had topped 5.30 percent last month when worries about inflation, higher interest rates and rising government debt were spiking. Helping to support yields was a report showing U.S. employers hired many more workers last month than economists expected. It’s the latest signal that the U.S. economy continues to chug along despite high inflation. On one hand, the encouraging data could mean the U.S. economy may be able to absorb a slowdown in construction of AI data centers. But at the same time, the strong growth in jobs could push upward on inflation. Following the report, traders saw a greater probability of the Federal Reserve hiking its short-term interest rate at its next meeting in December, according to data from CME Group. Rate hikes by the Fed can rein in inflation, but they do so by making borrowing money more expensive for everyone and slowing the overall economy. A separate report, meanwhile, suggested that sentiment among U.S. consumers unexpectedly improved. The preliminary report from the University of Michigan said sentiment rose for lower- and middle-wealth Americans but fell for those with the largest stock portfolios. Perhaps more importantly for the bond market, the survey also suggested expectations for inflation in the coming year eased for Americans. That could prevent a vicious cycle where expectations for high inflation drive behavior that only worsens inflation
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 人工智能概念股遭全球抛售，华尔街本周跌幅收窄
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 纽约消息——人工智能股票周五反弹，收复了过去两天抛售的部分跌幅。在华尔街经历了一连串跌宕起伏、试图判断本周民主党在美国中期选举中取得广泛胜利将如何影响经济之后，美国股市其余板块涨跌互现。标普500指数上涨0.9%，全周跌幅收窄至2.1%。截至东部时间上午11时45分，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌3点，跌幅不足0.1%；纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.6%。尽管本周行情剧烈波动，标普500指数仍仅比上月创下的历史高点低5.1%。该指数成分股及其他与人工智能数据中心建设相关的公司本周重挫，原因包括担心民主党在全国各州议会获胜可能意味着进一步建设放缓，尤其是在得克萨斯州。各政治派别的选民表示，他们对人工智能持谨慎态度，也不喜欢数据中心推高电费。这一因素又叠加了已经令该行业不安的担忧：由于借贷成本大幅上升，人工智能数据中心的进一步建设可能放缓。此前，甚至已有批评者称人工智能股票价格涨得过高，存在泡沫。不过，华盛顿的政治权力仍将由民主党控制的国会和共和党人特朗普掌控的白宫分享，特朗普仍保留否决权。这可能限制联邦政府监管人工智能行业的努力。与此同时，该行业公司仍预计将实现强劲增长。IREN是一家提供人工智能训练所需数据中心、算力和软件的公司，其最新季度业绩好于分析师预期。该公司股价上涨19.5%，并宣布在季度结束后又签署了两份新合同。联席首席执行官丹尼尔·罗伯茨说：“我们拥有土地、电力以及贯穿其中的数据中心，这使我们有更多方式为增长提供资金，也能自行掌控增长速度。”半导体制造设备和服务企业Lam Research宣布一项计划，通过回购自身股票向投资者返还最多250亿美元后，股价上涨9.9%。这也帮助其他受益于人工智能数据中心建设的股票收复了部分大幅跌幅。CoreWeave通过云端向客户提供人工智能芯片使用服务，股价上涨4.5%。销售计算机存储芯片的美光科技上涨5.9%。人工智能板块之外，美国股市涨跌互现，标普500指数成分股中下跌股票略多于上涨股票。Taser制造商Axon Enterprise最新季度业绩不及分析师预期，股价暴跌17.6%。该公司还宣布向无人机技术企业Skydio投资12亿美元。互联网和视频服务提供商Charter Communications最新季度出现亏损，而分析师原本预计其将实现盈利，股价下跌5%。债券市场上，美国国债收益率从本周早些时候的急跌中有所回升；此前股市暴跌，加之市场希望华盛顿的分裂格局能够限制美国政府进一步增加债务，均对收益率走势产生影响。10年期美国国债收益率从周四晚间的4.84%小幅升至4.85%。上月，在通胀、利率上升和政府债务攀升的担忧推动下，该收益率一度突破5.30%。一份报告显示，美国雇主上月招聘的 workers数量远多于经济学家预期，为收益率提供支撑。这是尽管通胀高企，美国经济仍在缓慢运行的最新迹象。一方面，这一令人鼓舞的数据可能意味着美国经济能够承受人工智能数据中心建设放缓；但另一方面，就业的强劲增长可能推高通胀。报告发布后，根据CME Group的数据，交易员认为美联储在12月下一次会议上上调短期利率的可能性更大。美联储加息能够抑制通胀，但方式是提高所有人的借贷成本，并拖累整体经济。与此同时，另一份报告显示，美国消费者信心意外改善。密歇根大学的初步报告称，中低收入和中等财富美国人的信心上升，但股票投资组合规模最大的群体信心下降Perhaps对债券市场而言更重要的是，调查还显示，美国人对未来一年通胀的预期有所缓和。这可能避免形成恶性循环：高通胀预期驱动相关行为，而这些行为只会进一步加剧通胀

Unlock these with Subscription Mysuru has figured in the list of cities adjudged for the Swachh Survekshan-2025-26 awards, with the Mysuru City Corporation (MCC) receiving a formal invitation from the Union Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs to attend the award presentation ceremony scheduled to be held in New Delhi on November 11. The invitation marks Mysuru’s inclusion in the national-level recognition for urban cleanliness and sanitation. The prestigious Swachh Survekshan-2026 awards would be presented by President Droupadi Murmu at Vigyan Bhavan in New Delhi. However, there is no official information yet on the category in which Mysuru has been selected for an award or the rank it has secured. The details will be known only after the rankings and award categories are officially announced. In 2024-25, Mysuru was ranked 3rd cleanest city in India in the 3 to 10 lakh population category under Super Swachh League (SSL), which was a newly introduced category. Mysuru was ranked the cleanest city in India for two consecutive years – 2015 and 2016. MCC Commissioner M.K. Savita and a team of officers are visiting New Delhi for the award function. Minister in-charge of Mysuru district and Urban Development Minister Yathindra Siddaramaiah and senior officials were also expected to attend the function, sources in MCC said. Expressing happiness over the invitation, Ms. Savitha credited Mysuru’s cleanliness initiatives over the years to the collective efforts of former commissioners, health officials, pourakarmikas, and engineers, who, had worked together as a team to address the shortcomings identified in earlier surveys to bring recognition to the city. The MCC Commissioner said that the 11th edition of Swachh Survekshan had commenced and expressed hope that Mysuru would secure a good position in the 2026-27 survey as well. The 10th edition of Swachh Survekshan-2025-26 was conducted under the theme ‘Swachhata Ki Nayi Pehel – Badhayein Haath, Karein Safai Saath’. Mysuru MP Yaduveer Krishnadatta Chamaraja Wadiyar expressed happiness over the MCC being invited to the Swachh Survekshan award function and congratulated pourakarmikas and citizens for their efforts. “Let us all work together to further enhance Mysuru’s reputation on the cleanliness front,” he added. “This is a proud moment for the State. Official announcement of the ranking is awaited. I congratulate the pourakarmikas, MCC officials, staff and citizens of Mysuru ahead of the award presentation,” said the Urban Development Minister, in a statement. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body: Nyesom Wike, Minister of the Federal Capital Territory, FCT, said the people of Rivers State have chosen President Bola Tinubu as their candidate in the January 2027 presidential election. Wike said this on Saturday while welcoming Tinubu and his delegation to the Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium in Port Harcourt for the president’s campaign rally. He is the coordinator of the presidential campaign council in the state. Wike said: “Your Excellency, this is Rivers State’s rally. We did not mobilise anybody from any other state. You can see with your eyes that the people of Rivers State have already concluded and agreed that on January 16, they will vote for you. “Since the inception of democracy in 1999, Rivers people have never had it this way. We have no less than 47 political appointments from Mr President. “So, who is our brother? Our brother is Bola Ahmed Tinubu because he has identified with the people of Rivers state. He described President Tinubu as a political ally of Rivers people, saying the president had demonstrated his commitment to the state through federal projects and political appointments. He questioned the outcome of an alleged fumigation exercise in Rivers, saying it had failed to eliminate mosquitoes. “All we are saying to the vice-presidential candidate is, please, come and give an account of how you fumigated Rivers state. You fumigated Rivers state so that there would be no mosquitoes. He recalled Amaechi’s role as director-general of the presidential campaigns of former President Muhammadu Buhari. Wike said the then APC candidate failed to secure up to 15 percent of the votes in Rivers state in the 2015 and 2019 presidential elections. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/rive.body_zh: 联邦首都 territory 部长 Nyesom Wike 表示，Rivers State 人民已经选择 Bola Tinubu 作为他们在 2027 年 1 月总统选举中的候选人。Wike 周六在 Port Harcourt 的 Adokiye Amiesimaka Stadium 欢迎 Tinubu 及其代表团出席总统竞选集会时说了这番话。他是该州总统竞选委员会协调员。Wike 说：“阁下，这是 Rivers State 的竞选集会。我们没有从其他任何州动员人手。您亲眼就能看到，Rivers State 人民已经作出决定并达成一致，他们将在 1 月 16 日投票支持您。‘自 1999 年民主制度建立以来，Rivers 人民从未像今天这样。我们从总统先生那里获得了不少于 47 项政治任命。‘那么，谁是我们的兄弟？我们的兄弟就是 Bola Ahmed Tinubu，因为他一直与 Rivers State 人民站在一起。’他将 Tinubu 总统形容为 Rivers 人民的政治盟友，称总统通过联邦项目和人事任命展示了对该州的承诺。他质疑了 Rivers 一次据称开展的灭蚊行动的结果，称其未能消灭蚊子。“我们对副总统候选人的全部要求就是，请他来说明自己是如何为 Rivers State 灭蚊的。他为 Rivers State 灭蚊，是为了让这里不再有蚊子。”他回顾了 Amaechi 担任前总统 Muhammadu Buhari 竞选活动总协调员的经历。Wike 说，当时 APC 候选人在 2015 年和 2019 年总统选举中均未能在 Rivers State 获得超过 15% 的选票。此处发表的意见不代表 Vanguard 报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body: Nigeria has recorded about 160 operational Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) refuelling stations across the country, with another 170 facilities at various stages of development and licensing, as the federal government intensifies efforts to expand access to cheaper alternative fuel. The Executive Chairman of the Presidential Compressed Natural Gas Initiative (PCNGI), Ismaeel Ahmed, disclosed this on Friday during the commissioning of a CNG Integrated Refuelling Unit (IRU) station along New Karu Road, Saint George Akume Way, Karu, Abuja. Mr Ahmed said the initiative had attracted approximately $2.6 billion in private-sector investments in less than two years, describing the growing investor interest as evidence that the market had moved beyond the proof-of-concept stage. “This is almost our 106th station across the country in less than two years. This is not beginning any longer. The market has been proven, and investors are trooping in,” he said. He said the additional stations were undergoing development or awaiting various approvals and licences from the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority ( NMDPRA ). According to him, President Bola Tinubu has also directed another round of infrastructure deployment, including 1,500 units in February and an additional 500 in August, which are expected to come on stream between this year and early next year. Mr Ahmed said the expansion was necessary to accelerate the adoption of CNG in a country with more than 220 million people and approximately 12 million vehicles. He argued that Nigeria needed to move faster in developing alternative fuel infrastructure to meet the country’s transportation and energy demands. “It took Nigeria about 60 years to build approximately 24,000 conventional petrol stations, most of which are privately owned. We are seeing a much faster adoption of CNG and electric vehicles, and the scale of interest is encouraging,” he said. The PCNGI chairman argued that the adoption of CNG-powered vehicles had reduced transportation fares by between 30 and 40 per cent on some routes where the buses were already operating. He cited Abuja, Lagos and Kano, as well as inter-state routes between Kano and Katsina, as locations where passengers were benefiting from lower transportation costs. According to him, passengers who previously paid between N3,000 and N4,000 on some routes now pay about N1,500 when travelling in CNG-powered buses. He said the initiative was designed to extend the benefits to all local government areas, particularly those with high concentrations of commercial vehicles and passenger traffic. However, acknowledging that the existing fleet remained insufficient to meet demand, Mr Ahmed said the government was working to deploy more buses and expand access to the alternative fuel. Asked how the government arrived at the reported 30–40 per cent reduction in transportation fares, he said the figures were based on comparisons between fares charged by operators before and after the introduction of CNG-powered buses on selected routes. He explained that the initiative obtained information from transport operators about previous fares and compared them with the fares charged after the adoption of CNG. Also speaking at the commissioning ceremony , the Permanent Secretary, State House, Temitope Fashedemi, said the facility demonstrated the federal government’s commitment to promoting CNG as a cheaper alternative to petrol following the removal of the petrol subsidy. Mr Fashedemi said President Tinubu’s administration had introduced CNG as part of efforts to cushion the impact of subsidy removal on Nigerians, particularly in the transportation and energy sectors. He said Nigeria’s abundant natural gas resources, which had historically been underutilised and flared, presented an opportunity to provide cheaper energy alternatives for households and businesses. According to him, the State House decided to demonstrate the viability of the initiative by rehabilitating an abandoned fuel depot within its premises and converting it into a CNG refuelling facility. He explained that the government partnered with the PCNGI and selected Rolling Energy Limited as the private-sector operator to rehabilitate and upgrade the facility. Mr Fashedemi said the State House provided the existing infrastructure and location, while the private-sector partner financed the rehabilitation and upgrading of the facility. “The State House did not spend public funds on the facility. We provided the infrastructure and made the location available, while the private-sector partner invested in rehabilitating and upgrading it,” he said. He added that the facility also housed a vehicle conversion centre where motorists could convert eligible vehicles to run on CNG. The permanent secretary disclosed that the State House had acquired some hybrid vehicles, while some buses operating within the Villa premises also run on alternative energy. He said some State House employees would also bring their vehicles for conversion in the coming weeks, subject to technical assessments to determine their suitability. Mr Fashedemi said the initiative was intended to demonstrate that the government was willing to lead by example rather than merely advocate the adoption of alternative fuels. He urged private investors to take advantage of the opportunities in the CNG market, noting that government support through infrastructure partnerships could accelerate the expansion of refuelling facilities. Meanwhile, the Chief Executive Officer of Rolling Energy Limited, Mubarak Danbatta, described the project as an example of the benefits of collaboration between government and private investors. Mr Danbatta commended the State House for making the abandoned facility available for redevelopment, saying the partnership demonstrated how the government could facilitate private investment by providing access to existing infrastructure. “What you are seeing here is the power of partnership. When private entities and governments come together, this is the result,” he said. He explained that the facility, known as an Integrated Refuelling Unit, combined the dispenser and compressor in a single system, with double-nozzle dispensers that allow vehicles to refuel from both sides. According to him, the station has the capacity to serve approximately 150 vehicles daily, depending on cylinder size and pressure. Its vehicle conversion centre is also projected to convert about 12 vehicles daily. The growing investment in CNG infrastructure comes as Nigeria seeks to diversify its energy mix and reduce dependence on petrol, particularly following the removal of fuel subsidies in May 2023. The Tinubu-led administration has repeatedly argued that the adoption of the CNG technology is part of the broader effort to reduce high cost of living pressures on Nigerians due to some of the ongoing reforms initiated by the government
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.title_zh: 尼日利亚已有160座运营中的压缩天然气站，私人投资达到26亿美元
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/business/.body_zh: 尼日利亚全国目前约有160座投入运营的压缩天然气（CNG）加气站，另有170座设施处于开发或牌照审批的不同阶段。联邦政府正加大努力，扩大民众获得这种更廉价替代燃料的渠道。总统压缩天然气倡议（PCNGI）执行主席Ismaeel Ahmed于周五在阿布贾卡鲁区Saint George Akume Way新卡鲁路沿线一座压缩天然气综合加气单元（IRU）加气站投入使用时透露了上述数据。Ahmed先生表示，不到两年时间，该倡议便吸引了约26亿美元的私人部门投资，并将投资者兴趣日益增长形容为市场已超越概念验证阶段的证据。他说：“这几乎是我们不到两年在全国建成的第106座加气站。这已经不再只是开端。市场已经得到验证，投资者正在纷至沓来。”他说，其他加气站正在开发之中，或等待尼日利亚中游及下游石油监管局（NMDPRA）的各项审批和许可。据他介绍，总统Bola Tinubu还指示开展新一轮基础设施建设，包括2月部署1,500个加气单元，8月再增加500个，预计这些设施将在今年至明年初陆续投入运营。Ahmed先生表示，在一个拥有超过2.2亿人口和约1,200万辆汽车的国家，扩大压缩天然气基础设施对于加快其普及至关重要。他认为，尼日利亚需要加快发展替代燃料基础设施，以满足国内交通和能源需求。他说：“尼日利亚花了约60年才建成约24,000座传统加油站，其中大多数为私营。我们如今看到压缩天然气和电动汽车的普及速度要快得多，关注度之广令人鼓舞。”PCNGI主席表示，在已经运营压缩天然气公交车的部分线路上，使用压缩天然气为燃料的车辆使交通票价降低了30%至40%。他列举了阿布贾、拉各斯和卡诺，以及卡诺与卡茨纳之间的州际线路，称这些地方的乘客正受益于较低的出行成本。据他介绍，此前乘客在部分线路需支付3,000至4,000奈拉，如今乘坐压缩天然气公交车只需支付约1,500奈拉。他说，该倡议旨在将相关惠益拓展至所有地方政府辖区，尤其是商用车辆和客流量高度集中的地区。不过，Ahmed先生承认现有车队仍不足以满足需求，政府正着手部署更多公交车并扩大替代燃料的可及性。当被问及政府如何得出交通票价降低30%至40%的数据时，他表示，这些数字来自对运营商在部分线路引入压缩天然气公交车前后所收取票价的比较。他解释说，该倡议向运输运营商收集以往票价信息，并将其与采用压缩天然气后收取的票价进行比较。州府常务秘书Temitope Fashedemi也出席启用仪式并表示，在取消汽油补贴后，这座设施体现了联邦政府推动压缩天然气作为汽油廉价替代燃料的承诺。Fashedemi先生说，Tinubu总统政府将压缩天然气纳入相关措施，旨在缓冲取消补贴对尼日利亚民众造成的影响，尤其是在交通和能源领域。他说，尼日利亚丰富的天然气资源过去长期未得到充分利用，部分天然气还被火炬燃烧，这为家庭和企业提供更廉价的能源替代方案创造了机会。据他介绍，州府决定通过修复其院区内一座废弃油库并将其改造为压缩天然气加气设施来展示该倡议的可行性。他解释说，政府与PCNGI合作，并选择Rolling Energy Limited担任私营部门运营商，负责修复和升级该设施。Fashedemi先生说，州府提供现有基础设施和场地，而私营部门合作伙伴出资完成设施修复与升级。他说：“州府没有为这座设施动用公共资金。我们提供了基础设施并提供了场地，而私营部门合作伙伴投资修复和升级了它。”他还补充称，该设施内还设有一座车辆改装中心，驾车者可在那里将符合条件的车辆改装为使用压缩天然气。常务秘书透露，州府已购入一些混合动力汽车，府邸内运营的部分公交车也使用替代能源。他说，未来数周，一些州府雇员也将把车辆送来改装，但须经过技术评估，以确定车辆是否适用。Fashedemi先生说，该倡议旨在表明政府愿意以身作则，而不是仅仅倡议使用替代燃料。他敦促私人投资者把握压缩天然气市场中的机遇，并指出，政府通过基础设施合作给予的支持能够加快加气设施的扩建。与此同时，Rolling Energy Limited首席执行官Mubarak Danbatta称，该项目是政府与私人投资者协作所带来惠益的实例。Danbatta先生赞扬州府提供废弃设施用于重新开发，并表示双方的合作证明，政府可以通过提供现有基础设施的使用机会来促进私人投资。他说：“你们在这里看到的是合作的力量。当私人实体与政府携手合作时，就会产生这样的成果。”他解释说，这座被称为综合加气单元的设施将加气机和压缩机整合在同一套系统中，采用双枪嘴加气机，车辆可从两侧同时加气。据他介绍，这座加气站每天可为约150辆汽车提供服务，具体取决于气瓶容量和压力。其车辆改装中心预计每天也可改装约12辆汽车。随着压缩天然气基础设施投资不断增长，尼日利亚正寻求实现能源结构多元化并降低对汽油的依赖，尤其是在2023年5月取消燃油补贴之后。Tinubu领导的政府多次表示，采用压缩天然气技术是政府推进一系列改革、减轻尼日利亚民众生活成本压力的整体努力的一部分

https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.title: Despite Stiff Challenge, South East Still Pull Behind Peter Obi
https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.summary: Findings by LEADERSHIP Weekend across Enugu, Imo, Abia and Anambra states indicate that Peter Obi continues to enjoy considerable political influence in the South-East, particularly among young people, traders and residents dissatisfied with the country’s economic situation. During the meeting, Obi criticised the administration of President Bola Tinubu, arguing that the South-East had not received adequate attention from the Federal Government.
https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.summary_zh: 《LEADERSHIP》周末在埃努古、伊莫、阿比亚和安帕拉各州开展的调查显示，彼得·奥比在东南部仍享有相当大的政治影响力，尤其是在年轻人、商贩以及对该国经济状况感到不满的居民中间。会上，奥比批评了总统博拉·蒂努布政府，认为联邦政府未能给予东南部充分关注。
https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.body: Findings by LEADERSHIP Weekend across Enugu, Imo, Abia and Anambra states indicate that Peter Obi continues to enjoy considerable political influence in the South-East, particularly among young people, traders and residents dissatisfied with the country’s economic situation. However, while his supporters are optimistic that he could secure overwhelming votes across the region, some political stakeholders have cautioned that popularity alone may not translate into electoral victory, especially in the face of competing political interests, party structures and concerns about the credibility of the electoral process. In Enugu, investigations by our correspondent revealed that Obi’s influence remains considerably strong, with many residents expressing confidence in his chances of defeating other presidential contenders in the state. Interviews conducted in different parts of the state showed that several residents had already indicated their intention to vote for him in the January 2027 presidential election. His level of acceptability, it was gathered, has remained high since the 2023 general election, with his name becoming familiar across different communities and social groups in the state. A former governorship candidate in Enugu State, Prince Uche Agbo, told LEADERSHIP Weekend that Obi enjoys widespread acceptance and could defeat other presidential candidates by a wide margin. “I don’t want to mention names, but all I know is that Obi is too popular in Enugu State and pulls surprises as usual. He has a better chance of winning than other candidates,” he said. Similarly, a political scientist, Mr Ignatius Mbaeri, rated Obi’s political influence highly, arguing that his growing popularity gives him an advantage over other presidential contenders. “My brother, honestly, the fear of Obi appears to be everywhere. He pulls crowds each time he comes to Enugu, and so he has a better chance of defeating other presidential candidates,” he said. In Imo State, Obi’s political appeal has also been described as phenomenal, with supporters expressing confidence in his capacity to address the country’s economic challenges. Since his emergence as a major presidential contender in 2023, his followership in the state has reportedly continued to grow, driven largely by his promises of economic recovery, prudent management of public resources and investment in critical sectors. A political analyst, Uche Onwuchekwe, told LEADERSHIP Weekend that Nigeria needed a technocrat with the capacity to translate policy ideas into practical solutions. He identified insecurity, healthcare and infrastructure as some of the critical areas requiring urgent attention. “We have overgrown this stage of trial and error. What we need now is a man with the capability to translate words into action,” he said. Onwuchekwe argued that the prevailing economic difficulties had made Nigerians more conscious of the need to elect a president capable of transforming the country. He also suggested that some residents who support Obi might be reluctant to openly declare their political preferences for fear of victimisation. Obi’s recent visit to Imo State further demonstrated the enthusiasm among his supporters. The presidential candidate, who arrived in Owerri from Yenagoa, Bayelsa State, as part of his nationwide town hall series, visited a popular market where he interacted with traders, some of whom presented him with gifts. His subsequent town hall meeting, attended by town union leaders from the 27 local government areas, market women, students, NDC candidates and Obidient Movement organisers, attracted considerable enthusiasm. During the meeting, Obi criticised the administration of President Bola Tinubu, arguing that the South-East had not received adequate attention from the Federal Government. He also raised concerns about insecurity, poverty and the state of the economy, while promising that an NDC administration would prioritise national unity, security, healthcare, education and poverty reduction. Participants also raised concerns about the protection of their votes in 2027, to which Obi assured them that his party would work to ensure that votes counted. However, not all political stakeholders in Imo State believe his growing popularity constitutes a threat to their political interests. The Publicity Secretary of the All Progressives Congress (APC) in the state, Onwuasanya FCC Jones, dismissed suggestions that Obi posed a threat to the party, saying it had already mapped out strategies to win the election. He maintained that Imo voters would support APC candidates, including President Bola Tinubu. Similarly, an NDC stakeholder, Hon. Udubueze Uwaezuoke, said the party was determined to win the presidential election and consolidate its presence across the South-East. Meanwhile, an APGA executive, Dr George Nworji, said his party had adopted President Tinubu as its presidential candidate and would work towards delivering him in the region through grassroots mobilisation. In Abia State, findings indicate that Obi’s political influence remains strong despite his yet-to-be-reported campaign visit to the state since the flag-off of his presidential campaign activities. According to our correspondent, his supporters appear eager to receive him, with his popularity being driven largely by youths and residents dissatisfied with the prevailing economic situation. Reliable findings indicated that even some members of other political parties in the state had made up their minds to vote for Obi for president while supporting their respective parties’ candidates for other elective positions. The support, it was gathered, is influenced by ethnic considerations, political expectations, economic concerns, his persistent criticism of the Tinubu administration and his perceived commitment to transparency and prudent management of public funds. In Anambra State, however, reactions to the chances of Obi and his running mate, former Kano State Governor, Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso, have been mixed, although many respondents expressed confidence in the ticket. With about 72 days to the January 16, 2027 general election, political party leaders, analysts, business operators and ordinary voters who spoke to LEADERSHIP Weekend agreed that the performance of the APC-led Federal Government could work against President Tinubu’s re-election. They, however, expressed concerns that electoral manipulation, vote-buying and the influence of political structures could affect the outcome. The Senator representing Anambra Central Senatorial District, Senator Victor Umeh, expressed confidence that Obi and Kwankwaso would secure overwhelming support, predicting that the ticket could win more than 70 per cent of the votes nationwide. Similarly, the NDC Chairman in Anambra State, Hon. Ikem Uzoezie, and the State Coordinator of the party’s Presidential Campaign Council, Hon. Ifeanyi Ibezi, expressed optimism that Obi would record between 70 and 95 per cent of the votes in the state. Uzoezie recalled that Obi polled more than 500,000 votes in Anambra during the 2023 presidential election as the Labour Party candidate, expressing confidence that he could secure at least 1.5 million votes in the state in 2027. Umeh argued that Obi had demonstrated his political strength in 2023 despite lacking the political structures enjoyed by established political parties. He also said the NDC was making arrangements to protect its votes, including plans to deploy three party agents to each polling unit nationwide. A lawyer and public affairs analyst, Mr Maxwell Ezeude, also expressed optimism about Obi’s chances, citing his alliance with Kwankwaso and the prevailing economic hardship. He argued that the alliance had strengthened Obi’s political prospects by giving him access to a wider political constituency, particularly in the North. However, Ezeude warned that the influence of money in Nigerian politics, the alignment of state governors with the ruling party and possible electoral manipulation could constitute major obstacles. A community leader, Mr Tony Okafor, predicted that Obi could win overwhelmingly in the South-East and secure significant support nationally if the election was free and fair. He said many Nigerians were looking for a leader who could reduce the cost of governance and redirect public resources towards improving their welfare. The factional Chairman of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Anambra State, Comrade Patrick Obianyo, said winning the 2027 presidential election would be difficult for Obi because his political strength was now better understood by his opponents. He argued that vote-buying, financial inducements and the influence of state governors could affect the outcome. Similarly, a media consultant, Mr Titus Eleweke, acknowledged that Obi could secure considerable votes in the South-East but expressed doubts about his ability to replicate the same level of support in the North. Other respondents, however, maintained that the prevailing economic hardship could influence voters to reject the ruling party. A real estate operator, Mr Ekene Thomas, expressed confidence that young people would resist attempts to manipulate the election, while a bar attendant, Miss Uchechukwu Chukwubuike, said she would vote for Obi because of the economic difficulties confronting Nigerians. Across the four states, the findings suggest that Obi continues to enjoy considerable goodwill, with his political appeal extending beyond party membership and attracting residents who believe that the country needs a change in leadership. Nevertheless, the extent to which this enthusiasm will translate into actual votes remains a major question. While his popularity appears particularly strong in Anambra, his home state, and extends to Enugu, Imo and Abia, the positions of APGA, APC and other political stakeholders demonstrate that the South-East is not without competing political interests. The January 16, 2027 presidential election will therefore provide a clearer test of whether Obi can convert his grassroots appeal, political alliances and growing support base into electoral support across the South-East. For now, the findings point to sustained political enthusiasm around Obi in the four states covered by this investigation, although the absence of findings from Ebonyi means the assessment does not yet represent the entire South-East region. https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.title_zh: 尽管面临严峻挑战，东南部地区仍落后于Peter Obi
https://leadership.ng/despite-stiff-chal.body_zh:
LEADERSHIP Weekend在埃努古、伊莫、阿比亚和安ambara州开展的调查显示，Peter Obi在尼日利亚东南部 continues to enjoy considerable political influence，特别是在年轻人、贸易商以及不满该国经济状况的居民中。然而，尽管其支持者乐观认为他可能在整个地区获得压倒性选票，一些政治利益相关者警告说，人气本身未必能转化为选举胜利，尤其是在 competing political interests、党务组织结构以及对选举进程可信度存在担忧的情况下。

在埃努古州，本报驻记者调查显示，Obi的影响力依然相当强劲，许多居民相信他有望击败该州其他总统竞选人。在该州不同地区进行的采访显示，数名居民已表示打算在2027年1月总统选举中投票给他。采访汇总情况显示，自2023年大选以来，他的支持率一直保持高位，他的名字已为该州不同社区和社会群体所熟知。埃努古州前州长候选人Prince Uche Agbo告诉LEADERSHIP Weekend，Obi在埃努古州广受欢迎，能够以较大优势击败其他总统候选人。他说：“我不想点名，但我知道Obi在埃努古州太受欢迎了，而且他一如既往地总能带来惊喜。他获胜的机会比其他候选人都大。”

同样，政治学学者Ignatius Mbaeri先生高度评价Obi的政治影响力，认为他日益增长的人气使他相较其他总统竞选人占据优势。他说：“兄弟，坦白说，对Obi的恐惧似乎无处不在。他每次来到埃努古都能吸引大批人群，因此他击败其他总统候选人的机会更大。”

在伊莫州，Obi的政治吸引力也被形容为非同寻常，支持者相信他有能力应对该国面临的经济挑战。自2023年成为主要总统竞选人以来，据报道他在该州的追随者持续增加，这主要得益于他关于经济复苏、公共资源审慎管理和投资关键领域的承诺。政治分析师Uche Onwuchekwe告诉LEADERSHIP Weekend，尼日利亚需要一位能够将政策理念转化为切实解决方案的技术型领导人。他指出，安全局势、医疗保健和基础设施是一些亟须关注的关键领域。他说：“我们已经过度依赖这个试错阶段。现在我们需要的是一个能够把言语转化为行动的人。”Onwuchekwe认为，当前的经济困境已使尼日利亚人更加清醒地认识到，需要选出一位有能力改变国家面貌的总统。他还暗示，一些支持Obi的居民可能因为害怕遭到迫害，而不愿公开表明政治立场。

Obi最近访问伊莫州进一步显示其支持者的热情。这位总统竞选人从巴耶尔萨州叶纳戈阿抵达奥韦里，作为全国市政厅系列活动的一部分，他走访了一座热门市场并与贸易商交流，其中一些人还向他赠送了礼物。随后举行的市政厅会议有27个地方政府区域的城镇协会领袖、市场妇女、学生、NDC候选人和Obidient Movement组织者参加，现场气氛热烈。会议期间，Obi批评总统Bola Tinubu政府，认为联邦政府没有给予东南部足够关注。他还提出了对安全、贫困和经济状况的担忧，同时承诺NDC执政后将优先关注国家团结、安全、医疗保健、教育和减贫。与会者还提出关切，要求保障他们在2027年的选票得到保护，Obi向他们保证，他的党将努力确保选票得到计入。

然而，伊莫州并非所有政治利益相关者都认为他日益增长的人气对自己的政治利益构成威胁。全进步大会党（APC）州宣传秘书Onwuasanya FCC Jones否定了Obi对该党构成威胁的说法，称该党已经制定winning strategies to win the election。他坚持认为，伊莫州选民将支持APC候选人，包括总统Bola Tinubu。同样，NDC利益相关者Udubueze Uwaezuoke阁下表示，该党决心赢得总统选举，并巩固其在东南部的存在。与此同时，APGA执行委员George Nworji博士说，该党已采纳总统Tinubu作为总统候选人，并将通过基层动员在该地区推动他胜选。

在阿比亚州，调查显示，尽管Obi的总统竞选活动启动以来尚未访问该州，但他的政治影响力依然强劲。据本报驻记者称，他的支持者似乎热切期待他的到来，而他的人气主要由年轻人和不满当前经济状况的居民推动。可靠调查显示，该州甚至一些其他政党的成员也已决定在其他公职选举中支持本党候选人的同时，投票支持Obi竞选总统。据汇总情况，这种支持受到族群因素、政治期待、经济担忧、他对Tinubu政府持续不断的批评，以及外界认为他致力于透明和公共资金审慎管理等因素的影响。

然而，在安ambara州，对于Obi及其竞选搭档、前卡诺州州长Alhaji Rabiu Kwankwaso胜选前景的反应不一，尽管许多受访者对二人的组合表示有信心。距离2027年1月16日大选约72天，接受LEADERSHIP Weekend采访的各政党领袖、分析人士、商业经营者和普通选民一致认为，APC主导的联邦政府的表现可能对总统Tinubu连任不利。不过，他们也担忧选举操弄、买票和政党组织结构的影响可能左右结果。

代表安amb拉中部选区的参议员Victor Umeh参议员对Obi和Kwankwaso能否获得压倒性支持表示有信心，预测这套候选人组合可能在全国赢得超过70%的选票。同样，安ambara州NDC主席Ikem Uzoezie阁下及该党总统竞选委员会州协调员Ifeanyi Ibezi阁下乐观表示，Obi将在该州获得70%至95%的选票。Uzoezie回忆称，Obi在2023年总统选举中以工党候选人身份参选，在安amb拉获得了超过500,000票，并相信他2027年能在该州赢得至少150万票。Umeh认为，尽管缺乏成熟政党所具备的政党组织结构，Obi在2023年已经证明了其政治实力。他还说，NDC正在制定保护本党选票的措施，包括计划在全国每个投票站部署3名政党监票员。

律师兼公共事务分析师Maxwell Ezeude先生也对Obi的胜选前景表示乐观，并提到他与Kwankwaso结盟以及当前的经济困境。他认为，这一联盟让Obi得以接触更广泛的政治群体，尤其是在北部地区，从而增强了他的政治胜算。然而，Ezeude警告称，金钱在尼日利亚政治中的影响、州长与执政党的结盟以及潜在的选举操弄，都可能构成重大障碍。社区领袖Tony Okafor先生预测，如果选举自由、公平，Obi可以在东南部以压倒性优势获胜，并在全国获得大量支持。他说，许多尼日利亚人正在寻找一位能够降低治理成本、把公共资源转用于改善民生福祉的领导人。安ambara州非洲民主大会（ADC）派系主席Patrick Obianyo同志说，Obi赢得2027年总统选举并不容易，因为其政治实力如今已得到对手更充分的了解。他认为，买票、经济诱因和州长的影响都可能左右结果。同样，媒体顾问Titus Eleweke先生承认Obi可以在东南部获得相当多的选票，但怀疑他能否在北部复制同等水平的支持。

不过，其他受访者坚持认为，当前经济困境可能促使选民拒绝执政党。房地产经营者Ekene Thomas先生相信年轻人会抵制操纵选举的企图；酒吧服务员Uchechukwu Chukwubuike小姐则表示，由于尼日利亚人正面临经济困难，她将投票给Obi。

在这四个州的调查结果表明，Obi continues to enjoy considerable goodwill，其政治吸引力超出了党派成员范围，吸引了认为国家需要领导层变革的居民。然而，这份热情最终能在多大程度上转化为实际选票，仍是一个重大问题。尽管他的人气似乎在其家乡安ambara州尤为强劲，并延伸至埃努古、伊莫和阿比亚，但APGA、APC及其他政治利益相关者的立场表明，东南部并非不存在相互竞争的政治利益。因此，2027年1月16日总统选举将更清楚地检验Obi能否将其基层号召力、政治联盟和不断扩大的支持基础转化为整个东南部的选举支持。目前，调查结果显示，在本次调查覆盖的四个州，围绕Obi的政治热情持续不减；不过，由于没有获得埃博尼州的调查结果，这项评估尚不能代表整个东南部地区。

https://leadership.ng/abba-aji-clarifies.body: The retired Justice said the travel ban to the United States was still subsisting against the justices. Justice Abba Aji who spoke on the occasion of a valedictory Supreme Court session held in her honour, however, noted that the ban was part of inconveniences and a small price to pay by judicial officers to preserve the chastity of justice. Abba Aji is to formally bow out of the Supreme Court on November 7 upon attainment of the mandatory retirement age of 70 years. Recalling her experience while on the bench, she said, “My time on the Supreme Court bench was filled with challenges, some of which have served as additional opportunities to stand firm on the side of justice, regardless of the consequences. Although, Justice Abba Aji did not disclose the judgment that attracted the US travel ban on her panel members, she however said, “Such inconveniences were a price to pay to preserve the chastity of justice”. Justice Abba Aji also recalled the year 2016 while on a programme at Washington DC in the USA, she received a call that her attention was needed by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) over a petition against her in Lagos. She explained that the petition made her a regular visitor at the EFCC office answering questions on allegations of corruption she knew nothing about adding that, at the end of the investigations, she was exonerated from all the allegations. Despite the exoneration, she said the situation was chaotic and made a very difficult time for her as slanders had filled the air, adding that to worsen the situation, she could not speak in her own defense in public because of the conservative nature of the judiciary. The retiring apex court justice, charged younger generation of judges to hold fast to integrity and let justice be their compass. She counseled serving judges to serve with humility and courage and to always remember that the law is not merely a profession but a trust. Earlier, the Chief Justice of Nigeria CJN, Justice Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, who presided over the special court session congratulated Justice Abba Aji for diligent service to the country’s judiciary and for leaving the Supreme Court bench with unblemished record of service. The CJN said the career of Justice Abba Aji in the judiciary and the legal profession was so important to the nation and women who had followed her example on the bench. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/abba-aji-clarifies.body_zh: 已退休的大法官表示，针对法官的美国旅行禁令仍然有效。在为表彰她而举行的最高法院告别会议上发言的Abba Aji大法官指出，这项禁令虽会带来不便，却只是司法人员为维护司法廉洁所付出的微小代价。Abba Aji大法官将在达到70岁的强制退休年龄后，于11月7日正式退出最高法院。回顾自己担任法官期间的经历，她说：“我在最高法院任职期间充满了挑战，其中一些挑战也给我提供了额外机会，让我无论面对何种后果都能坚定不移地站在正义一边。”尽管Abba Aji大法官没有透露导致她及合议庭其他成员受到美国旅行禁令的具体判决，但她表示：“这种不便是为维护司法廉洁而必须付出的代价。”Abba Aji大法官还回忆说，2016年，她在美国华盛顿特区参加一个项目期间，接到经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）的电话，要求她到拉各斯就针对她的申诉接受问询。她解释说，这项申诉使她经常前往经济和金融犯罪委员会办公室，回答有关她毫不知情的腐败指控；调查结束后，她洗清了所有指控。尽管最终洗清嫌疑，她表示当时的局面十分混乱，令她的日子非常艰难，因为诽谤之声四处弥漫；更糟的是，由于司法界作风保守，她无法在公开场合为自己辩护。这位即将退休的最高法院大法官告诫年轻一代法官，要坚守正直，以正义作为行动指南。她劝勉在职法官以谦逊和勇气履职，并始终牢记，法律不仅是一门职业，更是一项责任。此前，主持特别法院会议的尼日利亚首席大法官（CJN）Kudirat Kekere-Ekun大法官祝贺Abba Aji大法官为该国司法界勤勉履职，并Cleanly完成了最高法院法官任期。CJN表示，Abba Aji大法官在司法界和法律界的职业生涯，对国家以及所有以她为榜样进入法官行列的女性而言都具有重大意义。我们掌握独家优势。获取实时报道、突发新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp频道，全天候获取最新消息 → 加入我们的WhatsApp频道 --> --> Olakunle Olasanmi Olakunle Olasanmi是《LEADERSHIP Newspaper》的记者，拥有20多年经验，专长于司法报道。在其职业生涯中，他在报道尼日利亚及其他地区的司法体系和冲突解决方面表现卓越。通过准确、生动和独家的报道，他已成为法律事务领域值得信赖的权威。

https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.snippet:
A Direct Challenge to the APC and President Bola Tinubu on Nigeria’s $145 Billion Debt Profile (as at June 2026 from the DMO). 

Where is the Return on Investment?

According to the World Bank Group's International Debt Report 2026 released on November 6, 2026, Nigeria’s total external debt has surged to $145.02 billion. Within this astronomical portfolio, the ruling APC administration maintains a staggering $5.67 billion in bilateral debt owed to China, cementing Beijing as our largest government-to-government creditor.

As these liabilities compound, the administration continues to aggressively pursue more loans, including the latest $7.7 billion external borrowing request presented to the National Assembly to finance the budget deficit.

Debt in itself can be a tool for development, but only when it is strictly channelled into transparent, high-impact capital investments that generate economic returns. When debt rises without visible equivalents in infrastructure, it transitions from fiscal management to generational liquidation.

Therefore, the patriotic citizens of this country are asking a fundamental question: What has the APC-led administration achieved in tangible capital projects and critical investments with these billions of dollars?

To bring clarity to this national conversation and shift the focus from political rhetoric to verifiable governance, we hereby challenge the supporters of President Tinubu and the APC to step forward and name five (5) major capital projects or capital investments that have been fully initiated, completed, and officially commissioned under the presidency of Bola Ahmed Tinubu.

We do not want to hear about ongoing projects inherited from previous administrations, nor are we interested in policy declarations, macroeconomic promises, or legislative approvals. We demand an account of concrete, commissioned infrastructure that justifies the heavy debt burden being placed upon the shoulders of the Nigerian people.

True leadership is measured by the legacies it builds, not the liabilities it accumulates. Nigeria must survive, and that survival depends entirely on demanding absolute accountability from those entrusted with our national treasury.

https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.title_zh: 对全 progressives 党及博拉·蒂努布总统关于尼日利亚1450亿美元债务规模的一次直接质疑（截至2026年6月，数据来自债务管理办公室）。
https://x.com/morris_monye/status/211974.snippet_zh:
就尼日利亚1450亿美元债务规模直接质问全进步大会党（APC）和总统博拉·蒂努布（截至2026年6月，据债务管理办公室数据）

投资回报在哪里？

根据世界银行集团于2026年11月6日发布的《2026年国际债务报告》，尼日利亚外债总额已飙升至1450.2亿美元。在这份规模惊人的债务组合中，执政的APC政府仍背负着56.7亿美元欠中国的双边债务，使北京成为我国最大的政府间债权国。

在这些债务不断累积的同时，政府仍积极寻求更多贷款，包括 recently 向国民议会提交的77亿美元外部借款申请，用于填补预算赤字。

债务本身可以成为推动发展的工具，但前提是资金必须严格用于透明、影响重大的资本投资，并能创造经济回报。如果债务增加却看不到相应的基础设施成果，债务管理就会转变为对子孙后代的清算。

因此，这个国家富有爱国心的公民提出了一个根本问题：APC领导的政府利用这数十亿美元，在有形资本项目和关键投资方面取得了哪些成果？

为厘清这场全国性讨论，把焦点从政治口号转向可核实的治理表现，我们在此向总统蒂努布和APC的支持者提出挑战：站出来列出在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统任内已经全面启动、完成并正式投用的五个重大资本项目或资本投资。

我们不想听从前几届政府遗留的在建项目，也不关心政策声明、宏观经济承诺或议会批准。我们要求说明已经正式投用的具体基础设施，因为正是这些项目使尼日利亚人民背负了沉重的债务负担。

真正的领导力，要看它留下了什么遗产，而不是它累积了多少负债。尼日利亚必须生存下去，而要生存下去，就完全取决于我们是否要求那些受托掌管国家财政的人绝对负责任。

https://x.com/kwankwasiyya_ax/status/211.snippet:
PRESS STATEMENT

APC'S ENDLESS LIES AND DECEIT
HOW MANY TIMES WILL APC APPROVE IBOM DEEP SEA PORT?

President Tinubu, while campaigning in Uyo, has promised and granted approval for the construction of the Ibom Deep Sea Port.

What a hocus-pocus, what hogwash, and what barefaced lies and shenanigans of a rudderless party! How many times will the APC approve the Ibom Deep Sea Port?

President Buhari approved it in December 2020. The Federal Executive Council gave approval for the implementation of the first phase of the $4.6 billion Ibom Deep Sea Port (IDSP) during its meeting on December 16, 2020.

That approval named Bollore/Power China as the preferred bidder and was meant to allow construction to commence.

In a brazen display of ignorance of statecraft and the elevation of grand deceit as a campaign strategy, President Tinubu, as APC presidential candidate, first promised the port during his 2023 campaign.

At the APC campaign rally at the Godswill Akpabio International Stadium in Uyo on 30 January 2023, he told supporters: "We will do mechanised farming. We will export food from Akwa Ibom. We will build your seaport."

Unfortunately, as is characteristic of the APC, they never fulfilled the promise. Over three years down the line, President Tinubu on Friday, 6 November 2026, had to promise again to construct the long-awaited Ibom Deep Sea Port project in Akwa Ibom State.

Obviously, this is another round of cheap promises that will not be kept or honoured. Just as before, so it will be now — empty promises. All talk and no action.

APC'S ENDLESS LIES AND DECEIT
HOW MANY TIMES WILL APC APPROVE IBOM DEEP SEA PORT?

President Tinubu, while campaigning in Uyo, has promised and granted approval for the construction of the Ibom Deep Sea Port.

What a hocus-pocus, what hogwash, and what barefaced lies and shenanigans of a rudderless party! How many times will the APC approve the Ibom Deep Sea Port?

President Buhari approved it in December 2020. The Federal Executive Council gave approval for the implementation of the first phase of the $4.6 billion Ibom Deep Sea Port (IDSP) during its meeting on December 16, 2020.

That approval named Bollore/Power China as the preferred bidder and was meant to allow construction to commence.

In a brazen display of ignorance of statecraft and the elevation of grand deceit as a campaign strategy, President Tinubu, as APC presidential candidate, first promised the port during his 2023 campaign.

At the APC campaign rally at the Godswill Akpabio International Stadium in Uyo on 30 January 2023, he told supporters: "We will do mechanised farming. We will export food from Akwa Ibom. We will build your seaport."

Unfortunately, as is characteristic of the APC, they never fulfilled the promise. Over three years down the line, President Tinubu on Friday, 6 November 2026, had to promise again to construct the long-awaited Ibom Deep Sea Port project in Akwa Ibom State.

尼日利亚民众仍在等待全党一致性（APC）和蒂努布总统为我们提供不间断的电力供应，阿夸伊博姆居民也仍在无休止地等待那个已成为欺骗性竞选工具的深海港承诺。

尼日利亚人必须擦亮双眼，将全党一致性（APC）丢进社会政治无足轻重的深渊，并让一个新的尼日利亚成为可能。

https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.snippet:
On the third day of our visit to Nanning, I was honoured to be hosted by the Vice Mayor of Nanning City, Mr. Hou Jin, following our successful high-level engagement with His Excellency Wei Tao, Governor of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region.

Our engagement focused on initiating discussions towards establishing a Sister City Partnership between cities in Ghana and Nanning, with practical areas of collaboration in:

1. Urban planning and city development.
2. Development control and effective land-use management.
3. Urban transportation and mobility.
4. Education and institutional partnerships.
5. Healthcare delivery and medical cooperation.
6. Modern, AI-driven strategies for revenue mobilisation and efficient local governance.

We are particularly encouraged by the invitation extended to students from our respective cities to pursue academic programmes in our universities. We also explored opportunities for bilateral scholarship arrangements, university partnerships and academic exchanges.

We acknowledged the strong diplomatic and economic relations between Ghana and China, under the leadership of His Excellency President John Dramani Mahama and His Excellency President Xi Jinping of the People’s Republic of China. These high-level engagements provide an important foundation for translating bilateral relations into practical opportunities for our cities, institutions, businesses and people.

Our visit reinforces our commitment to building international partnerships that promote knowledge exchange, innovation, investment and sustainable urban development.

From diplomatic relations to practical partnerships, we are working to create opportunities that deliver tangible benefits to our people.

https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.title_zh: 我们访问南宁的第三天，我很荣幸受到南宁市副市长的邀请……先生
https://x.com/dramoakohene/status/211930.snippet_zh:
我们访问南宁的第三天，我很荣幸受到南宁市副市长侯进先生的接待。此前，我们已与广西壮族自治区主席韦涛阁下成功举行高级别会晤。

我们的磋商重点是启动关于加纳各城市与南宁建立友好城市合作关系的讨论，并探讨以下务实合作领域：

1. 城市规划与城市发展。
2. 开发管控与高效土地利用管理。
3. 城市交通与人员流动。
4. 教育与机构合作。
5. 医疗服务提供与医疗合作。
6. 以人工智能为驱动手段，提高财政收入动员能力和地方治理效率的现代化战略。

我们尤其受到一项邀请的鼓舞：加纳和南宁两市分别邀请对方城市的学生到各自大学就读学术课程。我们还探讨了落实双边奖学金安排、建立大学伙伴关系和开展学术交流的机会。

我们确认，在加纳总统约翰·德拉马尼·马哈马阁下和中华人民共和国主席习近平阁下的领导下，加纳与中国之间保持着牢固的外交和经济关系。这些高级别交往为将双边关系转化为惠及两国城市、机构、企业和民众的务实机遇奠定了重要基础。

此次访问强化了我们致力于建立国际伙伴关系的决心，以促进知识交流、创新、投资和可持续城市发展。

从外交关系到务实伙伴关系，我们正努力创造机遇，为两国人民带来切实利益。
